The resulting scheme provides a readable, keyboard-friendly, and machine-processable phonemic representation for language learning and cross-lingual speech processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套面向泰语和老挝语的音位化、纯ASCII罗马化方案，将两种亲缘语言作为统一的跨语言设计问题处理，兼顾音位透明性、泰老对应关系及与拼音/粤拼的对应。
AI.motivation: 泰语与老挝语关系密切，但缺乏一套音位化、纯ASCII、键盘友好且可在两语言间系统对应的罗马化方案；现有方案在音位透明度、声调表达和跨语言一致性上存在不足，且难以支持语言学习与跨语言语音处理。
AI.method: 将泰语和老挝语作为统一的跨语言设计问题，构建音位化罗马化方案：表示音段对立、元音长度和词汇声调；保持"一符号一音位"的透明性；建立泰老系统对应；优先同步语音对应（并在适用处对应拼音和粤拼），在不损害语音透明性时保留历史音韵对应；声调采用紧凑的单位数字默认记法，并可选配声调值和历史声调类别表示。
AI.result: 形成一套可读、键盘友好、可机器处理的音位表示方案，实现泰老两语的系统对应，并兼容拼音/粤拼的对应关系，适用于语言学习和跨语言语音处理。
AI.conclusion: 该方案以纯ASCII、音位透明和跨语言系统对应为核心，为泰语和老挝语提供统一的罗马化表示，兼具可读性与机器可处理性，可服务于语言学习及跨语言语音处理任务。

title: Federated Learning Framework for Privacy-Preserving Kidney Stone Detection
summary: Recent innovations in deep learning have significantly enhanced the diagnosis of medical images, although they are based on the use of centralized data storage that pose severe threats to patient privacy and medical data security. To address this issue, this research proposes a Federated Learning (FL) model that is coupled with an optimized YOLOv8 network to detect the kidney stones on a computed tomography (CT) image and at the same time, protect privacy of the patients. The suggested system can help various medical organizations to jointly train a common model without exchanging the information about the patients. This is to ensure that data protection laws like GDPR and HIPAA are adhered to. The residual feature fusion and DropBlock regularization among other architectural improvements are also included in YOLOv8 to enhance detection robustness and minimize overfitting. Experimental analysis carried out on a distributed CT dataset demonstrated that the federated YOLOv8 model has a mAP at 50 of 0.733 and is able to keep the data confidential. Moreover, its lean design facilitates fast edge deployment and real-time inference across a clinical setting. Altogether, these findings indicate that Federated Learning is a safe and efficient solution to AI-assisted diagnosis in contemporary healthcare when combined with the use of sophisticated object detection models.

AI.tldr: 提出联邦学习结合优化YOLOv8的肾结石CT检测方案，在保护患者隐私前提下实现0.733的mAP@50。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在医学影像诊断中效果显著，但依赖中心化数据存储，对患者隐私与医疗数据安全构成严重威胁，且需满足GDPR、HIPAA等合规要求。
AI.method: 采用联邦学习框架，使多家医疗机构在不共享患者数据的前提下协同训练统一模型；对YOLOv8进行架构改进，引入残差特征融合与DropBlock正则化，以提升检测鲁棒性并抑制过拟合。
AI.result: 在分布式CT数据集上实验，联邦YOLOv8模型取得mAP@50为0.733，同时保持数据机密性；模型结构轻量，支持边缘端快速部署与临床场景下的实时推理。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习结合先进目标检测模型，是当代医疗AI辅助诊断中安全且高效的可行方案。

title: Region-Level Policy Optimization for Fine-grained MLLM Perception
summary: Fine-grained visual perception in MLLMs is commonly improved by raising the resolution, but the added visual tokens inflate vision-encoding and language-model prefilling costs. We show that the two operations underlying fine-grained perception, localizing the region of interest (RoI) and recognizing its content, have different resolution requirements. In a controlled diagnostic, localization tolerates roughly 3 to 4 times stronger token compression than recognition, which motivates localizing from a coarse view and concentrating resolution on the selected evidence. Decoding coordinates with the MLLM can be trained end-to-end from answers, but costs a full model pass per query and depends on grounding ability. A lightweight proposal network distilled from the model's attention is fast, but inherits the noise of its attention targets. The RoI from the proposal network reaches the answer through a discrete region choice, so its faithfulness to the answer cannot supervise the network. We therefore optimize the proposal network with region-level reinforcement learning, which we call Vision-RL2. It treats coherent regions as actions, and a frozen MLLM reader scores each one by how its removal changes the answer likelihood. Complementary subtractive and additive objectives suppress distracting proposals and recover missing evidence, updating only the predictor without region annotations, response sampling, or reasoning trajectories. The refined proposal further enables a sparse encoding that magnifies evidence and excludes background tokens. Across six fine-grained benchmarks and four MLLM backbones, Vision-RL2 improves accuracy over the base model at every token budget and surpasses its largest-budget accuracy with about 4 times fewer visual tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/YuHengsss/VisionRL2 .

AI.tldr: 提出Vision-RL2，用区域级强化学习优化轻量提案网络，先粗视图定位RoI再将分辨率集中于证据，实现高分辨率细粒度感知的高效稀疏化。
AI.motivation: MLLM细粒度视觉感知通常靠提高分辨率实现，但增加视觉token会显著加重视觉编码与语言模型prefill开销。作者通过诊断发现定位RoI与识别内容对分辨率需求不同，定位可承受约3-4倍更强的token压缩，因此希望"从粗视图定位、对选定证据集中分辨率"以降低开销。
AI.method: 受控诊断比较定位与识别的压缩容忍度；用区域级强化学习训练提案网络（Vision-RL2）：将连贯区域视为动作，由冻结的MLLM reader根据移除该区域后答案似然的变化打分；采用互补的减法与加法目标分别抑制干扰提案与找回缺失证据；仅更新提案网络，无需区域标注、响应采样或推理轨迹。精炼后的提案进一步支持稀疏编码，放大证据并排除背景token。
AI.result: 在六个细粒度基准与四个MLLM骨干上，Vision-RL2在每个token预算下均提升基础模型准确率，并能在视觉token减少约4倍的情况下超过其最大预算的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度感知可解耦为定位（低分辨率足够）与识别（需高分辨率），据此以RL优化的提案网络加稀疏编码，可在显著降低视觉token的同时提升细粒度准确率。

title: STAR: Structure-aware Test-time Adaptation for diffusion-based light field Reconstruction
summary: Light field (LF) reconstruction from limited and noisy focal stack (FS) measurements is a highly ill-posed inverse problem. Although the LF-to-FS imaging geometry is fixed for a given optical setup, LF spatial-angular structure---including within-view spatial details, cross-view angular dependencies, and disparity across views---varies across scenes. Consequently, a fixed pre-trained prior may not optimally capture the spatial-angular structure of each test LF. We propose Structure-aware Test-time Adaptation for diffusion-based light field Reconstruction (STAR), the first test-time adaptation framework for reconstructing an LF from FS. For each test LF, STAR freezes a pre-trained diffusion prior and fits three lightweight adapters to the observed FS to jointly adapt the three components of the LF's spatial-angular structure. STAR outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in both two- and three-focal-sheet settings, with shorter inference times than those with test-time parameter updates.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出STAR，首个面向扩散模型的光场重建测试时自适应框架，通过为每个测试光场拟合三个轻量适配器，联合适配光场空间-角度结构的三个分量，从有限且含噪的焦栈测量中重建光场，性能优于现有方法且推理时间更短。
AI.motivation: 从有限且含噪的焦栈测量中重建光场是高度病态的逆问题。虽然给定光学系统的光场-焦栈成像几何固定，但光场的空间-角度结构（视图内空间细节、跨视图角度依赖、跨视图视差）因场景而异，因此固定的预训练先验可能无法最优地捕捉每个测试光场的空间-角度结构。
AI.method: 提出STAR（Structure-aware Test-time Adaptation for diffusion-based light field Reconstruction）。对每个测试光场，冻结预训练的扩散先验，并拟合三个轻量适配器到观测焦栈上，以联合适配光场空间-角度结构的三个组成部分。
AI.result: 在双焦平面和三个焦平面设置下，STAR均优于现有最先进方法，且推理时间比需要测试时参数更新的方法更短。
AI.conclusion: STAR是首个从焦栈重建光场的测试时自适应框架，通过针对每个测试光场适配空间-角度结构，在性能与推理效率上均取得优势。

title: AutoData: Agentic Search for Pre-training Data Selection
summary: LLM agents have recently shown promise in automating machine learning engineering by editing model and training code under execution feedback. Data, however, remains largely outside this agentic optimisation loop. We frame pre-training data selection as heuristic engineering over per-document features, i.e., lexical statistics, categorical labels, and perplexity. We introduce AutoData, an agent that searches directly over executable selection algorithms. Unlike prior data mixture methods that optimise weights over a fixed set of domains, AutoData searches a richer program space of scoring, stratification, and stochastic selection rules, discovering feature interactions automatically by iteratively refining algorithms with validation feedback from a proxy model. Within an overnight search, AutoData discovers a selection algorithm that outperforms existing human-designed curation pipelines. Despite being searched only on this small proxy, the discovered recipe transfers to larger scales and improves the downstream metric CORE. These results suggest that data engineering can be treated as an agentic machine learning problem, extending autonomous research from model and training-code optimization to the data.

AI.tldr: 提出 AutoData，一个面向预训练数据选择的 LLM 智能体，直接在可执行选择算法的程序空间中进行搜索，在夜间搜索内发现的算法超越人工设计的数据筛选流程，并可从小代理模型迁移到更大规模。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体已能通过代码编辑与执行反馈自动化机器学习工程（模型与训练代码），但数据选择仍停留在智能体优化循环之外；同时，既有数据混合方法只能优化固定域集合上的权重，无法发现更丰富的特征交互与选择规则。
AI.method: 将预训练数据选择重构为对逐文档特征（词汇统计量、类别标签、困惑度）的启发式工程问题，让 AutoData 直接在可执行的选择算法上搜索：涵盖打分、分层与随机选择规则组成的更丰富程序空间，并利用代理模型（proxy model）的验证反馈迭代精修算法，从而自动发现特征交互。
AI.result: 在一次夜间搜索内，AutoData 发现的选择算法优于已有的人工设计数据筛选流程；尽管仅在小代理模型上搜索，所发现的配方可迁移到更大规模，并提升下游指标 CORE。
AI.conclusion: 数据工程可被视为一个智能体式机器学习问题，从而将自主研究的能力从模型与训练代码优化扩展至数据层面。

title: HyperAMS-Net: Adaptive Multi-Scale Spatial Hypergraph Network for Brain Disorder Classification
comment: Accepted at the 17th International Workshop on Machine Learning in Medical Imaging (MLMI 2026), held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026
summary: Accurate classification of brain disorders from neuroimaging data remains challenging because of substantial inter-subject heterogeneity and the complex multi-scale patterns present in functional connectivity and morphological representations. To address these challenges, we propose HyperAMS-Net, a deep learning framework for brain disorder classification using neuroimaging representations derived from resting-state functional MRI or structural MRI. HyperAMS-Net integrates adaptive multi-scale convolution, hypergraph attention, spatial-channel attention, and adaptive feature fusion. Specifically, adaptive multi-scale convolution learns data-driven weights over multiple receptive fields to capture complementary patterns at different scales. Hypergraph attention models higher-order dependencies among learned feature representations through node--hyperedge--node message passing, while spatial-channel attention enhances discriminative feature learning. Adaptive feature fusion further aggregates complementary information across parallel network branches. HyperAMS-Net is evaluated on three benchmark datasets spanning distinct brain disorders: ABIDE for autism spectrum disorder, REST-meta-MDD for major depressive disorder, and ADNI for Alzheimer's disease, using 5-fold stratified cross-validation. HyperAMS-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance across all evaluated datasets, attaining the highest accuracy and AUC among the compared methods. Ablation studies further demonstrate the contribution of each proposed component, with the largest performance degradation observed when hypergraph attention is removed.

AI.tldr: 提出HyperAMS-Net深度学习框架，融合自适应多尺度卷积、超图注意力、空间-通道注意力和自适应特征融合，用于脑部疾病分类，在ABIDE、REST-meta-MDD和ADNI三个基准数据集上均取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 神经影像数据存在显著的个体间异质性，且功能连接与形态学表征包含复杂的多尺度模式，导致脑部疾病分类困难。现有方法难以充分捕捉这些异质性和多尺度高阶依赖关系。
AI.method: HyperAMS-Net整合四个核心模块：1）自适应多尺度卷积，对多个感受野学习数据驱动权重，捕捉不同尺度的互补模式；2）超图注意力，通过节点-超边-节点消息传递建模特征表示间的高阶依赖；3）空间-通道注意力，增强判别性特征学习；4）自适应特征融合，聚合并行网络分支的互补信息。输入为静息态功能MRI或结构MRI衍生的神经影像表征。
AI.result: 在三个覆盖不同脑部疾病的基准数据集（ABIDE-自闭症谱系障碍、REST-meta-MDD-重度抑郁症、ADNI-阿尔茨海默病）上，采用5折分层交叉验证，HyperAMS-Net在所有数据集上均取得最高准确率和AUC，达到当前最优水平。消融实验验证了各模块的贡献，其中去除超图注意力时性能下降最大。
AI.conclusion: HyperAMS-Net通过多尺度卷积与超图注意力的协同设计，有效应对神经影像的异质性和高阶依赖问题，在多种脑部疾病分类任务中展现出优越性和泛化能力，各组件均对性能有实质性贡献。

title: Benchmarking MLLMs via Cognitive Expected Scene Graph for Safety-Critical Visual Negation Understanding
summary: True machine intelligence requires transcending passive pixel registration to master top-down functional reasoning over absent information via visual negation understanding. However, unconstrained visual negation paradigms remain overly open-ended, and pervasive affirmation bias causes both existing Multi-Modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and evaluation metrics to fail under negative semantics. To solve these intertwined challenges systematically, we first anchor the boundaries of negation reasoning within specific cognitive goals. Specifically, by focusing on safety as a highly pragmatic and critical cognitive dimension, we define the task of \textbf{S}cene \textbf{N}egation \textbf{U}nderstanding under \textbf{S}afety Cognition (\textbf{SNUS}). Under this framework, we construct a high-fidelity negative caption dataset mapping dense assertions of localized hazards. Concurrently, we propose the Cognitive Expected Scene Graph (CESG) Score, a structure-grounded, polarity-aware evaluation metric. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while current models struggle on the task, traditional metrics completely collapse under semantic reversals. Conversely, our framework delivers a solid benchmark for SNUS, providing a rigorous foundation to advance risk-aware situational comprehension and counterfactual cognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出安全认知下的场景否定理解任务（SNUS），并构建了高质量否定字幕数据集与认知期望场景图（CESG）评分指标，以解决视觉否定理解中范式过于开放和肯定偏差导致模型与评测失效的问题。
AI.motivation: 真正的机器智能需要超越被动的像素登记，掌握对缺失信息进行自上而下的功能推理，即视觉否定理解。然而，无约束的视觉否定范式过于开放，且普遍存在的“肯定偏差”导致现有多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）和评测指标在否定语义下均失效。因此，作者希望系统性地解决这些相互交织的挑战。
AI.method: 作者首先将否定推理的边界锚定在特定认知目标上，聚焦“安全”这一高度实用且关键的认知维度，定义了“安全认知下的场景否定理解”（SNUS）任务。在该框架下，构建了一个高保真否定字幕数据集，用于映射局部危险陈述的密集标注；同时提出了认知期望场景图（CESG）评分，一种基于结构化表示、对极性敏感的评价指标。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，当前模型在该任务上表现困难，而传统指标在语义反转下完全崩溃。相比之下，作者提出的框架为SNUS提供了扎实的基准，为推进风险感知的情境理解与反事实认知奠定了严谨基础。
AI.conclusion: 通过将视觉否定理解限定在安全认知目标下，作者构建了任务、数据集与极性敏感评测指标，既揭示了现有模型与传统指标的不足，也为风险感知情境理解和反事实认知研究提供了严谨的基准基础。

title: Learn Before You Judge: Progressive Knowledge-to-Decision Alignment for Explainable Hateful Meme Detection
summary: Hateful memes spread abusive content through implicit interactions between images and text, posing serious threats to the safety of online communities. In recent years, multimodal large language models have been widely used for hateful meme detection and are increasingly adopted to generate explainable detection results. However, we find that existing explain-then-detect methods often couple explanation generation and label prediction within the same training process. This coupling causes interference between task objectives, leading to limited detection performance and even worse results than simple SFT baselines. To address these challenges, we propose ProKDA, a progressive knowledge-to-decision alignment method for explainable hateful meme detection. Inspired by the human annotation training process, ProKDA first uses an agentic background knowledge construction pipeline to obtain external knowledge related to meme understanding. It then adopts a three-stage training strategy that sequentially performs background knowledge learning, hatefulness detection learning, and hatefulness boundary alignment. Unlike prior explain-then-detect methods that jointly optimize both tasks, ProKDA focuses on a single training objective at each stage. This design reduces interference between the two tasks and progressively transforms background knowledge into robust detection decisions. Experiments on three public hateful meme benchmarks show that ProKDA achieves state-of-the-art detection performance and provides accurate, explainable, and evidence-supported decisions for hateful meme moderation. Project page: https://meizhiyuan88666.github.io/prokda.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProKDA，一种面向可解释仇恨表情包检测的渐进式知识到决策对齐方法，通过解耦解释生成与标签预测的训练目标，在三个公开基准上取得SOTA检测性能。
AI.motivation: 仇恨表情包的仇恨性源于图像与文本的隐式交互，严重威胁网络社区安全。现有"先解释后检测"方法将解释生成与标签预测耦合在同一训练过程中，导致任务目标相互干扰，检测性能受限，甚至不如简单的SFT基线。
AI.method: ProKDA借鉴人类标注训练过程：首先通过智能体背景知识构建流程获取与表情包理解相关的外部知识；随后采用三阶段训练策略，依次进行背景知识学习、仇恨性检测学习与仇恨边界对齐，每阶段仅聚焦单一训练目标。
AI.result: 在三个公开仇恨表情包基准上，ProKDA取得最先进的检测性能，并能提供准确、可解释且有证据支撑的决策。
AI.conclusion: 通过在各阶段仅优化单一目标，ProKDA有效缓解了解释与检测两任务间的干扰，将背景知识逐步转化为稳健的检测决策，为仇恨表情包审核提供了可解释的解决方案。

title: Hierarchical Aggregation of Semantic Uncertainty in 3D Scene Graphs
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs (3DSGs) ground each object node in a vision-language embedding, yet they record every entry as equally certain, so a robot querying the map cannot tell which of its entries are unreliable. Estimators of semantic uncertainty could supply that distinction, but they require repeated sampling of a model, training, or held-out labels, none of which are available to a deployed system at query time. We present a framework that exploits the detector confidence and the embeddings a 3DSG already stores, converts them into a probability that an entry is correct, and propagates that probability through the containment hierarchy into a belief that a room contains a queried class. Four signals, each paired with the object-level error it indicates, are converted to probabilities at the logit scale learned by the vision-language model and combined in closed form with no additional perception or training. Objects sharing a detector and a vocabulary fail together, so the framework aggregates them in the fully correlated limit, where an aggregation under independence would treat one repeated error as repeated evidence. Evaluated on HM3DSem against a state-of-the-art 3DSG system, the framework improves object retrieval and lowers the error of the room-level assertions of the graph it reads.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需重复采样、训练或标注数据的框架，利用3DSG已有的检测器置信度与视觉-语言嵌入，将四种误差信号转换为对象条目正确的概率，并在完全相关假设下沿包含层级聚合，得到房间是否包含查询类别的信念；在HM3DSem上提升了物体检索并降低房间级断言误差。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇3D场景图（3DSG）将每个物体节点锚定在视觉-语言嵌入中，但把所有条目视为同等确定，导致机器人在查询地图时无法辨别哪些条目不可靠。现有语义不确定性估计方法需要重复采样模型、训练或留出标签，而部署系统在查询时均无法获得这些条件。
AI.method: 复用3DSG已存储的检测器置信度与嵌入，将其转化为条目正确的概率：四种信号各对应一类对象级误差，在视觉-语言模型学习的logit尺度上转换为概率，并以闭式方式组合，不引入额外感知或训练。由于共享检测器与词表的物体可能共同出错，框架在完全相关极限下进行聚合，避免独立性聚合把一次重复错误当作多次独立证据。该概率沿包含层级传播为房间包含查询类别的信念。
AI.result: 在HM3DSem数据集上，与最先进的3DSG系统对比，该框架提升了物体检索性能，并降低了其读取的图在房间级断言上的误差。
AI.conclusion: 无需额外采样、训练或标签即可为3DSG条目提供校准的语义不确定性，并有效传播至房间级查询，提升机器人在部署时对地图可靠性的判断能力。

title: Printing the Underdetermined: Materializing Multi-solutionness in Figurative Paintings
summary: Figurative paintings are often approached as if they depict a single recoverable 3D scene: viewers infer depth and occlusion, and reconstruction pipelines attempt to converge to one stable model. We instead foreground multi-solutionness, the non-uniqueness of 3D configurations compatible with a single painted image, and propose a workflow that keeps this non-uniqueness visible and material. Multi-solutionness arises from two sources: unobserved content, where backsides and occluded volumes admit multiple plausible completions, and observed cues, where perspective, shading, and occlusion still underconstrain geometry. When additional views are synthesized by a video generative model without explicit 3D constraints, small frame-level drifts become inevitable rather than exceptional. Our pipeline samples multiple camera-orbit multi-view video sequences from one painting, reconstructs each sequence with 3D Gaussian Splatting into a point-based Gaussian scene representation where density halos and ghosting expose unresolved degrees of freedom, and fabricates these representations as physical artifacts using DreamPrinting. By treating multiple compatible interpretations as explicit outputs rather than residual error, we provide a computational framework for spatial readings of figurative painting that can be inspected, compared, and discussed in both digital and physical form.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以"多解性"（multi-solutionness）为核心的绘画三维解读工作流：从单幅具象绘画采样多条相机环绕视频，用3D高斯泼溅重建为显式暴露不确定性的高斯场景，并通过DreamPrinting制成实体物件，将多种相容的3D解释作为显式输出而非残差误差。
AI.motivation: 传统具象绘画研究默认其背后存在唯一可恢复的3D场景，观看者推断深度与遮挡，重建流程也力求收敛到单一稳定模型。但单幅画作实际对应多组相容的3D配置，作者希望保留并显式呈现这种非唯一性。
AI.method: 多解性来自两方面：未被观察的内容（背面与被遮挡体积可有多重合理补全）与已观察线索（透视、明暗、遮挡仍欠约束几何）。流程先用视频生成模型在无显式3D约束下合成额外视角（帧级漂移必然存在），对单幅画采样多条相机环绕多视图视频序列；随后对每条序列用3D高斯泼溅重建为基于点的高斯场景表示，其中密度光晕与重影暴露未解决的自由度；最后用DreamPrinting将这些表示制作为实体物件。
AI.result: 重建得到的多个高斯场景同时呈现同一绘画的多种相容空间解读，密度光晕与重影可视化为未定自由度；这些解读被实体化为可触可查的物理制品。
AI.conclusion: 将多种相容解释视为显式输出而非残差误差，为具象绘画的空间阅读提供了可检视、可比较、可在数字与实体形式中讨论的计算框架。

title: AI Smart Glasses for Wearable Intelligence: From Egocentric Sensing to Agentic Personalization
summary: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are reshaping smart glasses from egocentric capture and display devices into platforms for wearable intelligence. Smart glasses increasingly serve as wearable AI systems that connect first-person observation with real-time assistance under strict form-factor constraints. We frame this transition through the lens of \emph{AI smart glasses} and define them as a system-level concept in which egocentric sensing, resource-aware computing, intelligent reasoning, multimodal interaction, and real-world application constraints are co-designed for personalized assistance in the physical world. To systematically study this perspective, we organize the survey around four connected dimensions. First, we examine the hardware foundation that bounds sensing, computation, feedback delivery, and sustained deployment. Second, we study wearable intelligence, where egocentric signals are transformed into perceptual, contextual, and agentic capabilities. Third, we discuss interaction design, through which users request, receive, correct, and regulate assistance during ongoing activity. Fourth, we analyze application scenarios across healthcare, accessibility, situated learning, daily life assistance, cultural tourism, and industrial support, showing how domain requirements reshape system design and evaluation. We further identify five cross-cutting research challenges for future AI smart glasses: next-generation hardware, trustworthy egocentric intelligence, lifelong personalized memory, proactive intelligence, and embodied foundation models. By centering smart glasses as wearable-intelligence platforms, this survey provides a unified framework for organizing technologies, applications, and open challenges in this emerging area.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于"AI智能眼镜"的综述，将其定义为集成自我中心感知、资源感知计算、智能推理、多模态交互与应用约束的系统级可穿戴智能平台。
AI.motivation: AI进展正推动智能眼镜从单纯的自我中心拍摄与显示设备，转变为可穿戴智能平台，需要统一的框架来组织该新兴领域的技术、应用与开放挑战。
AI.method: 围绕四个相互关联的维度组织综述：硬件基础（感知、计算、反馈、持续部署）、可穿戴智能（自我中心信号转化为感知、情境与智能体能力）、交互设计（用户请求、接收、纠正与调节辅助）、应用场景（医疗、无障碍、情境学习、日常生活、文化旅游、工业支持）。
AI.result: 明确了各维度如何受领域需求影响并重塑系统设计与评估，并提炼出五项跨领域研究挑战。
AI.conclusion: 提出未来AI智能眼镜的五大挑战：下一代硬件、可信的自我中心智能、终身个性化记忆、主动式智能、具身基础模型；以智能眼镜为可穿戴智能平台，为该领域提供统一研究框架。

title: Evolution or Illusion? Rethinking Evaluation in LLM Evolutionary Search
summary: LLM-driven evolutionary search finds programs by launching seeds and iterating each one. Papers report a single budget setting, usually one seed run for a fixed number of iterations, and rank methods from that one point. We show this is not enough. We evaluate three evolutionary search strategies on five optimization tasks, commonly used by papers in the genre to report results. We run the analysis over a full grid of seeds and iterations. Our findings suggest that the best way to split a fixed budget between more seeds (width) and more iterations (depth) changes with the strategy, the task, and the total budget. Furthermore, we observe that the ranking of strategies also changes with the budget. On one task the strategy that looks worst at one seed is best at forty seeds. On another the best number of iterations is well below the value common in practice, so extra depth wastes budget that more seeds would turn into score. We provide a measurement protocol that reports the seeds-by-iterations frontier and practical guidance for using it.

AI.tldr: 本文实证指出LLM驱动的进化搜索论文中"单一预算设置"评测方式不足，提出用"种子数×迭代数"全网格前沿的测量协议来报告与比较方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动进化搜索文献通常只报告一个预算点（如1个种子运行固定迭代次数）并据此排名方法，忽略了预算在"宽度（种子数）"与"深度（迭代数）"之间的分配方式，可能导致结论片面甚至错误。
AI.method: 在五个优化任务上评估三种进化搜索策略，覆盖种子数与迭代数的完整网格（如从1个到40个种子），分析不同策略、任务、总预算下最优预算分配方式的变化，以及策略排名的稳定性。
AI.result: 最优的宽度-深度分配随策略、任务和总预算而变；策略排名也随预算改变——某任务中1个种子时表现最差的策略在40个种子时最优；另一任务中最优迭代数远低于常用值，过多深度浪费预算，本可转化为更多种子带来的分数提升。
AI.conclusion: 单一预算点的评测不足以支撑方法排名，应报告"种子×迭代"前沿；作者提供了测量协议及实用指南，指导在此前沿上进行更稳健的评测与预算分配。

title: Dictionary-Constrained Grapheme-to-Phoneme for Unsegmented Languages from LLM-Annotated Data
summary: Grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) conversion turns raw text into its phonemic form and is an essential part of both text-to-speech (TTS) and automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. It is required to be fast, stable and context-aware. For unsegmented languages such as Japanese, G2P additionally couples word segmentation with highly context-dependent polyphone disambiguation, and the scarcity of accurately annotated data remains a bottleneck. In this paper, we present a context-aware, segmentation-agnostic neural G2P framework that models the joint segmentation-and-reading hypothesis space, scoring paths of a discriminative conditional random field (CRF) over a dictionary-derived word lattice. To tackle data scarcity, we utilize large language models (LLMs) to generate more than 2 million sentences. Experimental results demonstrate that our method substantially outperforms conventional morphological analyzer-based methods and neural sequence models. On the Joyo-Kanji-Yomi benchmark, our method reaches 99.62% target word reading accuracy, 0.32% target word phoneme error rate (PER) and 0.14% sentence PER.

AI.tldr: 提出一种上下文感知、不依赖分词的神经G2P框架，通过CRF在词典词格上联合建模分词与读音假设空间，并用LLM生成超200万句数据缓解标注稀缺，在Joyo-Kanji-Yomi基准上取得99.62%词读音准确率、0.32%词PER与0.14%句PER。
AI.motivation: G2P是TTS与ASR的关键组件，需具备快速、稳定、上下文感知能力。对日语等不分词语言，G2P还需同时处理分词与高度依赖上下文的同音异读消歧，而高质量标注数据稀缺成为主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建上下文感知、分词无关的神经G2P框架：在词典导出的词格上定义判别式条件随机场（CRF），直接对联合的"分词-读音"假设空间中的路径打分；同时利用大语言模型（LLM）生成逾200万句数据以缓解标注稀缺。
AI.result: 显著优于传统基于形态分析器的方法与神经序列模型；在Joyo-Kanji-Yomi基准上达到99.62%目标词读音准确率、0.32%目标词音素错误率（PER）和0.14%句级PER。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模分词与读音的CRF词格框架结合LLM数据增强，可有效提升不分词语言G2P的准确性与鲁棒性，为数据稀缺场景提供可行方案。

title: Absence is Presence: Understanding Visual Scene Negative Events Under Safety Cognitive Constraint
summary: Traditional scene understanding focuses on affirmative information objectively present in images. However, in safety-critical domains, comprehending key information that should exist but is actually absent is vital for risk mitigation. To bridge this gap, we focus on visual scene negative captioning with safety as the cognitive constraint. The core challenge is to convert physical absence into semantic negative events. Existing vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with this process because affirmation bias suppresses negative reasoning, while limited mental filling capability and representation bias further hinder the inference of absent information. To address these challenges, we propose a negative captioning framework based on counterfactual reconstruction and contrastive decoding (CRCD). Inspired by human cognition, CRCD reformulates the task as counterfactual latent change captioning to bypass affirmation bias. It contrasts a synthesized safe expectation with reality to identify semantic omissions. To address limited mental filling, we design a dual-branch counterfactual reconstruction architecture. The amodal completion branch restores defective objects, while the functional association branch infers completely absent safety objects. Concurrently, a multi-condition representation learning mechanism is integrated to mitigate representation bias by projecting universal features onto predefined safety criteria subspaces, thereby capturing information across more dimensions. By decoding feature-level semantic residuals between the reconstructed scene prototype and raw input, CRCD bounds the non-existence search space and activates the decoder's negative logic. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of CRCD, establishing a high-performance baseline for this pioneering task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于反事实重构与对比解码（CRCD）的视觉场景负向描述框架，将安全约束下的"缺失信息"转化为语义负向事件，在该新任务上建立了高性能基线。
AI.motivation: 传统场景理解只关注图像中客观存在的肯定性信息，但在安全攸关领域，识别"本应存在却实际缺失"的关键信息对风险规避至关重要。现有视觉语言模型受肯定性偏置、心理填充能力不足和表征偏置的制约，难以完成这一"物理缺失→语义负向事件"的转换。
AI.method: 受人类认知启发，CRCD将任务重构为反事实潜在变化描述以绕开肯定性偏置，通过对比合成的安全期望与现实来识别语义遗漏；设计双分支反事实重构架构，其中非模态补全分支修复缺陷目标，功能关联分支推断完全缺失的安全目标；引入多条件表征学习机制，将通用特征投影到预定义安全准则子空间以缓解表征偏置；最后解码重构场景原型与原始输入之间的特征级语义残差，约束"不存在"搜索空间并激活解码器的负向逻辑。
AI.result: 大量实验验证了CRCD的有效性，为该开创性任务建立了高性能基线。
AI.conclusion: CRCD通过反事实重构与对比解码，有效克服肯定性偏置、心理填充受限与表征偏置三大挑战，实现了安全约束下的视觉场景负向描述，可作为后续研究的强基线。

title: SnapPhysics: A Physics-Aware Scene Graph from a Single View for Interactive Mixed Reality Scenes
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE ISMAR, 2026
summary: We propose SnapPhysics, a training-free framework that reconstructs 3D objects and estimates their physical properties such as mass, friction, and center of gravity from a single image. For physically coherent interactions in mixed reality (MR), such properties are as important as geometry. Prior approaches infer them by analyzing object dynamics in video, which is computationally costly, or by querying vision-language models (VLMs) on single images, which lacks geometric grounding and inter-object relationships. We address these limitations by combining instance-level 3D reconstruction and spatial alignment with a physics-aware scene graph that encodes these relationships and per-object metric geometry as structured context for VLM-based property reasoning. Experiments on 3D-FRONT show that SnapPhysics improves scene-level F-Score by 18.6% over the best learning-based method, and on real captured scenes with ground-truth mass, it reduces the mean absolute log difference error (mALDE) by up to 20.5% and improves log-scale correlation ($r^2_{\mathrm{ls}}$) by up to 19.6% over VLM-only estimation. SnapPhysics enables physically interactive MR experiences without manual parameter tuning. Project page: https://snapphysics-ismar2026.github.io/.

AI.tldr: SnapPhysics：一种免训练框架，从单张图像重建3D物体并估计质量、摩擦、重心等物理属性，通过实例级重建＋空间对齐＋物理感知场景图作为VLM的结构化上下文，显著提升场景级与真实场景的物理属性估计精度。
AI.motivation: 混合现实中物理一致的交互不仅依赖几何，还依赖质量、摩擦、重心等物理属性。现有方法要么通过视频中物体动力学推断，计算代价高；要么用视觉语言模型（VLM）对单张图像直接查询，缺乏几何基础与物体间关系建模。
AI.method: 将实例级3D重建与空间对齐，同物理感知场景图相结合；该场景图编码物体间关系及逐物体的度量几何，作为结构化上下文供VLM进行物理属性推理。整个框架无需训练。
AI.result: 在3D-FRONT上，场景级F-Score较最佳学习型方法提升18.6%；在带真值质量的真实采集场景中，较纯VLM估计，平均绝对对数差误差（mALDE）最多降低20.5%，对数尺度相关性（r²_ls）最多提升19.6%。
AI.conclusion: SnapPhysics无需人工调参即可实现可物理交互的MR体验，为单图像物理属性估计提供了兼顾几何基础与关系的有效方案。

title: F$^{2}$DR: A Fine-Grained Full-Pipeline Reward Framework for DeepSearch Workflows
summary: With the widespread industrial deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), DeepSearch has emerged as the dominant paradigm for resolving complex user queries. It typically operates through an iterative closed-loop workflow consisting of planning and reflection, information retrieval, and answer generation. However, existing reward models (RMs) and evaluation benchmarks are primarily designed for static single-turn tasks, failing to capture the full-pipeline complexity of DeepSearch workflows. To address this limitation, we propose F2DR, a fine-grained full-pipeline DeepSearch reward framework. F2DR evaluates DeepSearch workflows across three dimensions: Content, Trajectory, and Answer, enabling comprehensive process-level assessment. We further construct DeepSearch RM-Bench, a dedicated benchmark for evaluating RMs in DeepSearch scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that F2DR achieves significantly higher evaluation consistency than self-evaluation-based baselines, while DeepSearch RM-Bench exhibits strong discriminative capability across existing open-source RMs. We will publicly release the complete DeepSearch RM-Bench dataset soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出F2DR细粒度全流程DeepSearch奖励框架，从内容、轨迹、答案三个维度评估DeepSearch工作流，并构建DeepSearch RM-Bench基准；实验表明F2DR评估一致性显著优于自评估基线，RM-Bench对现有开源奖励模型具备强区分能力。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）的广泛工业部署，DeepSearch已成为解决复杂用户查询的主流范式，其通常采用由规划与反思、信息检索、答案生成构成的迭代闭环工作流。然而现有奖励模型（RMs）与评测基准主要面向静态单轮任务，无法刻画DeepSearch工作流的全流程复杂性。
AI.method: 提出F2DR——一种细粒度、全流程的DeepSearch奖励框架，从Content（内容）、Trajectory（轨迹）、Answer（答案）三个维度对DeepSearch工作流进行评估，实现全面的过程级评估；并进一步构建DeepSearch RM-Bench，用于在DeepSearch场景下评测奖励模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，F2DR的评估一致性显著高于基于自评估的基线方法；DeepSearch RM-Bench在现有开源奖励模型上展现出强区分能力。完整数据集将很快公开。
AI.conclusion: F2DR与DeepSearch RM-Bench填补了DeepSearch全流程奖励建模与评测的空白，为过程级评估提供有效方案，并计划公开发布基准数据集以推动后续研究。

title: KoUniTalk: A Lightweight Articulation-Centered Korean-English 3D Talking Face Benchmark
summary: High-quality 3D talking face datasets remain largely English-centric, and Korean 3D facial motion data are difficult to combine with standard English benchmarks because of differences in mesh topology, spatial scale, coordinate system, and temporal sampling. We present KoUniTalk, a lightweight articulation-centered Korean-English 3D talking face benchmark that retargets VOCASET and the released Korean speech-based 3D talking face data to a shared mesh topology using deformation transfer. Rather than proposing a new deformation-transfer algorithm or a full-head identity-preserving avatar dataset, KoUniTalk provides an identity-neutral canonical output space for controlled speech-driven facial articulation training and evaluation across English and Korean. The unified template contains 1,176 vertices and focuses on the mouth and adjacent lower- and mid-face regions, reducing the output dimensionality from 15,069 and 72,147 dimensions to 3,528 dimensions, corresponding to 4.27-fold and 20.45-fold reductions compared with VOCASET/FLAME and the original Korean mesh, respectively. To examine whether retargeting preserves speech-relevant motion, we evaluate semantic mouth-landmark trajectories, including mouth opening, mouth width, aperture ratio, and mouth-opening dynamics. Since the official test set of the Korean dataset is not publicly released, we additionally define a subject-disjoint Korean benchmark split. The processed matched benchmark contains 22 speakers, 4,978 sequences, and 642,781 frames, enabling Korean-English cross-dataset evaluation of speech-driven 3D facial animation models in a single compact articulation-template space. Source-reported inventory counts are listed separately from these processed counts.

AI.tldr: KoUniTalk是一个轻量的韩英双语3D说话人脸基准，通过变形迁移将VOCASET与韩语语音3D人脸数据重定向到统一网格拓扑，构建身份中立的规范发音空间，用于跨语言语音驱动面部发音的受控训练与评测。
AI.motivation: 高质量3D说话人脸数据集以英语为主，韩语3D面部运动数据因网格拓扑、空间尺度、坐标系和时间采样差异，难以与标准英语基准结合使用。
AI.method: 使用变形迁移（deformation transfer）将VOCASET和已发布的韩语语音3D说话人脸数据重定向到共享网格拓扑；统一模板含1,176个顶点，聚焦嘴部及相邻中下面部区域；通过语义嘴部关键点轨迹（嘴部张开度、嘴部宽度、开合比、张嘴动态）评估重定向是否保留语音相关运动；因韩语数据集官方测试集未公开，额外定义按说话人划分的韩语基准划分。
AI.result: 输出维度从15,069和72,147维降至3,528维，相较VOCASET/FLAME和原始韩语网格分别减少4.27倍和20.45倍；处理后的匹配基准包含22位说话人、4,978个序列、642,781帧。数据清单计数与处理计数分开列示。
AI.conclusion: KoUniTalk提供了身份中立的规范表达空间，支持在单一紧凑发音模板空间中进行语音驱动3D面部动画模型的韩英跨数据集评测。

title: PACE: Precise AI Cinematic Expression
comment: v2: the supplementary material referenced throughout v1 was never uploaded; it is removed and its 69 references resolved, two of its results moved into the main text and one dropped. 36 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/StudioPiLabs/pace-core
summary: Between a screenplay and a film sits a planning problem that is spatial first: who stands where, and what a camera sees from where it stands. An image diffusion model asked for a shot in free text settles that plan by its own defaults. We present PACE (Precise AI Cinematic Expression), a typed representation for the plan: the screenplay evidence, the characters, props and locations it needs, where each subject stands, and what the camera does. A value is written once at the level it belongs to (script, scene, shot or panel) and inherited below it. A compiler turns the result into both the prompt sent to the diffusion model and a 3D scene built in metres, and a camera solver places the camera so that the declared framing is the framing built. Where a declared value becomes geometry, PACE measures, field by field, how far the compiled camera and the staged render sit from the declaration, rather than asking a model to judge. On the 11-scene Automatic Drive screenplay, every staged single-subject panel places its subject within 1.2% of frame width of its declared position; with two or three subjects one camera pose cannot satisfy every position, and the residual is reported rather than absorbed. On 204 external director-storyboard shots, delivered head height is 1.906 times the staged target from the director's words, 1.733 from the compiled prompt, and 0.955 with the greybox control; the condition that holds framing best draws the described action least. Declaring the pose on 30 shots raises the action drawn from 58.9% to 74.4% without moving the framing. Transitions, fitted motion and human review of the generated panels remain open. Code: https://github.com/StudioPiLabs/pace-core

AI.tldr: PACE 提出一种带类型的分层表示（剧本-场景-镜头-画格），将影视分镜的空间规划显式声明并编译为扩散模型提示词与以米为单位的 3D 场景，通过相机求解器使实际取景与声明一致，并逐字段量化几何偏差而非交由模型评判。
AI.motivation: 从剧本到成片之间存在一个"空间优先"的规划问题：谁站在哪里、摄影机从何处看到什么。自由文本提示图像扩散模型生成镜头时，模型用自身默认值隐式决定该规划，导致取景、站位与动作难以精确控制。作者希望把这一隐含规划显式化、可度量、可复现。
AI.method: 提出 PACE 类型化表示，涵盖剧本证据、所需角色/道具/场景、每个主体站位及摄影机行为；值在所属层级（剧本、场景、镜头、画格）写一次并向下层继承。编译器将声明结果同时生成扩散模型提示词和以米为单位的 3D 场景，相机求解器放置相机使声明取景等于实际构建取景。对声明值转为几何之处，按字段测量编译相机与摆拍渲染相对声明值的偏差，而非使用模型评判。数据集：11 场景 Automatic Drive 剧本、204 个外部导演-分镜镜头、30 个声明姿态的镜头。
AI.result: Automatic Drive 剧本上每个摆拍单主体画格，主体位置误差在画幅宽度的 1.2% 以内；双/三主体时单一机位无法同时满足所有位置，残余偏差被报告而非吸收。204 个外部导演-分镜镜头中，交付头部高度为导演文字目标的 1.906 倍、编译提示词的 1.733 倍、灰盒控制的 0.955 倍；取景保持最好的条件反而最少呈现所描述动作。在 30 个镜头上声明姿态，使绘制动作比例从 58.9% 提升至 74.4%，且不改变取景。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式分层声明与编译，PACE 在几何层面精确控制分镜站位与取景，并揭示取景保持与动作呈现之间的权衡；声明姿态可在不牺牲取景的前提下提升动作绘制率。转场、拟合运动及生成画格的人工审核仍为待解问题。

title: Adapting Vision-Language Models for Human-Readable XAI in Industrial Object Detection
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) solutions are essential for building trust in AI technologies and their integration in real manufacturing lines. However, most existing methods are tailored to technical experts, limiting their accessibility to diverse user groups such as blue-collar workers in manufacturing lines who use AI for quality control. In this work, we introduce an XAI interface for object detection in industrial manufacturing based on a fine-tuned vision-language model, designed to generate intuitive explanations for non-expert users. We benchmark existing vision-language models and demonstrate that out-of-the-box models often fall short in delivering clear, context-relevant explanations for non-expert users. To address this, we fine-tune a vision-language model and integrate it into our interface, enabling contextualized, accessible explanations for non-expert users. We demonstrate improvements in explanation clarity, instruction adherence, image groundedness, and contextual awareness over GPT 4o-mini on proprietary and public robotics dataset. This approach advances the accessibility and usability of AI explanations, making them more intuitive and applicable in manufacturing domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于微调视觉语言模型的XAI接口，为制造业非专家用户生成直观的目标检测解释，在清晰度、指令遵循、图像接地性和上下文感知上优于GPT-4o-mini。
AI.motivation: 可解释AI对建立信任并融入实际生产线至关重要，但现有方法多面向技术专家，难以服务制造业质检等场景中的蓝领工人等非专家群体，其可及性受限。
AI.method: 先对现有视觉语言模型进行基准评测，发现开箱即用模型难以提供清晰、贴合语境、面向非专家的解释；随后微调一个视觉语言模型并集成到XAI接口中，用于工业制造中的目标检测解释生成。
AI.result: 在自有的和公开的机器人数据集上，相比GPT-4o-mini，本方法在解释清晰度、指令遵循度、图像接地性和上下文感知方面均取得提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提升了AI解释的可及性与可用性，使解释更直观并更适用于制造领域。

title: Feeling Terrain Before Crossing: World Models for Off-Road Navigation
summary: Navigation world models plan by foresight, predicting the future that each candidate action sequence produces and selecting the best, rather than mapping observations to actions directly. Unlike urban settings where a predicted scene is a sufficient proxy, off-road navigation hinges on the robot--terrain interaction, so the prediction must cover not only what the camera will see but what the robot will feel. However, existing scene-focused models do not predict how much the robot will slip, tilt or shake along a planned trajectory. Proprioception captures these dynamics directly and, when used as input, improves the prediction of the physical future. We present Feel-WM, the first off-road navigation world model that conditions on proprioception and predicts what the robot will feel alongside what the camera will see. The physical future takes the form of a future proprioceptive state and a failure risk, both learned from the robot's own experience without human labels. The planner rolls out the physical future alongside the scene and weighs the predicted failure risk against goal similarity in a separable score. Experiments on real off-road data and in simulation demonstrate that Feel-WM outperforms visual-only navigation world models in open-loop planning and closed-loop rough-terrain navigation across wheeled and legged platforms. Deployed on a Husky on mountain trails, Feel-WM plans onboard, predicts rough ground ahead and steers around it, completing courses that an end-to-end policy fails.

AI.tldr: 提出Feel-WM，首个以本体感知为条件的越野导航世界模型，同时预测未来视觉场景、本体感知状态与失败风险，并在可分离评分中权衡风险与目标相似度，真实与仿真实验均优于纯视觉世界模型。
AI.motivation: 越野导航的关键在于机器人—地形交互，预测不仅要覆盖相机所见，还要覆盖机器人所感（打滑、倾斜、抖动）。现有以场景为中心的世界模型无法预测这些动力学，而本体感知可直接捕捉这些动态并提升物理未来预测。
AI.method: Feel-WM以本体感知为条件进行世界建模，预测物理未来（未来本体感知状态与失败风险），二者均从机器人自身经验中学习、无需人工标注；规划器将物理未来与场景一并推演，在可分离评分中权衡预测失败风险与目标相似度。
AI.result: 在真实越野数据与仿真中，Feel-WM在开环规划与闭环崎岖地形导航上均优于纯视觉导航世界模型，覆盖轮式与足式平台；部署于山地小径的Husky上可机载规划、预判前方崎岖地面并绕行，完成端到端策略失败的路线。
AI.conclusion: 本体感知条件化的世界模型能有效预测越野物理未来并规避失败风险，为越野导航提供优于纯视觉方案的规划能力，且具备真实平台部署可行性。

title: Reproducibility is not construct validity: LLM measurement of institutionally situated communication
summary: High annotation reproducibility does not necessarily imply that an LLM-inferred measure captures the construct it is intended to measure. We test this distinction using a dataset from the European Commission's AI Act consultation, linking structured survey responses to free-text consultation submissions from the same stakeholders. LLM annotations of consultation submissions are highly reproducible (intraclass correlations > 0.99), yet show limited convergence with survey-reported measures of the nominal construct they were intended to approximate. Divergence between survey-and LLM-inferred text-based measures varies systematically across stakeholder groups: business associations express greater concern about AI risks in text-based consultations than in survey responses ({g} = +1.0), whereas public authorities and several nonbusiness groups show smaller or negative divergences. Divergences between scores suggest positive spatial autocorrelation across European countries (Moran's I = 0.347, p = 0.036), indicating that stakeholders from neighboring countries tend toward more similar text-based stances towards AI safety concerns. Despite divergence, survey-reported concerns remain strongly associated with support for explainability across all divergence levels. These results demonstrate that LLM annotation reproducibility can coexist with poor construct correspondence and motivate validation procedures that distinguish reproducibility, construct validity, and communication context variation when LLMs are used as measurement instruments.

AI.tldr: 该文区分LLM标注的"可复现性"与"构念效度"，利用欧盟委员会AI法案咨询数据（结构化问卷与同一利益相关方的自由文本意见相结合）进行检验。结果显示：LLM标注可复现性极高（ICC > 0.99），但与问卷测量的名义构念收敛有限，且分歧随利益相关方群体系统性变化，并在欧洲国家间呈正空间自相关。作者据此主张在使用LLM作为测量工具时，应分别验证可复现性、构念效度与沟通情境变异。
AI.motivation: 既有研究常以标注一致性/可复现性作为LLM测量质量的证据，但高可复现性并不保证所测指标真正捕捉了目标构念。作者希望澄清并实证区分"可复现性"与"构念效度"这两个常被混淆的测量学标准，并考察文本沟通情境差异对测量等价性的影响。
AI.method: 研究使用欧盟委员会AI法案咨询数据集，将同一利益相关方的结构化问卷回答与其自由文本咨询意见相链接。以组内相关系数（ICC）评估LLM对咨询文本标注的可复现性；以GLM/效应量比较文本推断指标与问卷自报指标之间的收敛程度（分歧），并按利益相关方群体（商业协会、公共机构、非商业团体等）分解；随后对分歧分数做空间自相关分析（Moran's I）以检验跨国地理聚集；最后在不同分歧水平下检验问卷自报关切与对可解释性支持之间的关联。
AI.result: LLM标注具有极高可复现性（ICC > 0.99），但与问卷自报的名义构念收敛有限。分歧呈群体系统性差异：商业协会在文本中表达的AI风险关切高于问卷（{g} = +1.0），而公共机构及若干非商业团体的分歧较小或为负。分歧分数在欧洲国家间呈现显著正空间自相关（Moran's I = 0.347，p = 0.036），表明邻国利益相关方的文本立场更趋相似。尽管存在分歧，问卷自报关切在所有分歧水平上均与对可解释性的支持强相关。
AI.conclusion: LLM标注的高可复现性可以与较差的构念对应性并存，因此不能将可复现性等同于构念效度。文本与问卷测量之间的分歧具有群体与地理系统性，说明测量受沟通情境差异影响。作者主张在将LLM作为测量工具时，应建立区分可复现性、构念效度与沟通情境变异的验证流程。

title: Socialized UAV Cross-Task Learning: Towards Cross-Granularity Collaboration through Hierarchical Interaction
summary: Joint learning across heterogeneous tasks is often treated as task coupling through feature sharing, distillation, or auxiliary supervision. However, in cross-task learning, mismatched representational and supervisory granularities make such coupling prone to interference, teacher bias, or unidirectional collapse. We argue that cross-granularity learning is fundamentally a problem of hierarchical interaction regulation rather than simple task coupling. This issue is particularly evident in UAV perception, where visual shifts and detection--segmentation objectives naturally form coarse- and fine-grained knowledge sources. To systematically study this problem, we introduce CrossUAV, a UAV benchmark for joint object detection and instance segmentation that provides a unified evaluation platform for cross-granularity task collaboration. To address these challenges, we propose Cross-Granularity Socialized Collaboration (CGSC), a progressive and adaptive framework that regulates when, where, and how tasks exchange information across network hierarchies. CGSC progressively activates cross-task interactions and adaptively adjusts the strength according to task contribution, suppressing harmful interference while exploiting complementary coarse- and fine-grained structures. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements on both tasks, validating hierarchical dynamic interaction as an effective mechanism for cross-granularity collaboration.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将跨粒度学习视为层级交互调控问题，并构建UAV基准CrossUAV及渐进自适应协作框架CGSC，在检测与实例分割上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 异构任务联合学习通常以特征共享、蒸馏或辅助监督实现任务耦合，但在跨任务学习中，表征与监督粒度不匹配易导致干扰、教师偏差或单向塌陷。作者认为跨粒度学习本质上是层级交互调控问题，而非简单任务耦合，这一矛盾在UAV感知中尤为突出：视觉偏移以及检测与分割目标天然构成粗粒度与细粒度知识来源。
AI.method: 1) 构建CrossUAV基准，面向UAV联合目标检测与实例分割，提供统一的跨粒度任务协作评测平台；2) 提出Cross-Granularity Socialized Collaboration (CGSC)框架，渐进且自适应地调控任务在网络层级间交换信息的时机、位置与方式；3) CGSC渐进激活跨任务交互，并根据任务贡献自适应调整交互强度，从而抑制有害干扰并利用粗/细粒度结构的互补性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，检测与实例分割两个任务均获得一致的性能提升，验证了层级动态交互作为跨粒度协作机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 跨粒度任务协作的有效途径在于对层级交互进行动态调控，而非静态耦合；CGSC与CrossUAV为UAV场景下的跨粒度联合感知提供了方法框架与评测基础。

title: Zarya: A Hybrid Autoregressive--Masked Diffusion Language Model with Flexible Training and Dual-Mode Inference
comment: Preprint. Work in progress. Please cite peer-reviewed version when published
summary: Autoregressive language models (ARMs) are constrained by sequential, left-to-right generation, while masked diffusion models (MDMs) enable parallel decoding but suffer from high computational overhead due to the inability to reuse Key-Value (KV) cache and from incoherent generation arising from learning dependencies over an intractable space of token combinations. We introduce Zarya, a family of hybrid language models that jointly optimizes an autoregressive (AR) objective and a masked-diffusion objective within a single architecture. Zarya structures training data into variable-size slots and employs a curriculum that gradually increases slot granularity, enabling a smooth transition from fine-grained AR learning to coarse-grained diffusion learning. At inference, Zarya provides two distinct decoding paradigms through a unified interface: (i) MDM sampling with first-hitting denoising, and (ii) slotted speculative decoding that interleaves inter-slot diffusion-based selection with intra-slot autoregressive infilling, achieving full KV cache reuse. The training and inference regimes are fully decoupled, allowing a model trained with any configuration to be deployed in either mode. Extensive configurability --- including grouped noise patterns (Prefix Completion, Fill-In-the-Prefix, Fill-In-the-Middle), ordered sampling schedules, and noise-level permutation strategies --- enables flexible research exploration. We release Zarya models publicly in sizes 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, demonstrating performance on standard benchmarks while offering a principled integration of autoregressive and diffusion paradigms.

AI.tldr: Zarya 是一种混合语言模型，在单一架构内联合优化自回归与掩码扩散目标，通过可变槽位粒度课程实现两种范式的平滑过渡，并支持训练与推理解耦的灵活部署。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型受限于严格的从左到右顺序生成；掩码扩散模型虽支持并行解码，却因无法复用 KV 缓存而计算开销高，且在不计其数的 token 组合空间中学习依赖关系导致生成不连贯。作者希望兼取二者之长、规避其短。
AI.method: 提出 Zarya 系列混合模型，在同一架构内同时优化 AR 目标与掩码扩散目标。训练时将数据组织为可变大小槽位，并用逐渐增大槽位粒度的课程策略，实现从细粒度 AR 学习到粗粒度扩散学习的平滑过渡。推理时通过统一接口提供两种解码范式：（i）首次命中去噪的 MDM 采样；（ii）槽位投机解码，将槽间基于扩散的选择与槽内自回归填充交错进行，从而实现完整 KV 缓存复用。训练与推理机制完全解耦，任意配置训练的模型都可部署于任一模式。此外支持分组噪声模式（前缀补全、前缀填充、中间填充）、有序采样调度及噪声级置换策略等可配置项。
AI.result: 公开发布 0.6B、1.7B 与 4B 三种规模的 Zarya 模型，在标准基准上取得性能表现，并给出自回归与扩散范式的有原则性整合方案。
AI.conclusion: Zarya 通过统一架构内的 AR 与扩散目标联合优化、可变槽位粒度课程以及训练-推理解耦设计，在保留自回归建模能力的同时引入并行解码与 KV 缓存复用优势，为混合语言模型提供了灵活且可扩展的研究与部署框架。

title: PART: Learning 3D Part Assembly and Retrieval with Transformers
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers. 11 pages, 12 figures. Project page: https://iambrc.github.io/PART-project-page/
summary: 3D assembly is fundamental to modern manufacturing and digital content creation. In this paper, we present PART, a unified transformer-based framework for 3D part retrieval and assembly: given a target shape and a part library, PART automatically selects the appropriate parts and predicts their 6-DoF poses to reconstruct the target. While prior work has achieved impressive progress on assembling a pre-defined set of parts, this more practical retrieval-based setting remains largely unexplored. The task faces three key challenges: (i) a combinatorially explosive search space that grows exponentially with library size; (ii) variable-length outputs, as different targets require different numbers of parts; and (iii) continuous 6-DoF pose estimation for part assembly. To address these, we formulate retrieval and assembly as a set prediction problem and design a novel transformer-based framework that retrieves parts and regresses their poses with variable-length output. Additionally, we exploit the duality between part pose estimation and target segmentation through joint training and a novel segmentation-enhanced optimization module. Finally, We curate a large-scale dataset of 80K+ shapes, and the results show that PART generalizes to scene layouts, image targets, and real-world scans. Project Page: https://iambrc.github.io/PART-project-page/.

AI.tldr: PART：统一的基于Transformer的3D部件检索与装配框架，将检索与装配建模为集合预测问题，支持变长输出与连续6-DoF位姿回归，并借助位姿估计与目标分割的对偶性进行联合训练。
AI.motivation: 现代制造与数字内容创建依赖3D装配，但已有工作多聚焦于对预定义部件集合进行装配，更实用的"从部件库中检索并装配"场景仍待探索。该任务面临三大挑战：搜索空间随库规模指数增长、输出长度可变、需连续6-DoF位姿估计。
AI.method: 将检索与装配形式化为集合预测问题，设计新颖的Transformer框架，从部件库中检索部件并以变长输出回归其位姿；利用部件位姿估计与目标分割之间的对偶性，通过联合训练与新颖的分割增强优化模块提升性能。
AI.result: 构建了80K+形状的大规模数据集；实验表明PART可泛化至场景布局、图像目标以及真实世界扫描。
AI.conclusion: PART验证了检索式3D装配这一更实用设定的可行性，统一的Transformer集合预测框架结合分割增强优化可有效应对爆炸搜索空间、变长输出与连续6-DoF位姿估计，并具备跨域泛化能力。

title: BINDER: A Latent Variable Model for Probabilistic Medical Image Registration
summary: We propose a new probabilistic model for general-purpose medical image registration that builds upon the mutual information registration criterion. It centers around a spatial interpolation technique that assumes latent voxel-wise correspondences between the images being registered. By exploiting these latent variables, we derive dedicated optimization and MCMC sampling techniques that only involve closed-form iterative updates. When applied to nonlinear registration, an efficient demons-like optimization algorithm is obtained that shows robust out-of-the-box performance across a variety of monomodal and multimodal registration tasks. We also demonstrate a corresponding sampler that can quantify, for the first time, uncertainty in multimodal registration scenarios with very high-dimensional 3D deformations. Our code, which we call BINDER (Bayesian INference for DEformable Registration), is freely available at https://github.com/ste93ste/BINDER.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于互信息准则的概率医学图像配准模型BINDER，通过潜在体素级对应关系实现闭式迭代优化与MCMC采样，在单模态和多模态非线性配准中表现稳健，并首次实现高维3D形变下的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: 通用医学图像配准，尤其是多模态场景下，缺乏能同时提供高效优化与不确定性量化的概率框架。
AI.method: 以互信息配准准则为基础构建概率模型，引入假设潜在体素级对应关系的空间插值技术，利用这些隐变量推导仅含闭式迭代更新的优化和MCMC采样方法；应用于非线性配准时得到类似demons的高效优化算法，并给出对应采样器。
AI.result: 在多种单模态和多模态配准任务中展现稳健的即开即用性能；采样器首次实现含极高维3D形变的多模态配准不确定性量化。
AI.conclusion: BINDER为可形变配准提供了统一的贝叶斯推断框架，兼具高效优化与不确定性量化能力，代码已开源。

title: SlugTrails: An Egocentric Benchmark for Floor Plan Localization in Large Buildings
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Preprint. Code and data: https://github.com/Head-inthe-Cloud/SlugTrails
summary: Floor-plan-based indoor visual localization enables infrastructure-free positioning, but most methods are developed and evaluated in small residential environments unlike the large public buildings of real deployment. We introduce SlugTrails, a floor plan localization benchmark for large indoor spaces under realistic egocentric sensing: $30$ Hz Aria glasses recordings across three campus buildings and six floors ($22089$ m$^2$ of floor plan outline), CAD-derived floor plans with semantic classes and circulation space masks, and trajectories aligned into the floor plan frame using laser-surveyed anchors. One protocol covers three practical ways of gathering geometry under a limited field of view -- a single walking frame, a stationary multi-view sweep, and a walking stream with odometry -- so methods designed for different regimes are compared on the same buildings and ground truth. Evaluating five representative geometric and learned systems under their native sensing configurations, we find that stock checkpoints (official released weights) are near zero on SlugTrails (at most $0.004$ R@1m30$^{\circ}$ on walking single frames), while fine-tuning on SlugTrails improves every trainable family on all three tasks (e.g., F$^3$Loc $0.0 \rightarrow 0.141$ single-frame and $0.03 \rightarrow 0.66$ sequential), with gains compounding as observations accumulate. The same fine-tuned weights also improve cross-dataset generalization on LaMAR with no LaMAR training (sequential R@1m $0.048 \rightarrow 0.143$ for F$^3$Loc and $0.063 \rightarrow 0.127$ for UnLoc), whereas train-from-scratch on SlugTrails alone stays far below fine-tuning from stock weights -- evidence that floor plan localization is currently limited by indoor data rather than by architecture. We release the dataset, protocols, and tools at https://github.com/Head-inthe-Cloud/SlugTrails.

AI.tldr: 该文提出SlugTrails——面向大型公共建筑、基于楼层平面图的室内视觉定位基准，包含三栋校园建筑六层（22089 m²）的30 Hz Aria眼镜自中心记录、带语义类别与通行空间掩码的CAD平面图及激光锚点对齐轨迹，并给出三种几何获取协议。评测表明现成模型近乎失效，微调后各方法在三任务上全面提升并改善跨数据集泛化，说明当前瓶颈在室内数据而非架构。
AI.motivation: 室内视觉定位中的平面图方法可免基础设施，但现有方法与评测多局限于小型住宅环境，与真实部署中的大型公共建筑差距显著。
AI.method: 构建SlugTrails：三栋校园建筑、六层、22089 m²平面图轮廓的30 Hz Aria眼镜自中心记录；CAD平面图带语义类别与circulation space掩码；轨迹借助laser-surveyed anchors对齐至平面图坐标系。设计三种采集几何的协议：单帧行走（single walking frame）、静止多视角扫描（stationary multi-view sweep）、带里程计的行走流（walking stream with odometry），在同一建筑与真值下对比五类几何与学习方法。
AI.result: 现成checkpoints近乎失效（single frame最高仅0.004 R@1m30°）；在SlugTrails上微调后所有可训练方法在三任务上提升，如F³Loc从0.0→0.141（单帧）、0.03→0.66（序列），随观测累积增益叠加。微调权重零LaMAR训练下改善跨数据集泛化（F³Loc 0.048→0.143，UnLoc 0.063→0.127）；而仅用SlugTrails从头训练远低于从现成权重微调。
AI.conclusion: 当前平面图定位的瓶颈主要在于室内数据而非模型架构；数据集、协议与工具已开源。

title: JustMem: Just-Enough Memory Access for Long-Term Conversations
summary: Efficient long-term conversational memory requires retrieving sufficient evidence without indiscriminately expanding the context presented to the language model. This is challenging because relevant evidence may be distributed across multiple sessions, while compression may discard details needed for answering. Different queries therefore require different forms of memory access. To capture these demands, we formulate memory access along two dimensions: discovery breadth, which controls how broadly evidence is searched, and reading fidelity, which controls whether evidence is read in compact form or recovered from the original conversation. Based on this formulation, we introduce JustMem, which stores conversation history as compact atomic memories and adapts memory access along these two dimensions to each query. Specifically, LOOKUP handles local evidence, COMPOSE broadens discovery for distributed evidence, and REPLAY increases reading fidelity for fidelity-sensitive evidence. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, JustMem achieves the highest mean accuracy and retrieval recall among the compared memory systems while using substantially fewer generative-model tokens for memory construction and inference.

AI.tldr: 提出JustMem，从发现广度与阅读保真度两个维度自适应地访问对话记忆，在长时对话任务上兼顾准确率与效率。
AI.motivation: 高效的长时对话记忆需要检索充分证据，但不能无差别地扩大上下文。难点在于：相关证据可能分散在多个会话中，而压缩又可能丢失回答所需的细节；不同查询因此需要不同形式的记忆访问方式。
AI.method: 将记忆访问形式化为两个维度：发现广度（控制证据搜索范围）与阅读保真度（控制以压缩形式读取还是从原始对话中恢复证据）。据此提出JustMem：将对话历史存为紧凑的原子记忆，并按查询自适应地沿两个维度访问。具体含三种模式：LOOKUP处理局部证据，COMPOSE为分散证据扩大发现范围，REPLAY为保真敏感证据提高阅读保真度。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo与LongMemEval-S上，JustMem在对比的记忆系统中取得最高的平均准确率和检索召回率，同时用于记忆构建与推理的生成模型token消耗显著更少。
AI.conclusion: 通过将记忆访问解耦为发现广度与阅读保真度并自适应选择访问策略，可在不牺牲证据充分性的前提下避免上下文膨胀，兼顾效果与效率。

title: Uni-LaDiR: Latent Diffusion Unifies Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multimodal models increasingly think with different modalities such as images, 3D point clouds, and robot states, not just text. Yet each modality is still encoded into its own representation space, creating a modality-switching gap whenever reasoning moves from one modality to another. In this paper, we introduce Uni-LaDiR (Unified Latent Diffusion Reasoner), a framework that unifies different modalities into a shared latent space for multimodal reasoning. A unified encoder maps teacher reasoning steps from different modalities into latent thought tokens in a shared space, trained to extract the information needed for later reasoning steps and the final output. A diffusion reasoner, trained jointly with the encoder, generates these tokens at inference without teacher reasoning steps. Across eleven vision-language model (VLM) benchmarks and two vision-language-action (VLA) suites, Uni-LaDiR achieves relative gains over the strongest baselines of 7.3% on four mathematical and logical VLM benchmarks and 6.1% on RLBench manipulation tasks. Controlled comparisons show increasing gains as more teacher modalities are unified. These results suggest that unification improves multimodal reasoning by weaving it into a single thread, where the model predicts successive thoughts in a common representation space.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Uni-LaDiR，将图像、3D 点云、机器人状态等不同模态统一映射到共享隐空间，用扩散推理器在该空间中生成"思维 token"完成多模态推理，在 11 个 VLM 基准与 2 个 VLA 套件上均优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态模型虽已能跨模态推理，但每种模态仍被编码在各自独立的表示空间中，导致推理从一个模态切换到另一个模态时出现"模态切换鸿沟"，限制了跨模态推理的信息传递效率。
AI.method: 提出 Uni-LaDiR（统一隐扩散推理器）：1）统一编码器把来自不同模态的教师推理步骤映射为共享隐空间中的隐式思维 token，训练目标是提取后续推理步骤与最终输出所需的信息；2）扩散推理器与编码器联合训练，在推理阶段无需教师推理步骤即可直接生成这些思维 token。
AI.result: 在 11 个 VLM 基准和 2 个 VLA 套件上验证：相较最强基线，4 个数学与逻辑类 VLM 基准上取得 7.3% 的相对提升，RLBench 操作任务上取得 6.1% 的相对提升；控制实验表明，统一融合的教师模态越多，性能增益越大。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明，将多模态推理"编织成一条单线程"——模型在统一表示空间中连续预测后续思维——能够有效提升多模态推理能力，模态统一是性能提升的关键因素。

title: VākQA: A Benchmark and Evaluation Study for Telugu Spoken Factoid Question Answering
comment: Paper is accepted in IEEE SLT 2026
summary: Question answering has advanced rapidly with large language models, but predominantly for high-resource languages, in both text and spoken settings. Spoken question answering (SQA) benchmark for Telugu remains unexplored, and the reliability of automatic evaluation in this setting remains unquantified. We introduce VākQA, a Telugu SQA benchmark of 2,001 factoid question-answer pairs across six domains, with 2.53 hours of speech audio, bilingual transcriptions, and human-verified reference answers. We first validate evaluation methods against human judgements: Gemini-as-a-judge best approximates human ratings but is non-uniformly strict, while open-weight judges systematically penalize correct Telugu answers that differ in surface form from the reference. Using this validated setup, we benchmark proprietary and open-weight models across input modality, language, and domain. We observe that Telugu phrasing retains cultural specificity that is lost in translation, speech input introduces phonetic confusions that alter question meaning, and cascaded ASR-MT errors compound progressively. VākQA is publicly released.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了 VākQA——一个包含2001条事实型问答对、2.53小时语音、双语转写及人工核验参考答案的泰卢固语口语问答基准，并系统评估了自动评价方法的可靠性及多模态模型表现。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型问答研究集中于高资源语言（文本与语音场景），泰卢固语等低资源语言的口语问答（SQA）基准缺失，且该场景下自动评估方法的可靠性尚未被量化。
AI.method: 构建 VākQA 基准（六领域、2001条事实型问答对、2.53小时语音、双语转写、人工核验参考答案）；先以人工评分验证多种自动评估方法（LLM-as-a-judge），再在输入模态、语言、领域三个维度上对闭源与开源模型进行基准测试。
AI.result: Gemini-as-a-judge 最接近人工评分，但严格程度不一致；开源评判模型会系统性惩罚与参考答案表面形式不同但正确的泰卢固语回答。基准测试显示：泰卢固语表述保留了翻译中丢失的文化特异性，语音输入引入改变问题含义的语音混淆，级联 ASR-MT 误差会逐级累积。
AI.conclusion: VākQA 填补了泰卢固语口语问答基准的空白，揭示了自动评估在低资源 SQA 场景下的偏差，并公开释放数据集以支持后续研究。

title: D-Quant: Driftable Entropy Coding for KV Cache Quantization
summary: The KV cache has become a major bottleneck in deploying LLMs, as its memory footprint grows linearly with sequence length and batch size, imposing substantial pressure on both memory capacity and bandwidth. Among various KV cache compression techniques, quantization is particularly attractive due to its effectiveness and ease of deployment. However, most existing methods rely on fixed-width quantization, where a $b$ bit representation is inherently limited to $2^b$ quantization levels. As the bit width decreases, the number of available levels shrinks exponentially, leading to severe information loss and rapid performance degradation. We further observe that fixed-width quantization fails to exploit the highly non-uniform distribution of KV cache. After rotation and normalization, KV values approximately follow a normal distribution, with most values concentrated near the center and only a small fraction appearing in the tails. Nevertheless, fixed-width coding allocates the same number of bits to frequent and rare symbols. Entropy coding naturally exploits such non-uniformity by assigning shorter codewords to frequent symbols and longer ones to rare symbols, substantially reducing the average number of bits required for representation. However, its variable-length output is not suited to highly parallel attention kernels, where efficient dequantization and computation rely on regular memory layouts and fixed-stride accesses. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{D-Quant}, a flexible KV cache quantization framework that introduces a \textbf{drift} mechanism to convert entropy-coded representations of each token into fixed-size bitstreams, enabling regular memory access and parallel dequantization within attention kernels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 D-Quant，一种灵活的 KV cache 量化框架，通过 "drift" 机制将每个 token 的熵编码表示转换为固定大小的比特流，兼顾熵编码的高压缩率与注意力核的规整并行访问。
AI.motivation: KV cache 显存占用随序列长度和批大小线性增长，成为 LLM 部署的主要瓶颈。量化因有效且易部署而受到关注，但现有方法多采用固定位宽量化：b 位最多只有 2^b 个量化级，位宽下降时量化级指数级减少，造成严重信息损失与性能骤降。同时，旋转与归一化后 KV 值近似服从正态分布，高度非均匀（多数值集中于中心，少数位于尾部），而固定位宽对频繁与稀疏符号分配相同比特，无法利用该非均匀性。熵编码可缓解此问题，但其变长输出与高并行注意力核所需的规整内存布局、固定步长访问不兼容。
AI.method: 提出 D-Quant——灵活的 KV cache 量化框架，引入 drift 机制，将每个 token 的熵编码表示转换为固定大小的比特流，从而在注意力核内实现规整的内存访问与并行反量化。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，主要结果为：D-Quant 在保持注意力核规整并行访问的同时，利用 KV cache 分布的非均匀性降低平均表示比特数，缓解固定位宽在低位宽下的性能退化问题。
AI.conclusion: D-Quant 通过 drift 机制弥合了熵编码的高压缩潜力与注意力核并行规整访问需求之间的鸿沟，为 KV cache 量化提供了一种兼顾压缩率与部署效率的灵活方案。

title: BinoGen: Scaling egocentric binocular data for embodied visual perception and learning
summary: Embodied visual perception relies on temporally coherent visual experience accumulated through continuous engagement with the environment. However, collecting large-scale egocentric binocular observations together with dense annotations remains costly and difficult. Moreover, visual experience is shaped not only by the environment but also by the embodiment of the observer, including viewing height, field of view, binocular geometry, and motion through the scene. To address these challenges, we present BinoGen, an automated framework for generating large-scale, embodiment-aware egocentric binocular visual experiences in indoor environments. BinoGen jointly models environmental and observer variation through generative scene synthesis, probabilistic object instantiation, appearance randomization, stochastic trajectory generation, and configurable binocular camera setups. The framework produces synchronized binocular videos together with dense multimodal supervision, including depth maps, optical flow, surface normals, semantic maps, object coordinates, and camera poses. Using BinoGen, we construct a dataset comprising more than 20 million annotated images for supervised learning. We demonstrate two complementary utilities of BinoGen. First, incorporating BinoGen data consistently improves real-world visual perception, including depth estimation, object detection, and video object tracking. Second, paired human-inspired and mouse-inspired observations from the same environments enable controlled investigation of how observer embodiment affects perceptual learning. Embodiment-specific adaptation substantially improves performance, while joint training enables a single model to perform competitively across both embodiments. Together, these results demonstrate that large-scale, controllable visual experience can improve embodied perception...

AI.tldr: BinoGen：自动化生成大规模、具身自适应的第一人称双目视觉经验框架，产出2000万+标注图像数据集，可提升真实世界视觉感知并支持具身差异的受控研究。
AI.motivation: 具身视觉感知依赖与环境持续交互所积累的时序连贯视觉经验，但大规模第一人称双目观测及密集标注的采集成本高、难度大；同时，视觉经验不仅受环境影响，还受观察者具身属性（观察高度、视场角、双目几何、运动方式等）塑造，现有数据难以覆盖这些变化。
AI.method: BinoGen 联合建模环境变异与观察者变异，通过生成式场景合成、概率化物体实例化、外观随机化、随机轨迹生成以及可配置双目相机设置，自动产出同步双目视频，并提供密集多模态监督（深度图、光流、表面法线、语义图、物体坐标、相机位姿）。据此构建了包含2000万+标注图像的数据集。
AI.result: 引入 BinoGen 数据可稳定提升真实世界视觉感知性能，涵盖深度估计、目标检测与视频目标跟踪；同时，同一环境下配对的“类人”与“类鼠”观测支持对具身如何影响感知学习的受控研究——具身特定适配显著提升性能，联合训练则使单一模型在两种具身上均具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，大规模、可控的视觉经验能够改善具身感知，BinoGen 兼作数据引擎与具身感知研究平台。

title: PetriBench: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning over Dynamic State Spaces
summary: Characterizing LLM reasoning remains an open challenge, as many existing benchmarks isolate specific reasoning skills, rely on external knowledge, or are costly to extend. We introduce PetriBench, a compact, fully self-contained, and scalable benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning over dynamic state spaces using Petri nets, a mature formalism for modeling real-world concurrent and distributed systems. PetriBench organizes reasoning into four task families varying by scope and temporal horizon, with Easy, Medium, and Hard levels generated by increasing structural complexity and evaluated against exact ground truth. Across a diverse set of proprietary and open-weight models, accuracy decreases consistently with difficulty, while harder instances expose increasingly distinct task-specific capability profiles. Additional analyses show that test-time compute improves performance but interacts differently with different reasoning tasks, and that procedural generation yields smooth scaling with structural complexity. Together, these results show that PetriBench provides a unified and extensible setting for probing the strengths, limits, and scaling behavior of LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: PetriBench：基于Petri网的紧凑、自包含、可扩展基准，用于评估LLM在动态状态空间上的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理基准存在局限：孤立特定推理技能、依赖外部知识、扩展成本高，缺乏统一且可扩展的评估环境。作者希望利用Petri网这一成熟形式化工具建模真实并发与分布式系统，构建能系统探测LLM推理优势、边界与扩展行为的基准。
AI.method: 提出PetriBench基准：基于Petri网建模动态状态空间；按范围与时间跨度划分四类任务族；通过增加结构复杂度生成Easy、Medium、Hard三级难度；以精确真值（exact ground truth）进行评估；程序化生成实现可扩展性；在多种闭源与开源模型上测试，并分析测试时计算量（test-time compute）的影响。
AI.result: 模型准确率随难度提升持续下降；较难实例暴露出日益分化的任务特定能力画像；测试时计算量可提升性能，但与不同推理任务的交互方式各异；程序化生成带来随结构复杂度的平滑扩展。
AI.conclusion: PetriBench提供了一个统一且可扩展的环境，用于探测LLM推理的优势、局限与扩展行为，弥补了现有基准在自包含性、可扩展性与动态状态空间建模上的不足。

title: Evaluating Communicative Success in Machine-Translated Conversation
summary: Interpreter agents built on machine translation (MT) increasingly mediate live conversation between people who do not share a language, yet we still evaluate them with metrics built for isolated sentences, which measure fidelity rather than whether communication succeeds. We introduce a reusable three-layer checklist-and-judge framework that evaluates interpreter-mediated conversation across semantic, pragmatic, and cultural-social dimensions, covering the naturalness, intent, and social appropriateness that fidelity metrics leave unmeasured. It runs in both single-turn and interactive multi-turn settings, where simulated users reply to translated messages as the conversation unfolds and each turn is scored alongside the conversation as a whole. We extensively validate it through controlled perturbations, cross-judge comparisons, and human annotations. Our main single-turn benchmark evaluates 10 interpreter setups across Arabic, Bengali, Indonesian, and Korean from 5,624 OpenSubtitles-derived scenarios spanning 12 translation directions, and our multi-turn study covers all 6 language pairs in scripted and live modes. Results show a consistent decline from semantic to pragmatic and cultural-social success, while conventional MT metrics overlook failures among stronger interpreters, and prompt ablations show that scenario context, structured instructions, and cultural context improve communicative success, although gains vary across setups. Our work thus provides an evaluation framework and benchmark for interpreter agents in conversation, and highlights the importance of communicative success alongside existing translation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个三层（语义、语用、文化-社会）检查表与评判框架，用于评估口译智能体在真实对话中的沟通成功度，覆盖单轮与多轮交互场景。
AI.motivation: 现有基于机器翻译的口译智能体已用于跨语言实时交流，但评估仍沿用面向孤立句子的保真度指标，无法衡量沟通是否真正成功。
AI.method: 构建可复用的三层检查表-评判框架，涵盖自然度、意图与社会得体性；支持单轮与交互式多轮设置（模拟用户随对话推进回复译文，每轮与整体对话分别打分）；通过受控扰动、跨评判者比较与人工标注进行验证。
AI.result: 主单轮基准评估10种口译配置，覆盖阿拉伯语、孟加拉语、印尼语、韩语，基于5,624个OpenSubtitles场景、12个翻译方向；多轮研究覆盖全部6个语言对（脚本与实时模式）。结果显示从语义到语用、文化-社会成功率持续下降；传统MT指标在较强口译者上遗漏失败；消融表明场景上下文、结构化指令与文化语境可提升沟通成功率，但增益因配置而异。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为对话中的口译智能体提供了评估框架与基准，强调在既有翻译指标之外应重视沟通成功度。

title: Generalization through Lexical Abstraction in Transformer Models: The Case of Functional Words
summary: Pronouns, adverbs and other functional words (such as they, her, somewhere, there) are often used in language to replace concrete nouns or phrases, when their properties - such as gender, grammatical number - provide sufficient information for the given context. Do pretrained transformer models encode such functional words in a manner that allows them to be used like humans do? Can language models recognize the syntactic and semantic parallelism of sentences such as "The researchers wrote the paper" and "They wrote it", which relies on such lexical abstraction? We map these linguistic questions into the embedding space of a pretrained transformer model, and compare representations of nouns, with the representations of the pronouns and adverbs that can replace these nouns, in isolation and in parallel lexicalized and functional sentences. We then probe for shared syntactic and semantic structure in the embeddings of parallel lexicalized and functional sentences. We find that functional words are located centrally compared to nouns, but are also distinct, which is congruent with their behaviour as place-holders in a wide variety of contexts. The analysis of the embeddings of parallel (lexicalized and functional) sentences show them inhabiting different subspaces of the embedding space. Experiments that distil the structural information of the sentence show that training on either type of data does not reveal the shared structure - because of the over-consistency of the vocabulary (in case of the functional data), and the too much variety (in case of the lexicalized versions). However, training with a mix of functional and lexicalized sentences, the shared structure emerges.

AI.tldr: 该研究将语言学问题映射到预训练Transformer的嵌入空间，考察模型是否以类似人类的方式编码代词等功能词。发现功能词在嵌入空间中位置居中但与名词可区分，与词汇化句子占据不同子空间；单独在任一类数据上训练都无法揭示共享结构（功能句词汇过于同质、词汇化句差异过大），但混合两类数据训练后共享的句法-语义结构得以显现。
AI.motivation: 功能词（代词、副词等）在语言中用于替代具体名词，前提是其属性（性别、语法数）足以支撑语境推断。作者关心预训练Transformer是否以类似人类的方式编码这类功能词，以及语言模型能否识别如"The researchers wrote the paper"与"They wrote it"之间的句法与语义平行性，这种平行依赖词汇抽象能力。
AI.method: 将上述语言学问题映射到预训练Transformer的嵌入空间；比较名词的表示与可替代该名词的代词、副词在孤立状态以及平行词汇化/功能句中的表示；探测平行词汇化句与功能句嵌入中共享的句法与语义结构；并通过结构信息蒸馏实验，分别用功能句、词汇化句及二者混合数据训练，检验共享结构能否被揭示。
AI.result: 功能词相对名词位于嵌入空间更中心的位置，但同时具有可区分性，这与其作为多语境占位符的行为一致。平行（词汇化与功能化）句子的嵌入表明二者占据嵌入空间的不同子空间。结构信息蒸馏实验显示，仅在单一类型数据上训练无法揭示共享结构：功能句因词汇过于一致（over-consistency），词汇化句因变化过大（too much variety）。而以功能句与词汇化句混合训练时，共享结构得以涌现。
AI.conclusion: 预训练Transformer以居中且可区分的方式编码功能词，功能句与词汇化句在嵌入空间中分属不同子空间。共享的句法-语义结构不能从任一单独类型的数据中习得，只有在功能与词汇化数据混合训练时才会显现，说明两类数据互为补充、共同支撑模型对词汇抽象与句子平行性的表征。

title: GS-PI: An Optimization-Decoupled Appearance Decomposition Approach for Generating PBR Gaussian Assets
summary: Gaussian Splatting (GS) excels at novel-view synthesis but encodes baked-in radiance, tightly entangling illumination with geometry and preventing seamless integration into physically based rendering (PBR) pipelines. Existing inverse-rendering methods attempt to disentangle materials via joint optimization, but often suffer from competing objectives that cause severe ambiguities and residual lighting artifacts. To overcome this, we present GS-PI, a novel optimization-decoupled framework that casts PBR material generation as a geometry-conditioned diffusion process on 3D point clouds. By operating directly in the 3D domain, our method inherently guarantees multi-view consistency, sidestepping the severe pixel correspondence issues that challenge 2D diffusion approaches. We introduce a multi-scale cross-view conditioning mechanism that integrates three complementary components: a global semantic prior, source-anchored photometric cues, and an absolute spatial learned view-direction conditioning signal. This design efficiently compresses complex multi-view evidence, mitigating cross-view projection misalignment and successfully preventing specular highlights from baking into intrinsic colors. By extracting a point cloud from a pre-trained Gaussian model, predicting PBR attributes via conditional diffusion, and distilling them back through differentiable rasterisation, we yield a fully relightable PBR-GS asset. GS-PI outperforms recent inverse-rendering baselines while replacing per-scene joint illumination/BRDF optimization with a learned diffusion pass followed by a short target-driven distillation, without requiring proxy meshes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GS-PI，一个优化解耦的框架，将PBR材质生成建模为3D点云上的几何条件扩散过程，实现多视图一致的、无需代理网格的完全可重光照PBR-GS资产。
AI.motivation: Gaussian Splatting虽擅长新视图合成，但其编码的是烘焙辐射，将光照与几何紧密耦合，无法无缝集成到基于物理的渲染（PBR）管线中。现有逆渲染方法通过联合优化解耦材质，但常因目标冲突导致严重歧义和残余光照伪影。
AI.method: 提出GS-PI优化解耦框架：从预训练高斯模型提取点云；直接在3D域上以几何条件扩散预测PBR属性，天然保证多视图一致性，规避2D扩散的像素对应问题。引入多尺度跨视图条件机制，融合全局语义先验、源锚定光度线索和绝对空间学习视图方向条件信号，压缩多视图证据，缓解跨视图投影错位，防止高光烘焙进本征颜色。最后通过可微光栅化蒸馏回PBR-GS资产。
AI.result: GS-PI优于近期逆渲染基线方法，同时用一次学习式扩散加短时目标驱动蒸馏替代逐场景的联合光照/BRDF优化，且无需代理网格。
AI.conclusion: GS-PI通过优化解耦与3D域扩散，有效解决了逆渲染中的歧义与残余光照问题，实现多视图一致、无需代理网格的完全可重光照PBR-GS资产，性能超越现有基线。

title: CitySTAR: Structured and Topology-Aware Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Urban 3D Grounding
summary: 3D grounding aims to localize target entities in complex scenes from natural language and plays a fundamental role in embodied perception and spatial reasoning. However, existing approaches mostly rely on feature similarity or direct matching, making it difficult to connect natural-language intent with the implicit semantic and geometric structures hidden in billion-scale urban point clouds. We reformulate city-scale 3D grounding as structured constraint reasoning, where description semantics are organized into computable cross-modal constraints over open-vocabulary 3D entities, attributes, and spatial relations. We present CitySTAR, a training-free framework for reasoning-driven urban 3D grounding. CitySTAR lifts raw billion-scale urban point clouds into a query-ready scene graph of open-vocabulary 3D instances, with CodeLLM-driven tools supplying multimodal evidence for node attributes and 3D spatial relations. It then models target-context topology with paired hypergraphs and performs bidirectional topology verification for structural disambiguation. Finally, a Reflective Cross-modal Grounding module integrates topology consistency and candidate-centered 2D visual evidence to make decisions over a metric-aware 3D context graph. To further support this setting, we introduce CitySTAR-3D, an enhanced benchmark that improves semantic coverage, instance completeness, bounding-box fidelity, and spatial-relation complexity in city-scale 3D grounding. Extensive experiments show that CitySTAR consistently improves open-world urban 3D grounding while maintaining strong interpretability and generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CitySTAR，一个免训练的推理驱动城市3D定位框架，将城市级3D定位重构为结构化约束推理，并发布增强基准CitySTAR-3D。
AI.motivation: 现有3D定位方法多依赖特征相似度或直接匹配，难以将自然语言意图与十亿级城市点云中隐含的语义和几何结构有效关联。
AI.method: CitySTAR将原始十亿级城市点云提升为开放词汇3D实例的可查询场景图，由CodeLLM驱动工具为节点属性和3D空间关系提供多模态证据；用成对超图建模目标-上下文拓扑，并进行双向拓扑验证以消解结构歧义；最后通过反思式跨模态定位模块，融合拓扑一致性与候选为中心的2D视觉证据，在度量感知的3D上下文图上决策。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CitySTAR持续提升开放世界城市3D定位性能，并保持较强的可解释性与泛化能力；同时引入的CitySTAR-3D基准在语义覆盖、实例完整性、边界框保真度和空间关系复杂度上均有改进。
AI.conclusion: 将城市级3D定位形式化为结构化约束推理是可行且有效的，免训练框架CitySTAR为开放世界城市3D定位提供了兼具性能、可解释性与泛化性的方案。

title: KoNeoBench: A Curated Evaluation Dataset for LLM Understanding of Korean Neologisms
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code and data are available at the project repository
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are typically evaluated on static benchmarks, even though natural language constantly evolves through newly emerging words and meanings. Existing Korean benchmarks are centered on established vocabulary and therefore provide limited coverage of such recent lexical change, and their English-oriented design makes it difficult to assess the typological properties of Korean, in which content words combine productively with functional morphemes. In this paper, we introduce KoNeoBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs' understanding of Korean neologisms. KoNeoBench is built on 1,785 Korean neologisms attested in online news since 2020 and curated through expert lexicographic review. Each entry provides usage examples, word-formation analyses, and dictionary-style definitions. Based on this resource, we define four tasks and report results on recent models, together with a human baseline. Our experiments show that current LLMs exhibit clear limitations in recovering source components, distinguishing semantic categories, and generating accurate definitions. These results reveal specific aspects of recent Korean lexical change that remain challenging for current LLMs. KoNeoBench is available at https://github.com/bcmilab/ko-neobench/ .

AI.tldr: 本文提出KoNeoBench，一个基于1,785个韩语新词、由专家词汇学审核构建的基准，用于评估大语言模型对韩语新词的理解，涵盖四个任务并报告了近期模型与人类基线的结果。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型通常在静态基准上评估，而自然语言随时间不断演化，新词与新义不断出现。现有韩语基准聚焦既有词汇，对近期词汇变化覆盖不足；且其英语导向设计难以评估韩语的类型学特征，即实词与功能语素的高产组合。
AI.method: 构建KoNeoBench基准：以2020年以来网络新闻中出现的1,785个韩语新词为基础，经专家词汇学审核筛选；每个词条提供用法示例、构词分析和词典式定义。基于该资源定义四个任务，并在近期模型上进行评测，同时设置人类基线。
AI.result: 实验显示，当前大语言模型在还原源构成成分、区分语义类别以及生成准确释义方面存在明显局限，揭示了近期韩语词汇变化中仍具挑战性的具体方面。
AI.conclusion: KoNeoBench填补了韩语新词理解评测的空白，揭示了当前大语言模型在韩语词汇变化理解上的具体不足，为后续研究提供了公开基准资源。

title: DirtyMoCap: Robust Motion Capture from Unconstrained Markers
summary: Optical motion capture delivers high-fidelity human motion, but its reliance on strict marker layouts and clean trajectories severely limits its real-world applicability. In practice, tracking systems frequently output unconstrained markers: sparse, noisy, and unordered point clouds with unknown or varying configurations. To bridge the gap between corrupted raw markers and parametric human models, we introduce DirtyMoCap, a robust, marker-layout-free framework. Our core insight is to map unordered marker observations to a fixed set of "proxy anchors" comprising skeletal joints and body surface points, which serve as a stable intermediate representation. We first initialize and track these anchors over long sequences using a recurrent sliding-window architecture. Then, a custom differentiable Gauss-Newton solver fits the SMPL-H model to the tracked anchors to recover full-body pose, translation, and shape. By explicitly deriving geometric residuals, our solver learns adaptive observation confidence, smoothness, and prior weights end-to-end, adapting dynamically to the reliability of the input data. Extensive experiments on diverse, noisy marker configurations demonstrate that DirtyMoCap successfully generalizes across arbitrary layouts using only a single trained model.
