It consistently outperforms state-of-the-art configuration-specific baselines in both joint and vertex reconstruction accuracy, while our custom CUDA solver achieves up to a 100x speedup over standard PyTorch implementations. We further apply DirtyMoCap to heterogeneous raw optical MoCap recordings of traditional Chinese martial arts, yielding a Kung Fu motion dataset of temporally coherent SMPL-H reconstructions. Code and data are available at https://wanglongzju.github.io/DirtyMoCap-Project-Page.

AI.tldr: DirtyMoCap：一种免标记布局的鲁棒光学动捕框架，通过"代理锚点"中间表示与可微Gauss-Newton求解器，将稀疏、噪声、无序的原始标记点云映射到SMPL-H参数模型，单一模型即可泛化至任意布局。
AI.motivation: 光学动捕虽能提供高保真人体运动，但依赖严格标记布局与干净轨迹，实际系统中常输出稀疏、含噪、无序且配置未知/多变的标记点云，导致原始标记与参数化人体模型之间存在鸿沟，现有方法多为针对特定配置的专用方案，泛化性差。
AI.method: 核心思想是将无序标记观测映射到固定集合的"代理锚点"（由骨骼关节与体表点构成），作为稳定中间表示。先用循环滑动窗口架构对锚点进行长序列初始化与跟踪；再用自定义可微Gauss-Newton求解器将SMPL-H模型拟合到跟踪锚点，恢复全身姿态、平移与体型。通过显式推导几何残差，求解器端到端学习自适应观测置信度、平滑项与先验权重，动态适应输入可靠性。
AI.result: 在多样噪声标记配置上的实验表明，仅用单一训练模型即可跨任意布局泛化，并在关节点与顶点重建精度上持续优于配置特定的SOTA基线；自定义CUDA求解器相较标准PyTorch实现最高达100倍加速。进一步应用于异构原始光学动捕的中国传统武术录像，构建了时间连贯的SMPL-H功夫运动数据集。
AI.conclusion: DirtyMoCap证明了通过代理锚点桥接无序标记与参数化人体模型的可行性，实现了免布局、鲁棒的动捕重建，兼顾精度与效率，并具备向真实异构动捕数据迁移的实用价值。代码与数据已开源。

title: Intrinsic Sequence-Likelihood Confidence in Retrieval-Dominated Extractive QA: Two Pre-Specified Negatives, and What They Do and Do Not Attribute
comment: v2: corrected author name spelling; removed co-author e-mail addresses; added acknowledgment. 26 pages main text + 26 pages supplementary (Online Resource 3). Submitted to Applied Intelligence. Code and data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.22710121, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22721044
summary: In extractive document question answering whose questions were generated from the passages that contain their answers -- so that retrieval recovers 92-99.8% of what any mode combination could reach, whatever its absolute accuracy -- confidence-driven mechanisms have little to gain. Fine-tuning an open language model on a specialized domain corpus yields a model whose own confidence is a tempting control signal: it could decide which queries warrant further adaptation, and which answers to trust. We evaluate both uses under criteria fixed before the runs were executed, across four 7-9B model families whose adaptation moved closed-book F1 by at most +0.03, and both fail: a distillation trigger on all four families, under its pre-specified three-step transfer budget, and a routing-and-abstention policy in its single-model pilot. Retrieval alone recovers 92-99.8% of best-case combined accuracy under every correctness criterion we test, leaving routers no meaningful gain. The sequence-likelihood signal is insufficient relative to that mode -- area under the receiver operating characteristic curve 0.65-0.81 under the registered criterion -- before adaptation as well as after, unchanged by scalar recalibration and not consistently improved by token-level temperature rescaling. And the finer diagnostics depend on the correctness criterion and on answer length; on the three adapted combinations where we could test it, selector ablations show no statistically detectable downstream benefit from the confidence term on any seed; on Gemma, removing it changes the selector from failing to passing both registered criteria. The usable product is a set of pre-specified negatives with their dependencies made explicit.

AI.tldr: 在抽取式文档问答中，检索已恢复92-99.8%的最佳组合准确率，置信度驱动的蒸馏触发、路由与弃答机制在四个7-9B模型家族上均未带来有意义的增益，序列似然信号（AUC 0.65-0.81）不足，且选择器消融显示置信度项无统计可检测的下游收益。
AI.motivation: 微调开放语言模型得到的置信度是诱人的控制信号，可用于决定哪些查询需要进一步适配、哪些答案可信。作者希望检验这一假设：在检索已高度饱和的抽取式文档问答设定下，置信度信号是否还能带来增益。
AI.method: 在四个7-9B模型家族上进行实验，适配后闭卷F1变化不超过+0.03。采用预先固定（注册）的评估标准，测试两类用途：一是蒸馏触发（三步迁移预算），二是路由与弃答策略（单模型试点）。使用序列似然作为置信度信号，进行标量重校准与token级温度重缩放，并做选择器消融实验。
AI.result: 两类用途均失败。检索在每种正确性标准下恢复92-99.8%的最佳组合准确率，路由无实质增益。序列似然AUC为0.65-0.81，适配前后无变化，标量重校准无效，token级温度重缩放未稳定改善。选择器消融在三个可测组合的任何随机种子上均无统计可检测收益；在Gemma上移除置信度项反而使选择器从失败转为通过两项注册标准。
AI.conclusion: 本文将结果作为一套预先设定的负面结论呈现，并明确其依赖条件：在检索饱和的抽取式文档问答中，基于序列似然的置信度信号不足以支撑蒸馏触发、路由与弃答等决策。

title: LapaTrack-3D: 6 DoF pre-operative shape tracking for laparoscopic surgery
comment: This paper has been accepted by IEEE Transactions on Medical Robotics and Bionics (T-MRB)
summary: This work proposes a real-time 6 Degree-of-Freedom (6 DoF) tracking algorithm for monocular laparoscopic surgery. It provides alignment between intra-operative video and pre-operative data (e.g., CT). The 6 DoF tracking offers a solution for accurately locating the internal anatomy of the target organ despite the lack of tactile feedback and transparency. The ORB-SLAM2 framework is adopted and modified for prior-based 3D tracking with four major modifications. First, the primitive 3D shape is used for fast initialization of the ORB-SLAM2 monocular mode. Second, a pseudo-segmentation strategy is employed to separate the target organ from the background for tracking. Third, the 3D shape is incorporated as a geometric prior in its pose graph optimization. Fourth, the Multi-Scale Retinex with Chromaticity Preservation (MSRCP) algorithm is leveraged and modified for image enhancement in challenging illumination scenarios. In-vivo and ex-vivo experiments validate that LapaTrack-3D provides robust 3D tracking and effectively handles typical challenges such as poor illumination, fast motion, out-of-field-of-view scenarios, partial visibility, and ``organ-background'' relative motion. LapaTrack-3D achieves a processing rate of 13 Hz for 1280*720 pixel video.

AI.tldr: 提出LapaTrack-3D，一种面向单目腹腔镜手术的实时6自由度跟踪算法，通过四项改进的ORB-SLAM2实现术中视频与术前数据对齐，处理速率达13 Hz。
AI.motivation: 腹腔镜手术缺乏触觉反馈且器官透明，难以准确定位目标器官内部解剖结构，需要将术中视频与术前数据（如CT）对齐的6 DoF跟踪方案。
AI.method: 基于ORB-SLAM2框架进行先验式3D跟踪改造，包含四项改进：(1)利用原始3D形状快速初始化单目模式；(2)采用伪分割策略将目标器官与背景分离；(3)在位姿图优化中引入3D形状作为几何先验；(4)改进MSRCP算法用于恶劣光照下的图像增强。
AI.result: 在体（in-vivo）与离体（ex-vivo）实验验证其鲁棒3D跟踪能力，可处理光照差、快速运动、视野外、部分可见及"器官-背景"相对运动等典型挑战；对1280×720像素视频处理速率达13 Hz。
AI.conclusion: LapaTrack-3D为单目腹腔镜手术提供了实时且鲁棒的6 DoF跟踪方案，有效应对腹腔镜场景下的多种典型困难。

title: Enhanced Knowledge Distillation for Detection Transformer via Teacher Prediction Refinement
summary: Detection Transformers (DETRs) achieve strong performance in object detection but remain challenging to deploy on edge devices due to their high computational cost. Existing DETR distillation methods mainly focus on aligning distillation points, while largely overlooking the quality of the teacher's supervision itself. We observe that due to stage-wise non-monotonic prediction behavior in DETRs, well-localized or correctly classified predictions from earlier stages may degrade in later ones, and some negative predictions become increasingly overconfident. As a result, relying solely on the current stage's predictions yields inaccurate and inconsistent supervision. To address this issue, we propose Teacher Prediction Refinement Distillation (TPRD), a plug-and-play module that refines teacher predictions before distillation by exploiting stage-wise prediction information. TPRD improves supervision quality through Positive Prediction Correction (PPC), which corrects degraded positive predictions by restoring more accurate ones from earlier stages, ensuring reliable localization and classification signals, and Negative Prediction Suppression (NPS) suppresses the influence of overconfident negatives, preventing them from providing misleading supervision to the student. To preserve informative dark knowledge, we further introduce Maximum Dark Knowledge Preservation (MDKP), which selectively refines target-class logits while retaining non-target relations. Extensive experiments on MS COCO and PASCAL VOC demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method. Our code is available at https://github.com/xingyitong1/TPRD.

AI.tldr: 提出TPRD，通过利用教师模型各阶段预测信息在蒸馏前精炼教师预测，提升DETR蒸馏监督质量。
AI.motivation: DETR计算开销大，难以部署在边缘设备；现有DETR蒸馏方法主要关注对齐蒸馏点，却忽视了教师监督本身的质量。由于DETR存在阶段性的非单调预测行为，早期阶段定位准确或分类正确的预测在后期可能退化，部分负样本预测还会变得过度自信，因此仅依赖当前阶段的预测会产生不准确且不一致的监督。
AI.method: 提出即插即用的教师预测精炼蒸馏模块TPRD，在蒸馏前利用各阶段预测信息精炼教师预测。包含三部分：(1) 正预测校正PPC，从早期阶段恢复更准确的正预测，修正退化的正预测，保证可靠的定位与分类信号；(2) 负预测抑制NPS，抑制过度自信负样本的影响，避免其提供误导性监督；(3) 最大暗知识保留MDKP，选择性精炼目标类logit，同时保留非目标类关系以维持暗知识。
AI.result: 在MS COCO和PASCAL VOC上进行大量实验，验证了所提方法的有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TPRD作为即插即用模块，通过精炼教师预测提升了DETR蒸馏的监督质量，为边缘设备上高效部署DETR提供了有效方案。

title: Before the Arrest: Benchmarking LLMs on Criminal Profiling from Incomplete Evidence
comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 Findings. Codes are available at: https://github.com/NLP2CT/PIJ-benchmark
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to legal and criminal justice tasks, yet existing work focuses almost exclusively on post-arrest scenarios where the suspect's identity is already known, leaving the critical pre-arrest challenge of inferring suspect characteristics from incomplete evidence largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce the Profiling, Investigation, and Judgment (PIJ), comprising 2,500 real homicide cases from five countries. PIJ evaluates LLMs across three tasks that span the entire criminal investigation pipeline: criminal profiling, which requires abductive reasoning to infer suspect attributes from fragmentary scene evidence, crime process reconstruction, which tests structured information extraction, and sentence prediction, which demands legal deductive reasoning. We evaluate 9 powerful LLMs and find that performance degrades systematically as tasks shift from explicit fact extraction to implicit reasoning over unknown suspect profiles. Categories requiring inferential reasoning, such as motivation and victim-offender relationships, remain the primary bottlenecks. Further analysis reveals substantial gaps between LLMs and human experts, along with pervasive biases in gender, age, and motive attribution. Our findings indicate that pre-arrest inference from incomplete evidence remains an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PIJ基准，包含五国2500个真实凶杀案件，评估LLM在犯罪画像、犯罪过程重建和量刑预测三类任务上的前逮捕阶段推理能力，发现随任务从显式事实抽取转向隐式推理，性能系统性下降，动机与受害者-罪犯关系等推理类别是主要瓶颈，并存在性别、年龄、动机归因偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在法律与刑事司法任务的研究几乎集中于嫌疑人身份已知的逮捕后场景，而从碎片化证据推断嫌疑人特征的前逮捕阶段挑战被严重忽视，亟需填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建PIJ（Profiling, Investigation, and Judgment）基准，汇集五国2500个真实凶杀案件，覆盖刑事调查全流程的三个任务：需溯因推理的犯罪画像（从碎片化现场证据推断嫌疑人属性）、检验结构化信息抽取的犯罪过程重建、以及要求法律演绎推理的量刑预测；对9个强LLM进行系统评测，并分析其与人类专家的差距及归因偏差。
AI.result: 随着任务从显式事实抽取转向对未知嫌疑人画像的隐式推理，模型性能系统性下降；动机、受害者-罪犯关系等推理类别成为主要瓶颈；LLM与人类专家存在显著差距，且在性别、年龄和动机归因上存在普遍偏差。
AI.conclusion: 基于不完整证据的前逮捕推理仍是LLM尚未解决的开放挑战。

title: Beyond the Foreground: FOV-Aware Polyp Image Synthesis via Lesion-Guided Adaptive Mucosal Context Propagation
summary: Synthetic image and mask pairs can alleviate scarce colonoscopy annotations, but realistic synthesis requires preserving the supplied lesion while generating compatible mucosa. Existing foreground-guided methods treat all non-foreground pixels as background and rely mainly on local integration. Directly applying them to colonoscopy causes two problems: non-mucosal black regions contaminate generated tissue, and local reasoning produces inconsistent mucosal texture and illumination. We propose LAMP, the first foreground-guided framework for polyp image synthesis based on lesion-guided adaptive mucosal context propagation. LAMP explicitly separates the lesion, valid mucosa, and camera exterior using a field-of-view (FOV) mask. Lesion-to-Mucosa cross-attention extracts lesion appearance conditions for valid-mucosa locations, while FOV-constrained multidirectional Vision Receptance Weighted Key Value propagates them over legal tissue support. An adaptive gate then controls their residual fusion into the diffusion U-Net. Extensive experiments on five polyp datasets demonstrate that LAMP substantially outperforms existing methods in overall generation quality and consistently improves five downstream segmentation models. Our code will be released at https://github.com/wangtong627/LAMP.

AI.tldr: 提出LAMP——首个基于病灶引导自适应黏膜上下文传播的前景引导框架，用于息肉图像合成，解决黑边污染与局部融合不一致问题，在五个数据集上生成质量领先并提升下游分割。
AI.motivation: 结肠镜标注稀缺，合成图像-掩码对可缓解；但真实合成需在生成相容黏膜的同时保留给定病灶。现有前景引导方法将所有非前景像素视为背景、依赖局部融合，直接用于结肠镜会产生两个问题：非黏膜黑色区域污染生成组织，局部推理导致黏膜纹理与光照不一致。
AI.method: LAMP 显式区分病灶、有效黏膜与相机外部区域，使用视野（FOV）掩码。通过 Lesion-to-Mucosa 交叉注意力从病灶外观提取条件，注入有效黏膜位置；采用 FOV 约束的多方向 Vision Receptance Weighted Key Value（视觉接收加权键值）在合法组织支撑上传播；再用自适应门控将其残差融合进扩散 U-Net。
AI.result: 在五个息肉数据集上的大量实验表明，LAMP 在整体生成质量上显著优于现有方法，并持续提升五个下游分割模型。
AI.conclusion: LAMP 通过FOV感知的区域解耦与多方向上下文传播，实现更真实的息肉合成，验证其作为数据增强手段对下游分割任务的有效性。代码将开源。

title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
summary: The widespread adoption of long-horizon agents has made model workloads increasingly input-heavy. Although prior work has substantially reduced the cost of long-context computation, prefill remains computationally expensive, and large KV caches continue to strain HBM and SSD capacity and data-transfer bandwidth. Together, these compute, storage, and bandwidth demands constitute the primary bottleneck to further lowering deployment costs. To address this challenge, we introduce DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B backbone parameters and support for contexts of up to one million tokens. With its Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) architecture, the model activates 16B parameters per token during decode but only 8B parameters during prefill, substantially improving cost efficiency for agentic workloads. To push the limits of KV cache compression, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash combines cross-layer KV cache reuse in Compressed Sparse Attention 2 (CSA2) with FP4 KV caching. These designs reduce its global KV cache footprint (always in HBM) to 890 bytes per token, roughly 1/4 of the corresponding footprint of DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Further, through a dedicated deployment optimization known as SWA Bounded Replay, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reduces its persistent KV cache footprint (always on SSD or in host memory) to roughly 1/8 of that of DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Despite its much smaller KV cache footprint, the model delivers substantially better performance than the baseline. In addition, we streamline the DeepSeek-V4 architecture and introduce several efficient architectural extensions. We pretrain DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on a multimodal corpus comprising 45T tokens and conduct comprehensive post-training, yielding strong performance across diverse text-based and multimodal agentic scenarios. Model checkpoints are available at https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.

AI.tldr: 提出 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 多模态 MoE 模型（552B 主干参数、支持百万 token 上下文），通过 CED 架构、CSA2 跨层 KV 复用与 FP4 KV 缓存，以及 SWA Bounded Replay 部署优化，大幅压缩 KV 缓存占用并提升 agentic 场景性能。
AI.motivation: 长时程 agent 使模型负载日益偏重输入，长上下文计算成本虽已降低，但 prefill 计算昂贵，且大 KV 缓存持续压迫 HBM、SSD 容量与数据传输带宽，构成进一步降低部署成本的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出多模态 MoE 模型 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash：采用 Causal Encoder-Decoder（CED）架构，使 decode 每 token 激活 16B、prefill 仅激活 8B 参数；结合 Compressed Sparse Attention 2（CSA2）的跨层 KV 缓存复用与 FP4 KV 缓存；并引入 SWA Bounded Replay 部署优化；同时精简 DeepSeek-V4 架构并加入多项高效扩展。
AI.result: 全局 KV 缓存（常驻 HBM）降至每 token 890 字节，约为 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 的 1/4；持久化 KV 缓存（常驻 SSD 或主机内存）约为其 1/8；尽管缓存占用显著更小，性能仍大幅优于基线；在 45T token 的多模态语料上预训练并经全面后训练，在多种文本与多模态 agentic 场景中表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 通过架构与缓存设计同步缓解计算、存储与带宽瓶颈，在显著压缩 KV 缓存的同时提升 agentic 性能，模型检查点已开放获取。

title: An Event Preserving Velocity Invariant Representation for Event Cameras
comment: @inproceedings{ikura2026event, title={An Event Preserving Velocity Invariant Representation for Event Cameras}, author={Ikura, Mikihiro and Gava, Luna and Wu, Jiahang and Glover, Arren and Bartolozzi, Chiara}, year={2026}, booktitle={ECCV 2026 Workshop-Event-Based Multimodal Vision: From Imaging to Perception and Understanding} }
summary: Event cameras provide low-latency, high temporal resolution perception for real-time vision tasks such as robotics.The novel circuitry (i.e. asynchronous, independent pixels) that enables these advantages also introduces new algorithmic challenges. Velocity-invariant representations alleviate missing observations under slow motion and motion blur under fast motion, but most discard temporal information by converting events into image-like representations. We propose Set of Centre Active Receptive Fields (SCARF), a real-time velocity-invariant representation that preserves raw events while consistently handling fast motion, stationary scenes, and independently moving objects. SCARF achieves state-of-the-art performance in both computational efficiency and representation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出SCARF，一种保留原始事件、速度不变的实时事件相机表征方法，兼顾计算效率与表征质量。
AI.motivation: 事件相机的异步独立像素电路带来低延迟、高时间分辨率优势，但也引入算法挑战：慢速运动下观测缺失、快速运动下运动模糊。现有速度不变表征多以转换为图像形式为代价，丢弃了时间信息。
AI.method: SCARF（Set of Centre Active Receptive Fields，中心活跃感受野集合），一种速度不变的实时表征，直接保留原始事件，同时一致地处理快速运动、静止场景和独立运动物体。
AI.result: 在计算效率和表征质量两方面均达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）表现。
AI.conclusion: SCARF在保持原始事件时间信息的同时实现速度不变性，适用于机器人等实时视觉任务。

title: Benchmarking LLM Compliance with China AI Generated Content Regulations
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, with appendix still improving
summary: The widespread adoption of LLMs has led to escalating content compliance risks. Prior works have contributed to addressing these risks in the English context, downplaying the complexity of Chinese language content. This paper follows China's current AI-Generated content compliance requirements and provides evaluation results on 20 notable LLMs, offering insight into China's regulatory landscape. We design a novel framework to assess the compliance and refusal rates with 2303 questions spanning six distinct dimensions, including 203 self-constructed constitutional questions. The framework employs several judges to generate verdicts independently based on their hierarchical alignment memory. Our findings show that international models also exhibit high levels of compliance despite the use of standard Chinese questions, and the main differences may stem from dimensions closely related to ideological alignment. We establish a regulatory benchmark that enables the global AI community to evaluate both Chinese and non-Chinese LLMs under a unified set of legally grounded compliance requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文围绕中国AI生成内容合规要求，构建了一个包含2303个问题（含203个自建宪法类问题）、覆盖六大维度的评估框架，对20个主流LLM的合规率与拒答率进行评测，并据此建立可供全球AI社区在统一法律合规标准下评估中外LLM的监管基准。
AI.motivation: LLM广泛部署带来不断上升的内容合规风险。已有研究多聚焦英语语境，低估了中文内容合规的复杂性。本文依据中国现行AI生成内容合规要求开展评测，以揭示中国监管格局，填补中文合规评估的空白。
AI.method: 设计了一个新颖的评估框架，包含2303个问题，跨越六大维度，其中203个为自建宪法类问题；采用多个judge基于其分层对齐记忆独立生成裁决，用以衡量合规率与拒答率；对20个知名LLM进行评测。
AI.result: 国际模型在使用标准中文提问时同样表现出较高合规水平；中外模型的主要差异可能集中在与意识形态对齐密切相关的维度上。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了具有法律依据的监管基准，使全球AI社区能够在统一合规要求下评估中文与非中文LLM，为中文AI生成内容合规评估提供了可复用的参考标准。

title: QCPruner: Query-Conditioned Population Coverage for Visual Token Pruning
summary: The high visual-token load in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) motivates training-free pruning to reduce later-layer computation, but under a fixed budget, pruning must preserve query-relevant evidence while avoiding redundancy. Existing methods rank tokens, diversify selected subsets, or optimize coverage without using a shared per-visual query utility to weight both visual targets and candidate representatives. We introduce QCPruner, which makes both roles query-conditioned through bilateral utility weighting. Using keyword-matched query anchors, QCPruner fuses two cross-modal cues into utility and applies it to both visual targets and candidate representatives within visual-affinity-based coverage. The resulting nonnegative facility-location objective is monotone and submodular, retains the standard (1-1/e) greedy guarantee, and requires no model training or parameter updates. Across LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT, LLaVA-Video, and Qwen2.5-VL, QCPruner achieves the highest average relative performance among evaluated complete-system pruning methods at every reported token budget. At 32 of 576 tokens on LLaVA-1.5-7B, it retains 96.1% of unpruned performance, versus 93.9% for the strongest evaluated baseline. At 256 of 1296 tokens on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, the corresponding values are 96.7% and 92.5%.

AI.tldr: QCPruner提出一种查询条件化的双侧效用加权视觉token剪枝方法，通过关键字匹配的查询锚点融合跨模态线索，在非负设施选址目标下联合为视觉目标与候选代表加权，实现免训练、可保持贪心近似保证的高效剪枝。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型中的高视觉token负载导致后层计算开销大，免训练剪枝成为降低计算的有效途径。然而在固定预算下，剪枝必须既保留与查询相关的证据，又避免冗余。现有方法要么对token排序，要么对所选子集进行多样化，或优化覆盖率，但均未使用共享的、针对每个视觉查询的效用同时为视觉目标和候选代表加权。
AI.method: QCPruner通过双侧效用加权使视觉目标与候选代表两种角色均查询条件化：利用关键字匹配的查询锚点，将两种跨模态线索融合为效用，并在基于视觉亲和力的覆盖率框架中同时作用于视觉目标和候选代表。由此得到的非负设施选址目标具有单调性和子模性，保留了标准(1-1/e)贪心近似保证，且无需模型训练或参数更新。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT、LLaVA-Video和Qwen2.5-VL上，QCPruner在所报告的每个token预算下均取得评估的完整系统剪枝方法中最高平均相对性能。在LLaVA-1.5-7B上保留576个token中的32个时，保持未剪枝性能的96.1%，而最强评估基线为93.9%；在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上保留1296个token中的256个时，对应数值分别为96.7%和92.5%。
AI.conclusion: QCPruner通过查询条件化的双侧效用加权，在免训练条件下有效解决了固定预算下兼顾查询相关证据保留与冗余抑制的问题，并在多个MLLM主干上以更少的token预算实现了优于现有完整系统剪枝方法的相对性能，同时具备理论上的子模贪心近似保证。

title: AVTrace: Diagnosing Audio-Visual Temporal Reasoning in Omni Models
summary: Omni models can describe video content, but can they locate events in time, preserve event order, and judge audio-visual synchronization? We introduce AVTrace (Audio-Visual Temporal Reasoning Assessment and Capability Evaluation), a silver-standard diagnostic suite spanning onset and span grounding, synchronization, next-step prediction, cross-modal localization, chain parsing, and event-conditioned comprehension. It contains 34,114 training examples and category-balanced development and test splits of 3,500 and 7,000 examples. We evaluate five open omni models under their respective input configurations using reference-blind response normalization followed by deterministic scoring. All five off-the-shelf systems score below the test split's majority-label baseline of 0.556 on synchronization verification, and obtain low scores on chain parsing and event-conditioned grounding and comprehension. Development-set perturbations reveal task-dependent sensitivity in Qwen3-Omni-30B to modality removal and changes in visual input processing, without isolating their underlying causes. Parameter-efficient temporal post-training improves Gemma4-E4B-it on several benchmark metrics. On three external image benchmarks, task metrics change modestly, including some degradations, while teacher-forcing perplexity decreases. Together, these findings show that semantic reference-text overlap should not be treated as a proxy for temporal localization, and that AVTrace can identify task-specific weaknesses while providing a testbed for temporal post-training.

AI.tldr: 提出 AVTrace 音视频时序推理评测套件，揭示现有 omni 模型在时序定位、事件顺序与音视频同步上的明显短板。
AI.motivation: omni 模型能描述视频内容，但是否具备时间定位、事件顺序保持与音视频同步判断能力尚不清楚，且语义文本重叠常被误当作时序定位能力的代理指标。
AI.method: 构建 AVTrace 银标准诊断套件，覆盖起止点与跨度定位、同步性、下一步预测、跨模态定位、链式解析、事件条件理解；含 34,114 训练样例及类别均衡的 3,500 开发集与 7,000 测试集；在各自输入配置下评测五个开源 omni 模型，采用参考盲响应归一化后确定性打分；对 Qwen3-Omni-30B 做模态移除与视觉输入处理扰动的开发集实验，并对 Gemma4-E4B-it 进行参数高效时序后训练。
AI.result: 五个现成系统在同步性验证上均低于测试集多数类基线 0.556，在链式解析与事件条件定位和理解上得分较低；Qwen3-Omni-30B 对模态移除和视觉输入处理变化表现出任务相关敏感性；时序后训练提升 Gemma4-E4B-it 多项指标，外部图像基准任务指标小幅变化（含部分退化），教师强制困惑度下降。
AI.conclusion: 语义参考文本重叠不能作为时序定位的代理；AVTrace 能识别任务级薄弱点，并为时序后训练提供测试平台。

title: Geopolitical Divisions Across Languages in Large Language Models
summary: People increasingly turn to AI chatbots for news and explanations of world events. But do they receive the same political answers when they ask in different languages? Here we show that the language of a question can change how the same AI systems assess the war in Ukraine. We ask GPT, Claude and Gemini to evaluate twenty statements about the war in 112 languages, collecting 67,200 responses. The balance between Russia-leaning and Ukraine-leaning responses differs across languages. When we group responses by countries' official languages, they follow a pattern resembling worldwide political divisions: relatively more Russia-leaning answers correspond to more favourable public views of Russia, less support for Ukraine in United Nations votes, and less aid to Ukraine. The broad pattern recurs across all three models and remains when individual statement pairs are removed. Our findings suggest a possible route through which information warfare may shape the text used to train AI models, which may in turn spread geopolitical biases.

AI.tldr: 研究通过112种语言向GPT、Claude、Gemini提出20条关于俄乌战争的陈述（共67,200条回答），发现AI对同一政治问题的回答因提问语言而异，且按国家官方语言分组后呈现出与全球政治分歧相似的模式。
AI.motivation: 随着人们越来越多地使用AI聊天机器人获取新闻和对世界事件的解释，作者关注一个被忽视的问题：用不同语言提问是否会得到不同的政治性回答，并探究这种语言差异是否反映或传播地缘政治偏见。
AI.method: 向GPT、Claude和Gemini三个模型，用112种语言询问关于俄乌战争的20条陈述以评估其立场，共收集67,200条回答；按国家官方语言对回答分组，并与各国对俄公众态度、联合国投票中对乌克兰的支持度、对乌援助等信息进行对照分析。
AI.result: 不同语言下"亲俄"与"亲乌"回答的比例存在差异；按国家官方语言分组后，偏亲俄回答较多的语言，对应公众对俄更正面、联合国投票中支持乌克兰更少、对乌援助更少。这一总体模式在三个模型中均成立，且在剔除个别陈述对后依然稳健。
AI.conclusion: AI模型对政治议题的回答随提问语言变化，且这种差异与全球地缘政治分歧相关，提示信息战可能通过塑造AI训练文本而注入地缘政治偏见并在模型输出中扩散。

title: GRF-Recon: Global Ray-Field Optimization for Long-Sequence Feed-forward Reconstruction
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026 as a Spotlight presentation
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction provides an efficient paradigm for scene modeling from image sequences. Scaling these models to large monocular scenarios are constrained by excessive GPU memory footprint, degraded local geometry, and long-term trajectory drift. Existing chunk-based optimization strategies provide limited geometric constraints and fail to maintain global consistency over extended trajectories. We present a unified framework for stable and scalable feed-forward 3D reconstruction from long monocular sequences. Our approach builds on coarse-to-fine trajectory alignment augmented by lightweight geometric prior injection. Distilling monocular geometric cues into the feed-forward backbone via LoRA adaptation improves depth accuracy on fine structures while preserving inference efficiency. We introduce a hybrid-weight sparse ray-field optimization that leverages high-frequency geometric features to guide local point-cloud refinement and enforce consistent inter-frame ray constraints. Unlike prior chunk-based methods, this establishes strong cross-frame geometric coupling while maintaining scalability. Finally, an efficient trajectory stitching strategy with joint ray-error optimization explicitly reduces accumulated drift. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves competitive trajectory accuracy compared with representative SLAM systems, while maintaining globally consistent 3D reconstruction in large-scale scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个统一框架，用于从长单目序列进行稳定且可扩展的前馈3D重建，通过粗到细轨迹对齐、几何先验注入、混合权重稀疏射线场优化与轨迹拼接，实现大规模场景下全局一致的3D重建。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D重建虽高效，但在大规模单目场景中受限于显存开销过大、局部几何退化与长期轨迹漂移；现有基于分块的优化策略几何约束有限，难以在长轨迹上保持全局一致性。
AI.method: 1) 粗到细轨迹对齐，并结合轻量几何先验注入；2) 通过LoRA适配将单目几何线索蒸馏进前馈骨干网络，在保持推理效率的同时提升细结构深度精度；3) 提出混合权重稀疏射线场优化，利用高频几何特征引导局部点云精化并施加一致的帧间射线约束，建立强跨帧几何耦合；4) 采用高效轨迹拼接策略与联合射线误差优化，显式减少累积漂移。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在轨迹精度上与代表性SLAM系统具有竞争力，同时在大规模场景中保持全局一致的3D重建。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保证前馈重建效率与可扩展性的同时，提升了长单目序列的几何精度与全局一致性，为大规模前馈3D重建提供了可行方案。

title: Astronex-World 1.0: Real-Time Interactive World Model Foundation
comment: Technical report. 25 pages, 13 figures, 10 tables. Project page: https://world.astronex.com.cn ; Code: https://github.com/Astronex-Robotics/Astronex-World ; Weights: https://huggingface.co/Astronex-Lab/Astronex-World
summary: We present Astronex-World 1.0, an open controllable video world-model foundation. Given a text prompt (text-to-video) or an initial observation (image-to-video), the model predicts future visual states under frame-aligned camera trajectories, continuous actions, and an embodiment identifier, and accepts text events inserted at a specified position of a rollout. The family provides a bidirectional model for full-context generation and a causal model with block-causal attention and cross-block KV caching for persistent generation, both built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B prior. PRoPE injects camera intrinsics and extrinsics, while a 64-dimensional action stream modulates every Transformer layer. A five-stage training path develops bidirectional camera and action control, converts the backbone to block-causal generation, distills a few-step student, restores mixed-domain dynamics, and applies asymmetric DMD/DMD2 distribution matching. The causal model generates 832x480 video at 24 fps. All five training stages run on two NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPUs, and the causal model streams in real time on one. It scores 73.5 on WBench Navi and 70.0 on WBench Full. On Full, this 5B model is above the 13.6B LongCat-Video and the 14B Helios, within one point of the 22B LTX-2.3, and above YUME 1.5, which is post-trained from the same 5B prior on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. The reserved action input and output interfaces allow post-training for embodied intelligence and autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 提出可控视频世界模型Astronex-World 1.0，支持文本/图像到视频预测，具备相机轨迹与动作控制，含双向与因果两种模型，5B参数在WBench上超越更大模型。
AI.motivation: 构建开放、可控的视频世界模型基础，使模型能在给定文本或初始观测下预测未来视觉状态，并支持相机轨迹、连续动作、具身标识等细粒度控制，同时兼顾高质量生成与实时持续生成能力。
AI.method: 基于Wan2.2-TI2V-5B先验，提供双向全上下文模型与带块因果注意力和跨块KV缓存的因果模型。用PRoPE注入相机内外参，64维动作流调制每层Transformer。五阶段训练：双向相机与动作控制、骨干转块因果生成、少步学生蒸馏、混合域动态恢复、非对称DMD/DMD2分布匹配。
AI.result: 因果模型以24 fps生成832x480视频。五阶段训练仅用两张NVIDIA L20 48GB GPU完成，因果模型可在单卡实时流式生成。WBench Navi得分73.5，WBench Full得分70.0；Full上超过13.6B LongCat-Video和14B Helios，逼近22B LTX-2.3（差1分以内），并超过同源5B后训练的YUME 1.5。
AI.conclusion: Astronex-World 1.0以较小参数量实现强控制性与竞争性性能，预留动作输入输出接口，可面向具身智能与自动驾驶进行后训练，具备开放可控世界模型基础潜力。

title: The Missing Complement: State-Conditioned Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Coding Agents
comment: 32 pages, 3 figures. Benchmark and evaluation resources: https://github.com/LordTARN1SHED/SERBench
summary: Retrieval assembles repository context by ranking passages for relevance to the current query. A coding agent halfway through an issue has already read much of what such a ranker returns. Relevance is scored per passage, but sufficiency belongs to the set: independently scored passages can fill the budget with support for one requirement while another goes unmet. We formulate state-conditioned minimal sufficient evidence recovery: given a captured agent state, recover a compact evidence combination supplying what its next decision still lacks. SERBench measures this on 500 held-out states from 45 repositories, recording what the agent has seen, crediting only sets that satisfy every annotated evidence requirement of the current decision, and separating set recovery from candidate discovery. MSS-Complement treats acquisition as set construction, not ranking. Three semantic calls propose a jointly sufficient set, search for what it lacks, and return 4-8 intact source units within 6,144 tokens. One configuration, fixed on calibration data, recovers a complete set for 73.0% of those states at five items and 80.6% at eight, against 61.4% and 72.4% for Qwen3 embedding with reranking. A matched control ranking by similarity alone recovers fewer complete sets, placing the margin over it in the set-level policy, not the computation. The lead persists from frozen repository source with no gold-derived pool. On AMA-Bench it answers from a 76.2% smaller answer prompt, with accuracy 2.08 points above that benchmark's own memory agent. Removing one required group from a complete set costs repair-localization precision under two executors. Retrieval for agents is better posed as recovering what a decision lacks than re-ranking what an issue resembles.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"状态条件化最小充分证据恢复"任务，即给定编码智能体的当前状态，恢复一组能补齐其下一步决策所缺信息的紧凑证据集合（而非按相关性重排段落），并构建SERBench基准与MSS-Complement方法，在集合级充分性指标上显著优于重排基线。
AI.motivation: 现有检索范式以"按与查询的相关性对段落排序"来组装仓库上下文，但处于任务中段的编码智能体已读过大量返回内容。相关性是逐段打分，而充分性属于集合属性：独立打分的段落可能把预算填满在满足某一需求上，导致另一需求缺失。因此需要重新将检索定位为"恢复决策所缺证据"。
AI.method: 提出SERBench基准，在45个仓库的500个留出状态上评测：记录智能体已见内容，仅当集合满足当前决策的全部标注证据需求时才计分，并将"集合恢复"与"候选发现"分离。提出MSS-Complement，把证据获取视为集合构造而非排序，通过三次语义调用——提议一个联合充分集合、搜索其缺失部分、并返回4-8个完整源码单元（限6,144 tokens）。配置在标定数据上固定，不依赖金标注池。
AI.result: 单一配置在五个条目时对73.0%的状态恢复出完整集合，八个条目时为80.6%；Qwen3 embedding加重排为61.4%与72.4%。仅按相似度排序的匹配对照恢复的完整集合更少，说明优势来自集合级策略而非计算量。该领先在冻结仓库源码、无金标注池条件下依然保持。在AMA-Bench上，以缩小76.2%的答案提示作答，准确率仍高出该基准自有记忆智能体2.08个点。从完整集合中移除一个必需组会降低两种执行器下的修复定位精度。
AI.conclusion: 面向智能体的检索，更恰当的表述是"恢复一个决策所缺失的内容"，而非"对某个问题所相似的内容重新排序"。

title: AI Should Facilitate Democratic Deliberation at Scale
summary: AI systems can strengthen democracy by supporting deliberation at scale by addressing cognitive, social, platform-design, and market-driven frictions, while preserving human agency. Unlike proposals such as liquid democracy that restructure representation through vote delegation, in this position paper, we argue that AI-assisted deliberation offers a more promising path by lowering barriers to meaningful engagement without substituting machine judgment for human choice. Drawing on evidence from online deliberation platforms and experimental research, we identify four guiding principles: preserving agency and autonomy, encouraging mutual respect, promoting equality and inclusiveness, and augmenting rather than substituting active citizenship. We also address critical challenges, including alignment, sycophancy, training bias, and over-reliance on AI systems. We call on the machine learning community to develop deliberation-focused AI systems evaluated not on engagement metrics but on their capacity to facilitate informed, representative, and friction-robust discourse.

AI.tldr: 本文主张以AI辅助协商（而非票权委托式民主）来强化民主，提出四项指导原则并呼吁ML社区以协商质量为导向开发与评估系统。
AI.motivation: 协商面临认知、社会、平台设计与市场驱动等多重摩擦，规模化的有意义参与受到阻碍；同时存在以液态民主等重构代表机制的替代方案，需论证何种路径更能兼顾参与深度与人类能动性。
AI.method: 立场论文（position paper）。基于在线协商平台证据与实验研究，提出AI辅助协商的论证框架，识别四原则：保持能动性与自主性、促进相互尊重、推动平等与包容、增强而非替代积极公民参与；并讨论对齐、谄媚（sycophancy）、训练偏差与过度依赖等挑战。
AI.result: 论证AI辅助协商比液态民主等票权委托方案更具前景：它降低有意义参与的门槛，而不以机器判断替代人类选择；同时系统梳理了需应对的关键风险与挑战。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁机器学习社区开发面向协商的AI系统，其评估标准应从参与度指标转向促进知情、具代表性且抗摩擦的 discourse 的能力。

title: A Free Lunch? Adapting PP-OCRv6 for Historical Text Recognition
summary: Despite impressive reported scores, large vision-language models have seen limited practical uptake in historical automatic text recognition because of their computational cost, dependence on large-scale pretraining, and hallucination. Historical ATR therefore continues to rely largely on compact CRNN line recognizers, which are visually grounded and trainable on modest data. Lightweight recurrence-free recognizers promise the accuracy of larger models with the practical advantages of CRNNs, yet have not been comprehensively evaluated on historical writing. We adapt PP-OCRv6, a recent compact text recognizer without strong language modeling, for historical line recognition and compare it with a conventional CRNN across generalized pretraining, domain-specific training, corpus-level fine-tuning, and manuscript-specific few-shot adaptation on multilingual Latin- and Arabic-script material. While PP-OCRv6 does not consistently outperform the baseline when trained from scratch, heterogeneous pretraining produces markedly better generalization. Comparisons with the Qwen3.5-based Medusa recognizer further show that fine-tuned PP-OCRv6 can outperform a large VLM tailored towards historical Latin-script HTR.

AI.tldr: 该文系统评估了轻量无循环识别器PP-OCRv6在历史文本行识别中的表现，发现异质预训练带来的泛化优势明显，且微调后可超越面向历史拉丁手写体的大视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型虽报告分数亮眼，但因计算成本高、依赖大规模预训练及幻觉问题，在历史自动文本识别（ATR）中实用化受限；历史ATR仍主要依赖视觉接地、可在中小数据上训练的紧凑CRNN行识别器。轻量无循环识别器理论上兼具大模型精度与CRNN的实用优势，但尚未在历史书写上得到全面评估。
AI.method: 将近期紧凑文本识别器PP-OCRv6（缺乏强语言建模）适配于历史文本行识别，并将其与传统CRNN在多语言拉丁字母与阿拉伯字母材料上，就通用预训练、领域特定训练、语料级微调、手稿特定小样本适配四种设置进行对比；同时与基于Qwen3.5的Medusa识别器比较。
AI.result: 从头训练时PP-OCRv6未能一致超越CRNN基线，但异质预训练带来显著更好的泛化能力；与Medusa识别器对比显示，经微调的PP-OCRv6可超越面向历史拉丁字母手写文本识别定制的大型视觉语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 轻量无循环识别器（如PP-OCRv6）在历史ATR中具备实用潜力，其关键在于异质预训练与领域微调，而非依赖大规模预训练或强语言建模；微调后甚至可媲美、超越定制的大型VLM。

title: PointEvent: Rethinking Event-based Tiny Object Detection via Serialized Motion Evidence Accumulation
summary: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and motion sensitivity for tiny UAV detection, yet distant targets generate sparse and fragmented events that are easily overwhelmed by clutter and ego-motion. Existing methods mainly rely on dense event representations or local sparse spatiotemporal modeling, resulting in redundant computation or fragmented modeling of motion continuity across distant asynchronous events. To address this limitation, we introduce serialized motion evidence accumulation, which treats motion continuity as an ordered evidence propagation process. Specifically, the same event stream is organized into locality-preserving spatiotemporal paths and chronology-preserving temporal paths through the latent complementary serializations. Based on this principle, we propose PointEvent, a lightweight event-wise state-space framework that alternates serialized scans across the complementary orders, progressively consolidating fragmented motion evidence beyond fixed local neighborhoods. A high-resolution event branch preserves fine-grained target responses, while compact context modulation suppresses interference. Experiments demonstrate that PointEvent achieves SOTA with the fewest parameters and fastest measured inference among the compared methods. Code: https://github.com/wzz-z/PointEvent

AI.tldr: 提出PointEvent，一种轻量级事件级状态空间框架，通过互补序列化扫描实现运动证据积累，用于微小UAV检测，以最少参数达到SOTA且推理最快。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备高时间分辨率与运动敏感性，适合微小UAV检测。但远距离目标产生的事件稀疏且碎片化，易被杂乱背景和自运动淹没。现有方法依赖稠密事件表征或局部稀疏时空建模，导致冗余计算，或对跨远距离异步事件的运动连续性建模碎片化。
AI.method: 引入序列化运动证据积累，将运动连续性视为有序的证据传播过程。将同一事件流通过潜在互补序列化组织为保局域的时空路径与保时序的时间路径。基于此提出PointEvent：轻量级事件级状态空间框架，交替进行互补顺序的序列化扫描，逐步整合超出固定局部邻域的碎片化运动证据；同时设置高分辨率事件分支保留细粒度目标响应，并用紧凑上下文调制抑制干扰。
AI.result: 实验表明，PointEvent在对比方法中以最少参数量达到SOTA，并实现最快的实测推理速度。
AI.conclusion: 通过序列化运动证据积累与互补序列化扫描，PointEvent有效解决远距离微小UAV事件稀疏碎片化问题，在精度与效率上均优于现有方法，代码已开源。

title: Marginal utility, matrix factorization, and the Key-Value (KV) cache: a unified information-economic framework for sovereign geo-mining inference
comment: Version 11, 14 septembre 2026. 49 pages, 9 tables. Les valeurs de l'architecture souveraine sont projet{é}es et non mesur{é}es ; le calcul {à} grande {é}chelle est en cours. Soumission pr{é}vue {à} IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence
summary: This paper builds a theoretical bridge between the economic notion of marginal utility and two machine-learning constructs, matrix factorization and the Key--Value cache of transformer language models. The singular value spectrum of a rating matrix is shown to be a diminishing marginal utility schedule for latent factors, the eigenvalue spectrum of the projected covariance operator to be the marginal utility schedule of a model's learned representation, and cache eviction and low-rank cache compression to be instances of constrained utility maximization under a memory budget. The three collapse into a single allocation rule: retain the top dimensions whose eigenvalue exceeds the shadow price of the binding constraint. The framework is applied to the automated extraction of structured information from geo-mining documents, where it motivates a multi-pass inference protocol, a layer-wise TIES model merging procedure, and a selection policy combining extraction quality, localization drift and energy, scalarized with a Conditional Value-at-Risk term on drift. Two empirical contributions are reported. An 11.2-million-parameter hierarchical classifier, trained in about five minutes on a single GPU, reaches 90.0 per cent level-1 accuracy on a held-out test set from a 973-document uranium-exploration corpus, against 92.0 per cent for a proprietary model on a fifty-document human audit of the same corpus, at a latency of 2.62 ms per card against approximately 2,000 ms for the API and at negligible cost. A diagnostic of uniform-density TIES merging exposes a reproducible degenerate mode in which the merged model returns token-identical outputs across five geographically distinct districts while declaring high confidence; re-executing the merge under layer-wise calibrated densities removes that signature on the diagnostic sample. The full-scale extraction benchmark, including LoRA fine-tuning, is reported as projected rather than measured and remains an empirical extension of this work.

AI.tldr: 该论文在经济学边际效用与机器学习（矩阵分解、Transformer KV缓存）之间建立理论桥梁，统一为"保留特征值高于影子价格维度"的分配规则，并将其应用于地质采矿文档的结构化信息抽取，提出多趟推理、分层TIES合并与风险标量化选择策略；实验上以11.2M参数分层分类器在铀矿勘探语料上达到90.0%一级准确率、2.62ms延迟，并诊断出均匀密度TIES合并的退化模式。
AI.motivation: 作者试图寻找经济学的边际效用概念与矩阵分解、Transformer键值缓存两种机器学习构造之间的理论共同点，以统一的资源分配视角解释降秩、缓存淘汰与压缩等机制，并借该框架指导地质采矿文档的自动化结构化信息抽取。
AI.method: 理论上：将评分矩阵奇异值谱解释为潜在因子的边际效用递减曲线，将投影协方差算子特征值谱解释为模型所学表示的边际效用曲线，将缓存淘汰与低秩缓存压缩视为记忆预算约束下的效用最大化；三者统一为在紧约束下保留特征值超过影子价格维度的分配规则。应用上：提出多趟推理协议、分层TIES模型合并流程，以及结合抽取质量、定位漂移与能耗并引入漂移条件风险价值（CVaR）项的选择策略。
AI.result: 11.2百万参数的分层分类器在单GPU上约5分钟训练完成，在973篇铀矿勘探语料留出测试集上达到90.0%一级准确率；对同一语料50篇人工审计中专用模型为92.0%，该模型延迟2.62ms/卡片，对比API约2000ms且成本可忽略。均匀密度TIES合并诊断出可复现的退化模式：合并模型在五个地理上不同区段输出逐token完全相同却声明高置信度；在分层校准密度下重做合并可消除该诊断样本上的特征。全规模抽取基准（含LoRA微调）为投影值而非实测值。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了边际效用与矩阵分解、KV缓存之间的统一分配理论，并在铀矿勘探文档抽取任务上验证了小型高效模型的可行性，同时揭示了TIES合并的退化风险及分层密度校准的缓解作用；但全规模基准仍属未实测的实证延伸。

title: Reading Emotions in the Token Space: Discriminative Adaptation of SpeechLLMs for Emotion Recognition
summary: SpeechLLMs have shown strong potential for emotion recognition, yet they read the predicted emotion off a generative decoder not suited for classification: it can emit labels outside the target set and favors frequent classes. We propose a discriminative adaptation that reads the final prompt token's hidden state through a classification head, producing a label in one forward pass without modifying the backbone. Because this readout starts from the hidden state the model would otherwise decode, it gives a controlled comparison of generative and discriminative inference in an otherwise identical speechLLM. We keep the head a single linear layer, trading little accuracy for interpretability: each emotion becomes one direction in the LLM output token space, revealing associated tokens. On IEMOCAP, across two speechLLM architectures, it improves Macro F1 and removes hallucinations, with largest gains on realistic ASR transcripts. Our analysis reveals that these emotion directions encode indirect associations mirroring biases in web-scale text.

AI.tldr: 提出一种判别式适配方法，通过分类头读取SpeechLLM最后一个提示词token的隐状态，一次前向即输出类别，在IEMOCAP上提升Macro F1并消除幻觉。
AI.motivation: SpeechLLM用于情感识别时依赖生成式解码器读标签，而该解码器不适于分类：会输出目标集合之外的标签，并偏向高频类别。
AI.method: 不改动主干，将最后一层提示token的隐状态经单层线性分类头读出类别，一次前向完成判别；因读起点正是模型本会用于解码的隐状态，构成生成式与判别式推理的受控比较；单线性层带来可解释性，每个情感对应LLM输出token空间中的一个方向。
AI.result: 在IEMOCAP、两种SpeechLLM架构上，Macro F1提升并消除幻觉，在真实ASR转写文本上增益最大；分析显示这些情感方向编码了间接关联，反映网络规模文本中的偏差。
AI.conclusion: 判别式读出可有效替代生成式解码进行语音情感分类，兼顾性能、可控比较与可解释性。

title: MATCH: Model-Aware Tool Learning with Curriculum Scheduling and Hierarchically Gated Rewards
summary: Tool learning enables large language models (LLMs) to use external tools for tasks beyond parametric knowledge. Reinforcement learning can optimize tool-call behavior from feedback, but current methods still face two problems: fixed-threshold curricula can become misaligned with the policy's evolving capability boundary, and additive rewards can leak argument-level credit when the predicted tool is wrong. To address these problems, we propose MATCH, a closed-loop framework for model-aware tool learning with curriculum scheduling and hierarchically gated rewards. Model-Aware Curriculum Learning (MACL) maintains reward-derived sample difficulty that co-evolves with the policy, and each epoch selects samples near the current capability boundary together with a top-k pool of harder cases. Hierarchical Tool-call Gated Reward (HTGR) scores tool name, argument key, and argument value as a gated chain, granting credit at each level only when prerequisites hold. The same HTGR rewards drive both GRPO updates and MACL's difficulty refresh, closing the loop between policy optimization and sample scheduling. On API-Bank and BFCL V3, MATCH reaches 72.19% and 62.87% overall accuracy, outperforming the main supervised and RL-based baselines. Backbone experiments further show consistent improvements across four backbones from two model families.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MATCH，一个面向LLM工具学习的闭环框架，通过模型感知课程学习（MACL）与分层门控奖励（HTGR）联合优化工具调用行为，在API-Bank与BFCL V3上取得优于主流监督与RL基线的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的工具调用优化存在两个问题：固定阈值课程与策略不断演进的能力边界不匹配；加性奖励在预测工具错误时会造成参数级信用泄漏。
AI.method: MATCH包含两个核心组件：MACL基于奖励推导样本难度，使其与策略共同演化，每轮选取靠近当前能力边界的样本及一个top-k更难样本池；HTGR将工具名、参数键、参数值作为门控链式评分，仅在前置条件满足时授予对应层级信用。同一HTGR奖励同时驱动GRPO更新与MACL难度刷新，形成策略优化与样本调度的闭环。
AI.result: 在API-Bank和BFCL V3上，MATCH总体准确率分别达到72.19%和62.87%，优于主要监督与RL基线；在来自两个模型族的四个骨干上均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: MATCH通过模型感知课程调度与分层门控奖励的闭环设计，有效缓解课程失配与信用泄漏问题，提升了LLM工具调用能力，并具备跨骨干的泛化性。

title: G^2RA-NET: Graph-based Cross-Slice Relation Modeling with Attention Gating for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Medical image segmentation supports quantitative clinical analysis and computer-aided diagnosis. Recent methods for medical image segmentation have improved both local feature representation and volumetric context modeling. However, existing methods still strug- gle to efficiently model cross-slice relations in anisotropic volumet- ric images, limiting segmentation consistency and accuracy. This pa- per proposes G^2RA-Net, a medical image segmentation framework that combines graph-based cross-slice relation modeling with atten- tion gating. Graph-Based Slice Relationship Modeling (GSRM) cap- tures anatomical dependencies across consecutive slices by repre- senting each slice as a graph node and propagating semantic con- text through graph message passing. The Cross-Slice Attention Gate (CSAG) then selects relevant neighboring context and emphasizes target anatomical regions through attention-guided feature modula- tion. Experiments on brain MRI and abdominal CT datasets demon- strate that G^2RA-Net outperforms representative methods in seg- mentation accuracy and boundary quality. Ablation studies further validate the proposed design.

AI.tldr: 提出G²RA-Net，融合图跨切片关系建模与注意力门控，提升各向异性体数据分割一致性。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割中现有方法难以高效建模各向异性体数据的跨切片关系，限制分割一致性与精度。
AI.method: GSRM将各切片视为图节点，通过图消息传递传播语义上下文以捕获相邻切片的解剖依赖；CSAG以注意力引导的特征调制选择相关邻域上下文并强化目标解剖区域。
AI.result: 在脑MRI与腹部CT数据集上，分割精度与边界质量优于代表性方法，消融实验验证各设计有效性。
AI.conclusion: 图跨切片关系建模与注意力门控结合可有效解决跨切片建模难题，提升分割性能。

title: A Smaller Transformer in Your Transformer
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at the 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026)
summary: Recent findings indicate that Vision Transformers settle into locally similar computational phases, implying a level of depthwise computational redundancy. However, existing methods to exploit this redundancy either fail to reduce inference compute or severely degrade model expressivity. In this work, we formalise a unified view of block redundancy that decouples the geometry from specific surrogate interventions. We then introduce Transformer-Within-Transformer (TWT), a post-hoc method that fuses contiguous groups of redundant layers into a single learned surrogate layer. TWT reduces parameter count and inference compute while remaining competitive with original models using half the depth on natural images, and in several downstream histopathology settings, TWT matches or even improves on the original baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出统一视角刻画Vision Transformer的块冗余，并设计TWT方法将连续冗余层融合为单个学习到的代理层，在降低参数和推理计算量的同时保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 近期研究发现ViT会进入局部相似的计算阶段，存在深度方向的计算冗余。但现有利用该冗余的方法要么无法减少推理计算，要么严重损害模型表达能力，因此需要一种兼顾压缩与性能的方法。
AI.method: 作者形式化了一个关于块冗余的统一视角，将几何结构从具体的代理干预中解耦；并提出Transformer-Within-Transformer（TWT），一种事后（post-hoc）方法，将成组的连续冗余层融合为一个学习到的代理层。
AI.result: TWT减少了参数量和推理计算量，在自然图像上以一半深度即可与原始模型竞争，在若干下游组织病理学任务中达到甚至超过原始基线。
AI.conclusion: TWT证明了对ViT层冗余进行统一建模与层融合可有效实现深度压缩，在保持甚至提升任务性能的同时降低推理成本。

title: Design of the IBM Granite 5.0 TurboCTC ASR Model
summary: We describe the architecture, training methodology and inference speedups of Granite 5.0 Turbo CTC, a 470 million parameter encoder-only model with an excellent speed-accuracy tradeoff. The architecture uses pyramidal temporal subsampling within Conformer blocks using strided depthwise convolutions, block-diagonal (chunk-wise) self-attention, and conditioning on intermediate predictions from the middle layer. Training highlights are the use of only publicly available data, the novel use of a Muon optimizer, and balanced data sampling. Inference speedups include replacing 1 x 1 convolutions with linear layers and optimizing the attention computation in the Conformer blocks. Collectively, these result in a model that is on the speed-accuracy Pareto frontier of the Open ASR leaderboard for English short-form ASR while being twice as fast as the fastest competitor. The model can be used under a permissive license and downloaded from https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-speech-5.0-470m-turboctc.

AI.tldr: Granite 5.0 Turbo CTC：4.7亿参数纯编码器ASR模型，通过架构、训练与推理优化，在Open ASR排行榜上达到速度-精度帕累托前沿，速度达最快竞品的两倍，允许宽松许可证使用。
AI.motivation: 在英语短语音ASR任务中，需要兼顾识别精度与推理速度，以实现良好的速度-精度权衡；同时希望仅使用公开数据训练，并提供可宽松许可使用的模型。
AI.method: 架构上采用Conformer块内的金字塔式时间下采样（步进深度卷积）、块对角（分块）自注意力，并以中间层预测作为条件；训练上仅用公开数据，采用Muon优化器与平衡数据采样；推理上以线性层替换1x1卷积并优化Conformer块的注意力计算。
AI.result: 在Open ASR排行榜英语短语音ASR任务上，该模型处于速度-精度帕累托前沿，且比最快的竞品快两倍。
AI.conclusion: Granite 5.0 Turbo CTC在速度-精度权衡上表现优异，模型可在宽松许可证下使用，并已开源供下载。

title: AnyviewMeter: Adapting Robotic Reward Models with Camera Geometry and Multi-View Attention
summary: Robotic reward models evaluate task execution from visual observations, but their predictions can change with camera viewpoint and occlusion even when the underlying task state is unchanged. Adapting a pretrained reward model to a local task therefore requires accounting for how that task is observed. We introduce AnyviewMeter, a geometry-conditioned adaptation framework for robotic reward models that represent task progress as a scalar reward signal. It combines low-rank fine-tuning with token-aligned Plucker rays and synchronous block attention: ray conditioning incorporates camera geometry into visual features and attention queries and keys, while block attention fuses synchronized views inside the pretrained decoder. The framework supports both single-view reward prediction and joint multi-view evaluation through parameter-efficient adaptation of a pretrained Robometer model. On PickCube, single-view adaptation improves progress prediction in every camera group and reduces mean absolute error under a changed field of view by approximately 21% relative to RGB fine-tuning. Across simulated manipulation tasks, joint multi-view prediction reduces progress error by 41-69% compared with averaging single-view RGB predictions and improves temporal ordering in approximately 88% of task-camera groups. On real tasks with fixed and wrist-mounted cameras, mean absolute error decreases by approximately 21% relative to averaged RGB fine-tuning. These results support camera geometry and joint visual evidence as useful components of task-specific robotic reward adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出AnyviewMeter，一种几何条件化的机器人奖励模型适配框架，通过Plücker射线条件与同步块注意力实现相机视角与遮挡不变的任务进度评估。
AI.motivation: 机器人奖励模型从视觉观察评估任务执行，但其预测会随相机视角和遮挡变化而改变，即使底层任务状态未变。因此将预训练奖励模型适配到特定本地任务时，必须考虑该任务的观测方式。
AI.method: AnyviewMeter将低秩微调与token对齐的Plücker射线、同步块注意力相结合：射线条件化把相机几何注入视觉特征以及注意力的query和key；块注意力在预训练解码器内部融合同步视图。该框架支持单视图奖励预测与联合多视图评估，并对预训练Robometer模型进行参数高效适配。
AI.result: 在PickCube上，单视图适配在每个相机组均提升进度预测，且在视场变化下相比RGB微调平均绝对误差降低约21%。在仿真操作任务中，联合多视图预测相比平均单视图RGB预测将进度误差降低41–69%，并在约88%的任务-相机组中改善时间排序。在固定与腕部相机的真实任务中，平均绝对误差相比平均RGB微调降低约21%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，相机几何与联合视觉证据是任务特定机器人奖励适配的有效组成部分。

title: Think Thrice Before Reranking: Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking
summary: Reasoning-based reranking with Large Language Models (LLMs) has shown promising improvements in text ranking. However, current methods predominantly rely on a single reasoning trajectory, resulting in rankings that are susceptible to reasoning errors and inherently constrained in modeling the multifaceted signals underlying document relevance. To resolve this dilemma, we propose MERIT-Rank(Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking), a framework that models complementary reasoning trajectories to improve reranking robustness. MERIT-Rank formulates a Multi-Trajectory Reasoning Space (MTRS) that evaluates query-document relevance from multiple perspectives and introduces a joint reranker that consolidates these reasoning paths into a unified ranking decision. We further develop Progressive Rank Policy Optimization (PRPO), a progressive training framework that stabilizes reasoning trajectories while continually improving ranking quality through staged optimization objectives. Experiments on both reasoning-intensive and traditional retrieval benchmarks show that MERIT-Rank consistently achieves superior performance over competitive baselines. The 4B model notably outperforms most 7B and even 32B rerankers on BRIGHT.

AI.tldr: 提出MERIT-Rank框架，通过多视角证据与推理集成，缓解单一推理轨迹带来的排序脆弱性问题，并优于同级及更大规模基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM推理的文本重排序方法主要依赖单一推理轨迹，排序结果易受推理错误影响，且难以建模文档相关性背后的多面性信号。
AI.method: 构建多轨迹推理空间（MTRS），从多视角评估查询-文档相关性；引入联合重排序器融合多条推理路径形成统一排序决策；提出渐进式排序策略优化（PRPO），通过分阶段优化目标稳定推理轨迹并持续提升排序质量。
AI.result: 在推理密集型与传统检索基准上均持续优于竞争基线；4B模型在BRIGHT上显著超越多数7B乃至32B重排序器。
AI.conclusion: 多视角推理轨迹集成与渐进式策略优化可有效提升LLM重排序的鲁棒性与性能，小规模模型亦具竞争力。

title: Cross-Modal Attention Acts as a Frequency Filter: Why Verbose Prompts Improve Robustness in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are fragile under image corruption. We find that the wording of the question affects VLMs in two opposite ways. Verbose questions make VLMs substantially more robust---e.g., rephrasing "Is there a cat?" into "Please look carefully and answer: is there a cat?". Conversely, VLMs become more fragile under corruption when the question is semantically complex or finer-grained, e.g., "what colour is the cup left of the chair?" instead of "is there a cup?". Both effects stem from question-conditioned cross-modal attention, which induces a spectral filter over image patches: verbose questions broaden its frequency support, while fine-grained questions concentrate it onto fewer visual scales. The model's answer drifts most when this filter and the corruption sit on the same spatial frequencies. We test the filter view on Qwen3-VL and LLaVA-OneVision across GQA and CLEVR; verbose paraphrasing reduces drift variance by 70--81% on the 8B models. The practical recipe---pad the prompt---further yields measurable gains in accuracy, even under image corruption.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现视觉语言模型（VLM）在图像损坏下的鲁棒性受问题措辞影响：冗长问题更鲁棒，细粒度复杂问题更脆弱，并用"问题条件化跨模态注意力诱导的图像块谱滤波"机制解释。
AI.motivation: VLM 在图像损坏下表现脆弱，而作者发现同一模型对同一图像、不同提问措辞的鲁棒性差异显著，这一现象缺乏机理解释，因此需要揭示问题措辞影响损坏鲁棒性的内在机制。
AI.method: 提出"谱滤波"视角：问题条件化的跨模态注意力对图像块施加频率滤波。冗长问题拓宽滤波频率支撑，细粒度问题将支撑集中于更少视觉尺度；当滤波器与损坏落在相同空间频率时答案漂移最大。在 Qwen3-VL 与 LLaVA-OneVision 上，跨 GQA 与 CLEVR 进行验证。
AI.result: 冗长改写使 8B 模型的漂移方差降低 70–81%；提示填充（pad the prompt）这一简单做法在准确率上带来可测提升，即使在图像损坏下也有效。
AI.conclusion: 问题措辞通过塑造跨模态注意力的谱滤波特性双向调控 VLM 的损坏鲁棒性；据此可给出实用建议——用冗长、添加注意事项的提示词，以提升鲁棒性与准确率。

title: Bridging Modalities on the Cortex: Surface-based MRI to PET Translation with a Diffusion Bridge
summary: Cortical hypometabolism measured by Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography (FDG-PET) is a highly sensitive biomarker for dementia diagnosis. However, high costs, radiation exposure, and limited accessibility constrain its clinical utility. While cross-modal synthesis from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) offers a promising alternative, existing volumetric generation methods do not explicitly account for the highly folded cortical geometry, where disease-related patterns predominantly reside. To address this, we introduce a novel surface-based diffusion bridge framework DB-SUiT for MRI-to-PET translation that operates natively on the cortical manifold. A conditional Spherical U-shaped vision Transformer (SUiT) is specifically designed to model the intricate cross-modal relationships while preserving surface topology. It combines spherical convolutional encoders for multi-scale surface feature extraction with bottleneck Transformers to capture long-range spatial dependencies, while incorporating demographic and subcortical conditions to refine the synthesis. Evaluated on two datasets, including subjects with different dementia types, DB-SUiT demonstrates high-fidelity synthesis that substantially outperforms other baselines. In automated dementia classification, synthesized PET surfaces improve performance over MRI by 14.2% and PET volumes by 11.3%, approaching the performance of real PET surfaces. In a blinded reader study, synthetic PET achieved 85.5% diagnostic accuracy, compared with 75.8% for MRI and 95.2% for real PET. This further demonstrates cross-cohort and cross-pathology generalization, as the model was evaluated without retraining on an external cohort that included a dementia subtype not represented during training. Our code is available at https://github.com/ai-med/DB-SUiT.

AI.tldr: 提出基于皮层面流形的扩散桥框架DB-SUiT，实现MRI到FDG-PET的跨模态合成，性能显著优于基线并接近真实PET。
AI.motivation: FDG-PET是痴呆诊断的高灵敏生物标志物，但成本高、有辐射、可及性差；现有基于MRI的体积生成方法未显式建模高度折叠的皮层几何，而疾病相关模式恰位于皮层表面。
AI.method: 提出原生运行于皮层流形的表面扩散桥框架DB-SUiT，设计条件球面U形视觉Transformer（SUiT）：球形卷积编码器提取多尺度表面特征，瓶颈Transformer捕获长程空间依赖，并引入人口学与皮层下条件以精炼合成。
AI.result: 在两个数据集（含不同痴呆类型）上实现高保真合成，显著优于其他基线；自动痴呆分类中，合成PET表面较MRI提升14.2%、较PET体积提升11.3%，接近真实PET；盲法读者研究中合成PET诊断准确率85.5%（MRI为75.8%，真实PET为95.2%）；在含未见过痴呆亚型的外部队列上无需重训即展现跨队列与跨病理泛化。
AI.conclusion: DB-SUiT可在皮层面进行MRI至PET的高保真跨模态合成，提升痴呆分类与诊断性能并具备泛化能力，为低成本、低辐射的痴呆诊断提供新途径。

title: Task-Oriented Semantic Feature Transmission for Multi-Task Satellite Remote Sensing over Low-SNR Channels
summary: Conventional satellite remote sensing transmission follows a reconstruct-then-infer paradigm that optimizes pixel-level fidelity, creating an objective mismatch with downstream tasks such as classification and detection, especially at low SNR. This paper investigates a task-oriented framework that bypasses image reconstruction and directly transmits semantic features extracted by a multitask-pretrained backbone. A lightweight channel adaptation module (CAM) compresses feature dimensionality for bandwidth reduction, and a feature restorer recovers task-relevant structure after channel corruption. With the backbone frozen, the CAM and task-specific downstream heads are jointly optimized with task and feature-level supervision under random-SNR training. Under the adopted AWGN setting, experiments on scene classification and object detection show consistent gains over reconstruction-oriented JSCC baselines across different SNR conditions, with the largest improvements in the low-SNR regime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出任务导向的卫星遥感传输框架，跳过图像重建，直接传输多任务预训练骨干提取的语义特征，并通过轻量级信道适配模块(CAM)压缩特征维度、特征恢复器修复信道失真，在AWGN下于场景分类和目标检测均优于重建导向的JSCC基线，低SNR增益最大。
AI.motivation: 传统卫星遥感传输采用"先重建后推理"范式，以像素级保真度为目标，与分类、检测等下游任务目标不一致，尤其在低信噪比条件下失配严重。
AI.method: 采用任务导向框架，绕过图像重建，直接传输多任务预训练骨干提取的语义特征；引入轻量级信道适配模块(CAM)压缩特征维度以降低带宽，并用特征恢复器在信道损伤后恢复任务相关结构；冻结骨干，仅联合优化CAM与任务专用下游头，在随机SNR训练下施加任务级与特征级监督。
AI.result: 在AWGN设定下，场景分类与目标检测实验在不同SNR条件下相比重建导向的JSCC基线均取得一致的性能提升，且低SNR区间改进幅度最大。
AI.conclusion: 以语义特征传输替代像素重建可有效缓解目标失配问题，验证了任务导向框架在低SNR卫星遥感通信中的优越性。

title: Ischemic Stroke Segmentation and Net Water Uptake Quantification on Multicenter Non-Contrast CT Using Supervised Target-Domain Adaptation
summary: Objectives: Quantitative assessment of infarct hypodensity on non-contrast computed tomography (NCCT), including net water uptake (NWU), requires manual or semi-manual lesion delineation, often guided by CT perfusion or diffusion-weighted MRI, limiting clinical applicability. Automated segmentation on NCCT could enable efficient biomarker extraction such as NWU but remains challenging across heterogeneous multicenter data. This study aimed to develop and externally test a domain-aware deep learning framework for ischemic stroke segmentation on NCCT and assess its suitability for NWU quantification. Materials & Methods: In this retrospective multicenter study of 801 patients from four datasets, an nnU-Net-based model was trained on NCCT scans from the University Medical Center Hamburg-Eppendorf and the Acute Ischemic Stroke Dataset. To adapt to new domains, the model was fine-tuned on target-domain subsets from Boston (n=11) and ISLES (n=75), with evaluation on held-out cases not used for fine-tuning. Automated segmentations and NWU values were compared with expert references. Results: For lesions $\geq$ 30 mL, median Dice was 0.68 (Boston) and 0.56 (ISLES). Including smaller lesions, which predominated in ISLES, median Dice was 0.54 (interquartile range [IQR] 0.30-0.70) for acute lesion segmentation (Boston dataset) and 0.20 (IQR 0.03-0.41) for NCCT lesion segmentations when compared to post-treatment infarct (primary target of the ISLES challenge). Automated NWU mean absolute error was 1.37 percentage points (SD 1.61, Boston). Conclusion: Target-domain adaptation supported NCCT-only infarct segmentation across heterogeneous external cohorts, although performance varied across domains. The approach enabled low-error NWU quantification from baseline NCCT without advanced imaging, supporting further prospective clinical evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并外部验证了一个域感知深度学习框架（基于 nnU-Net），用于在 NCCT 上自动分割缺血性卒中病灶并量化净水摄取（NWU）。通过对目标域小样本微调实现跨中心迁移，Dice 达 0.68（Boston）/0.56（ISLES，病灶≥30 mL），Boston 队列 NWU 平均绝对误差为 1.37 个百分点，表明无需灌注或 DWI 即可实现低误差 NWU 定量。
AI.motivation: NCCT 上梗死低密度及净水摄取（NWU）的量化依赖手动或半手动勾画，且常需 CT 灌注或 DWI 引导，限制了临床可推广性。自动分割有望高效提取 NWU 等影像生物标志物，但在异质性多中心数据上仍具挑战。因此研究旨在构建可跨域迁移的自动分割框架并评估其 NWU 定量适用性。
AI.method: 回顾性多中心研究，纳入四个数据集共 801 例患者。以 nnU-Net 为基础模型，在汉堡大学医学中心与急性缺血性卒中数据集的 NCCT 上训练；为适应新域，分别在 Boston（n=11）与 ISLES（n=75）的目标域子集上微调，并在未参与微调的保留病例上评估。自动分割结果与 NWU 值均与专家参考标准进行对比。
AI.result: 对于≥30 mL 病灶，中位 Dice 为 0.68（Boston）与 0.56（ISLES）。纳入以 ISLES 为主的小病灶后，急性病灶分割中位 Dice 为 0.54（IQR 0.30–0.70，Boston 数据集）；与治疗后梗死灶（ISLES 挑战主要目标）相比，NCCT 病灶分割中位 Dice 为 0.20（IQR 0.03–0.41）。自动 NWU 平均绝对误差为 1.37 个百分点（SD 1.61，Boston）。
AI.conclusion: 目标域自适应可支持跨异质性外部队列的纯 NCCT 梗死分割，但性能存在域间差异。该方法能够在无高级影像的条件下，从基线 NCCT 实现低误差 NWU 定量，支持进一步开展前瞻性临床评估。

title: Needles in a Raystack: Ultra-Sparse LiDAR Occupancy Detection for Bat Tracks
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted and presented at the AI4Nature@AVSS 2026 Workshop of the 22nd International Conference on Advanced Visual and Signal-Based Systems (AVSS 2026), Lecce, Italy
summary: Monitoring flying animals is important for understanding and protecting biodiversity, but nocturnal species such as bats are difficult to observe in the field. Using LiDAR, bat movements at night result in ultra-sparse 3D spatio-temporal data in which standard reconstruction losses tend to predict only background and miss real flight paths. We study this problem as voxel-wise occupancy detection in sensor-centric LiDAR raystacks. A lightweight 3D U-Net is proposed that preserves temporal resolution, uses skip connections for spatial detail, and combines weighted binary cross-entropy with Dice loss to handle the strong class imbalance. In real LiDAR recordings of bats over open fields, cross-checked with acoustic monitoring, a reconstruction-based 3D convolutional autoencoder baseline fails to recover foreground trajectories. In contrast, the proposed U-Net recovers sparse foreground occupancy in diagnostic experiments and produces coherent occupancy patterns along bat flight trajectories, providing a practical basis for validation-scale experiments, later clustering of flight tracks, and future integration of bat activity information into biodiversity-aware turbine curtailment strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究以LiDAR探测夜间蝙蝠飞行轨迹的问题，将其建模为传感器中心raystack中的体素占用检测，提出轻量3D U-Net（结合加权BCE与Dice损失）以应对极端类别不平衡；实验表明该方法能恢复稀疏前景占用并生成连贯轨迹，优于基于重建的3D卷积自编码器基线。
AI.motivation: 蝙蝠等夜行性物种难以在野外直接观测，而监测飞行动物对理解与保护生物多样性至关重要。使用LiDAR时，夜间蝙蝠运动产生的是超稀疏3D时空数据，标准重建损失倾向于只预测背景、漏掉真实飞行路径，因此需要针对该稀疏占用检测问题设计合适的方法。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为传感器中心LiDAR raystack中的逐体素占用检测。提出一种轻量3D U-Net：保持时间分辨率不变，通过跳跃连接保留空间细节，并组合加权二元交叉熵与Dice损失以应对强烈的类别不平衡。基线为基于重建的3D卷积自编码器。
AI.result: 在开阔田野上真实蝙蝠LiDAR记录中，并以声学监测交叉验证：基于重建的3D卷积自编码器基线无法恢复前景轨迹；而所提U-Net在诊断实验中能够恢复稀疏前景占用，并沿蝙蝠飞行轨迹产生连贯的占用模式。
AI.conclusion: 所提3D U-Net为验证规模实验、后续飞行轨迹聚类，以及未来将蝙蝠活动信息纳入生物多样性友好的风机限转策略提供了实用基础。

title: To Copy or Not to Copy: Controlling Speculative Decoding via Intrinsic Model Signals
summary: Speculative Decoding (SD) has significantly accelerated Large Language Model (LLM) inference, yet existing approaches face a fundamental tradeoff between two drafting strategies: neural drafting and context-based copying. Neural drafts (e.g., EAGLE3) provide robust performance across diverse text settings, while copy-based methods achieve higher speedups in copy-intensive regimes by generating candidates faster and exploiting long repetition spans for near-perfect speculation. We analyze existing copy-based methods and find that they are prone to accidental repetitions where surface-level n-gram overlap does not reflect a structural intent to copy, leading to false-positive triggers that ultimately degrade throughput. We introduce SwitchSD, an adaptive framework that treats copying as a latent control signal of the LLM. By training lightweight probes on the target model's internal representations, SwitchSD identifies genuine copy-intent with high precision (AUC > 0.99). This allows the system to dynamically switch between neural drafting (e.g., EAGLE) and context-based copying. Our results across Llama and Qwen families demonstrate throughput gains of up to 15% over state-of-the-art baselines like EAGLE3, effectively turning copying from a noisy heuristic into a principled, model-aware decoding regime.

AI.tldr: SwitchSD通过轻量探针检测LLM内部表示中的真实"复制意图"，自适应切换神经草稿与上下文复制两类推测解码策略，在Llama与Qwen系列上相较EAGLE3等最优基线提升吞吐量最多15%。
AI.motivation: 现有推测解码（SD）在两种草稿策略间存在根本性权衡：神经草稿（如EAGLE3）在不同文本场景下表现稳健，而基于复制的方法在复制密集场景中因候选生成更快、可利用长重复片段实现近乎完美的推测而获得更高加速。但作者发现现有复制方法易产生"偶然重复"——表层n-gram重叠并不反映结构性复制意图，导致误触发，反而降低吞吐量。
AI.method: 提出SwitchSD自适应框架，将"复制"视为LLM的潜在控制信号。在目标模型内部表示上训练轻量级探针，以高精度（AUC>0.99）识别真实复制意图，据此在神经草稿（如EAGLE）与上下文字符串复制之间动态切换。
AI.result: 在Llama和Qwen系列模型上，相较EAGLE3等当前最优基线，吞吐量提升最高达15%。
AI.conclusion: SwitchSD将复制从一种噪声启发式规则转变为有原则、模型感知的解码范式，在保持神经草稿广覆盖能力的同时，精准捕捉复制密集场景的加速收益。

title: AgriScope: Pixel-Grounded Multimodal Understanding for Agricultural Images
summary: Agricultural image understanding requires fine-grained recognition of plant diseases, pests, crop structures, and botanical species under complex real-world conditions. Despite recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), existing models remain limited to text-only outputs and lack pixel-level visual grounding capabilities. In this work, we introduce AgriScope, a unified pixel-grounded multimodal framework for agricultural image understanding. AgriScope jointly supports image-level, region-level, and pixel-level understanding within a unified framework, enabling tasks such as grounded caption generation, referring expression segmentation, and multi-turn multimodal interaction for agricultural imagery. AgriScope integrates biologically specialized semantic representations with dense spatial grounding through biological-semantic encoding, dense spatial representations, and pixel decoding. To support large-scale grounded learning, we introduce AgriGround, a large-scale pixel-grounded agricultural multimodal instruction-tuning dataset containing over 500K images and 11M instruction-following samples spanning plant disease analysis, crop and weed identification, insect pest recognition, and fine-grained botanical understanding. AgriGround is constructed through a multi-stage automatic annotation pipeline that integrates multimodal caption generation, phrase-level grounding, segmentation mask generation, and task-oriented instruction synthesis to produce densely grounded supervision. Extensive experiments across multiple agricultural vision-language tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of AgriScope in pixel-grounded multimodal understanding, establishing a strong benchmark for agricultural vision-language learning and visual grounding. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at (https://github.com/boudiafA/AgriScope)

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgriScope——一个面向农业图像理解的统一像素级多模态框架，同时支持图像级、区域级和像素级理解，并构建了大规模像素级农业多模态指令微调数据集AgriGround（50万+图像、1100万样本）。
AI.motivation: 农业图像理解需要在复杂真实条件下对植物病害、害虫、作物结构和植物物种进行细粒度识别。尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）取得进展，但现有模型仅支持纯文本输出，缺乏像素级视觉定位（visual grounding）能力。
AI.method: AgriScope通过生物语义编码（biological-semantic encoding）、稠密空间表示（dense spatial representations）和像素解码（pixel decoding），将生物学专门化语义表示与稠密空间定位相结合，在统一框架内联合支持图像级、区域级与像素级理解，可完成接地式描述生成（grounded caption）、指代表达分割（referring expression segmentation）和多轮多模态交互。同时提出AgriGround数据集，通过多阶段自动标注流水线（多模态描述生成、短语级接地、分割掩码生成、任务导向指令合成）构建稠密接地监督。
AI.result: AgriGround包含50万+图像和1100万条指令跟随样本，覆盖植物病害分析、作物与杂草识别、害虫识别和细粒度植物理解。在多个农业视觉-语言任务上的大量实验验证了AgriScope在像素级多模态理解方面的有效性，为农业视觉-语言学习与视觉定位建立了强基准。
AI.conclusion: AgriScope实现了统一的像素级农业多模态理解，显著推进了农业视觉-语言学习与视觉定位研究，数据集与代码将公开于 https://github.com/boudiafA/AgriScope。

title: FreqDINO++: A Frequency-Guided Multi-Task Routing Vision Foundation Model for Universal Ultrasound Analysis
summary: Ultrasound image analysis plays a crucial role in cancer screening and prenatal diagnosis, yet comprehensive assessment requires jointly addressing tasks such as lesion segmentation and benign-malignant classification. While recent vision foundation models have shown remarkable universal representations, unlocking their potential for ultrasound is bottlenecked by the considerable domain gap from natural images. Existing methods typically fine-tune heavy vision encoders for isolated tasks, incurring substantial computational overhead while overlooking the underlying commonalities across heterogeneous tasks. In this work, we propose FreqDINO++, a frequency-guided multi-task routing vision foundation model for universal ultrasound analysis. We first introduce a Multi-task Routing Adapter (MR-Adapter) to support parameter-efficient integration of task-common and task-specific knowledge, a Frequency-aware Feature Enhancer (F$^2$-Enhancer) is then designed to capture the rich multi-scale frequency characteristics of ultrasound images, and a Task-aligned Collaborative Decoder (TC-Decoder) is devised to promote collaboration between dense and global prediction tasks through global-local token interaction. Extensive experiments on large-scale multi-task and external single-task ultrasound benchmarks demonstrate that FreqDINO++ consistently outperforms strong baselines and recent foundation models across 27 diverse clinical task scenarios, while also showing promising generalization to unseen data. The code is at https://github.com/MingLang-FD/FreqDINO-Plus.

AI.tldr: 提出FreqDINO++，一种频率引导的多任务路由视觉基础模型，用于通用超声图像分析，通过MR-Adapter、F²-Enhancer和TC-Decoder实现参数高效的多任务知识整合与频率特征增强，在27个临床任务场景中超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 超声图像分析需同时处理病灶分割与良恶性分类等多项任务，但视觉基础模型在自然图像与超声之间存在显著域差距；现有方法通常为重编码器针对单一任务进行微调，计算开销大且忽视了异构任务间的共性。
AI.method: 1) Multi-task Routing Adapter (MR-Adapter)：参数高效整合任务共性与任务特异性知识；2) Frequency-aware Feature Enhancer (F²-Enhancer)：捕获超声图像丰富的多尺度频率特征；3) Task-aligned Collaborative Decoder (TC-Decoder)：通过全局-局部token交互促进密集与全局预测任务协作。
AI.result: 在大规模多任务及外部单任务超声基准测试中，FreqDINO++在27个不同临床任务场景中一致优于强基线和近期基础模型，并对未见数据展现出良好泛化能力。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: FreqDINO++为通用超声分析提供了参数高效、多任务协同的频率引导视觉基础模型方案，验证了跨异构任务共性建模与频域增强的有效性。

title: Fast Cross-Strength Multi-Contrast Brain MRI Translation using Latent Bridge Matching
summary: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) acquired at different field strengths exhibits pronounced variation in noise, resolution, homogeneity, and contrast, which limits comparability across acquisition settings and complicates downstream analysis. We address this with a unified conditional model for controllable field-to-field synthesis, built on the framework of conditional latent bridge matching. Our single model achieves highly competitive results across the validation phase for all three tasks of the MRIxFields2026 challenge without task-specific architectures or training. We achieve fast generation with only a single inference step, producing all modality and field-strength combinations for $30$ axial slices in under $90$ seconds, as well as cross-modality-strength translation for a full volume in under $70$ seconds, on a single NVIDIA A5000 GPU. We further provide extensive ablations regarding different components of our solution. Code: https://gitlab.com/siddharthsrivastava/mrixfields-2026

AI.tldr: 提出基于条件潜桥匹配的统一条件模型，实现跨场强MRI的可控合成，单一模型在MRIxFields2026三项任务中均取得有竞争力结果，单步推理即可快速生成。
AI.motivation: 不同场强下采集的MRI在噪声、分辨率、均匀性和对比度上差异显著，限制了跨采集设置的可比性并增加下游分析难度。现有方法通常依赖任务特定架构或训练，泛化性与效率不足。
AI.method: 在条件潜桥匹配（conditional latent bridge matching）框架下构建统一条件模型，用于可控的场强到场强合成；无需任务特定架构或专门训练，采用单步推理生成。
AI.result: 单一模型在MRIxFields2026挑战验证阶段三项任务上均取得具竞争力结果；在单张NVIDIA A5000 GPU上，30张轴位切片的所有模态与场强组合生成耗时<90秒，全容积跨模态-场强转换<70秒。并提供针对各组成部分的广泛消融实验。
AI.conclusion: 统一的桥匹配条件生成模型可高效、可控地完成跨场强MRI合成，验证了单模型多任务泛化与单步快速推理的可行性；代码已开源。

title: EliGSiR: Continual RGB-D Mapping with Gaussian Splatting under Bounded Compute
summary: Conventional 3D Gaussian Splatting assumes a closed set of observations and long optimization schedules. Continual RGB-D mapping in contrast poses the problem that new observations arrive online, while previously reconstructed regions must be preserved. We present EliGSiR (Evidence-guided Load-adaptive Incremental Gaussian Splatting with Image Replay), a continual Gaussian mapper that controls how the available optimization budget is used as the reconstruction evolves. Map-Guided View Scheduling filters redundant incoming views and reconsiders retained views according to the current state of the map. Load-Adaptive Fidelity adjusts supervision resolution to the current mapping load instead of following a fixed resolution schedule. Targeted Geometry Growth separates depth supervision from Gaussian creation and adds geometric capacity only where repeated RGB-D observations indicate missing or misplaced structure. Together, these mechanisms adapt which views are optimized, how much image detail is used, and where the representation grows while mapping remains active. We evaluate EliGSiR on Replica, TUM RGB-D, ScanNet++, and real RGB-D sensor sequences, considering both the final reconstruction and the map available throughout acquisition. On TUM RGB-D fr3/long_office_household, EliGSiR reaches 21.52 dB with the same ground-truth mapping poses used by the controlled baselines, compared with 19.42 dB for SplaTAM. In the tracked-pose comparison, EliGSiR with live ORB-SLAM3 poses reaches 23.02 dB in 155.5 s, compared with 20.10 dB in 230.9 s for CaRtGS using its native tracker. We further evaluate reconstruction throughout acquisition and show how EliGSiR adaptive view scheduling, supervision fidelity, and geometry growth improve the use of the available mapping budget.

AI.tldr: EliGSiR：面向在线RGB-D连续建图的负载自适应增量高斯泼溅，通过地图引导视角调度、负载自适应保真度与定向几何增长控制优化预算，在多数据集上取得更优重建质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 传统3D高斯泼溅假设观测集合封闭且优化调度长，无法应对连续RGB-D建图中新观测在线到达、同时需保留已重建区域的问题，因此需要一种能在建图持续进行时动态控制优化预算的连续高斯建图方法。
AI.method: 提出EliGSiR，包含三个机制：1）Map-Guided View Scheduling：过滤冗余新视角，并依据当前地图状态重新考虑保留视角；2）Load-Adaptive Fidelity：根据当前建图负载调整监督分辨率，而非固定分辨率调度；3）Targeted Geometry Growth：将深度监督与高斯创建解耦，仅在重复RGB-D观测指示结构缺失或错位的区域增加几何容量。
AI.result: 在Replica、TUM RGB-D、ScanNet++及真实RGB-D传感器序列上评估，兼顾最终重建与采集过程中的地图。在TUM RGB-D fr3/long_office_household上，使用与受控基线相同的地图真值位姿时达21.52 dB，优于SplaTAM的19.42 dB；在跟踪位姿对比中，EliGSiR使用实时ORB-SLAM3位姿于155.5 s达23.02 dB，而CaRtGS使用其原生跟踪器为230.9 s达20.10 dB。
AI.conclusion: EliGSiR通过自适应视角调度、监督保真度和几何增长，提升了采集全程可用建图预算的利用效率，在重建质量和速度上均优于现有连续建图基线。

title: MM-Future: Multi-Mode Joint World-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving involves coupled decision-making and scene evolution under multi-mode uncertainty. To capture this coupling and uncertainty, we introduce MM-Future, a world-action model that generates multiple paired scene-action hypotheses and models bidirectional interaction within each pair. Each hypothesis is initialized from a structured action prior and an independent future scene source, which are then co-evolved through a modality-aware diffusion Transformer. To support efficient multi-mode rollout, MM-Future compresses multi-view video into planning-oriented representations, dubbed MM-Tokens. Finally, a future-conditioned proposal scorer ranks trajectory candidates by shared history context and their paired predicted future. On NAVSIM navtest, MM-Future achieves 94.0 PDMS and 91.5 EPDMS, while attaining a 32.3 HD-Score in zero-shot closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. Ablations show consistent improvements over both single-mode and action-only variants, validating the benefit of multi-mode joint world-action modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出MM-Future世界-动作模型，通过多模态配对假设和双向交互实现自动驾驶中决策与场景演化的联合建模。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶中决策与场景演化存在耦合，且处于多模态不确定性下，现有方法难以同时捕捉这种耦合与不确定性。
AI.method: 1) 生成多个配对的场景-动作假设，每个假设由结构化动作先验与独立未来场景源初始化，并通过模态感知扩散Transformer协同演化，实现配对内双向交互；2) 将多视角视频压缩为面向规划的表示MM-Tokens以支持高效多模态展开；3) 使用未来条件化的提议评分器，结合共享历史上下文与配对预测未来对轨迹候选进行排序。
AI.result: NAVSIM navtest上达到94.0 PDMS和91.5 EPDMS；HUGSIM零样本闭环评估中HD-Score为32.3。消融实验显示相比单模态和仅动作变体均有稳定提升，验证了多模态联合世界-动作建模的优势。
AI.conclusion: 多模态联合世界-动作建模能有效应对自动驾驶中的耦合决策与场景演化问题，显著提升规划性能。

title: Compact Vision Models for Iris Presentation Attack Detection under Presentation Attack Instrument Shift and Environmental Degradation
comment: Accepted at BIOSIG 2026. This preprint includes minor nomenclature and editorial corrections clarifying the project-specific Patch-ABMIL and Compact-TransMIL variants
summary: Iris presentation attack detection (PAD) is security-critical when a subsystem that appears reliable during development encounters presentation attack instruments (PAIs) or acquisition conditions absent from validation data. We benchmark three compact scratch-trained computer-vision models, each with at most approximately 0.26 million trainable parameters, on the Notre Dame subset of LivDet-Iris 2017 under PAI-driven domain shift and environmental degradation. All models are trained without external pretraining or data augmentation and evaluated over five seeds. A validation-selected threshold is transferred unchanged to the known-attack, unknown-attack, corrupted, and pooled test partitions. From known to unknown attack presentations, Attack Presentation Classification Error Rate (APCER) increases by 17.11-30.47 percentage points and Detection Equal Error Rate (D-EER) increases by 7.38-12.73 percentage points. At the validation-selected threshold, ZACH-ViT obtains the lowest unknown-attack APCER (47.69 +/- 4.84%) and D-EER (38.87 +/- 0.93%), while Compact-TransMIL obtains the lowest Bona Fide Presentation Classification Error Rate (BPCER). ZACH-ViT also gives the lowest unknown-attack BPCER at an APCER limit of 10% (81.29 +/- 1.95%). The high absolute errors show that the comparative advantage of the best compact model does not constitute deployment readiness under unknown PAIs.

AI.tldr: 该文在LivDet-Iris 2017未发现的PAI攻击与图像退化条件下，基准测试三个≤0.26M参数的小型从头训练CV模型，发现从已知到未知攻击时APCER与D-EER显著上升，最优模型ZACH-ViT仍远未达到部署就绪标准。
AI.motivation: 虹膜呈现攻击检测（PAD）在部署中常遇到开发验证阶段未见过的攻击仪（PAI）与采集条件，存在PAI驱动的域偏移与环境退化风险；需评估紧凑型模型在未知攻击下是否具备实用可靠性。
AI.method: 在LivDet-Iris 2017的Notre Dame子集上基准测试三个紧凑、从头训练的计算机视觉模型（每个≤约0.26M可训练参数），不使用外部预训练与数据增强，5个随机种子评估；将验证集选定阈值原样迁移到已知攻击、未知攻击、退化图像及合并测试分区。
AI.result: 从已知到未知攻击，APCER上升17.11–30.47个百分点，D-EER上升7.38–12.73个百分点；在验证选定阈值下，ZACH-ViT获得最低未知攻击APCER（47.69±4.84%）与D-EER（38.87±0.93%），Compact-TransMIL获得最低BPCER；在APCER限制10%时，ZACH-ViT最低未知攻击BPCER为81.29±1.95%。
AI.conclusion: 最佳紧凑模型虽有相对比较优势，但绝对误差极高，在未知PAI条件下不具备部署就绪性；需更强泛化方法或更广训练分布。

title: Navi-Agent: Unlocalized Monocular Navigation Agent
summary: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an embodied agent to execute long-horizon instructions in unknown environments. Existing zero-shot VLN-CE systems typically maintain spatial states through geometric localization or coordinate-based representations. Recent geometry-constrained navigation removes depth and globally consistent coordinates, but maintaining persistent spatial awareness for place confirmation, progress verification, and recovery remains challenging. We present Navi-Agent, a zero-shot VLN-CE agent that constructs a coordinate-free spatial state from visual observations and executed motion histories. Navi-Agent organizes this state as a navigation topology, where nodes represent visual places and edges represent motion transitions.
