Existing methods address specific anomaly categories or stop at localization, leaving a gap between detection and actionable information. Here we present ESIA, an Earth Surface Immune System whose architecture is constrained by three principles from the biological immune system, refined over millions of years against equally diverse and uncertain threats. A non-specific innate immune stage treats anomalies as unobserved changes in time-series satellite imagery, generating binary localization maps at 14.51 km2/s without assuming any anomaly category, surpassing the strongest general baseline by 37% in F1. A specific adaptive immune stage applies negative selection to filter text prompts and matches surviving prompts with localized image patches through a multi-modal foundation model, enabling open-vocabulary recognition of unknown anomaly attributes including category, affected area, and damage severity, with recognition F1 exceeding 80%. A mutation mechanism tunes minimal embeddings at test time, adapting to each scene in 3.26s using a single reference image pair. We validate ESIA on a global-scale dataset covering 19,801.60 km2 across six anomaly categories, comparing against 22 models, and further apply it to quantify degraded farmland in the Dnipro Delta following the Kakhovka Dam collapse and assess burn severity from 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles. This unprecedented flexibility in handling unknown anomalies opens new avenues for real-time disaster response and environmental surveillance.

AI.tldr: ESIA借鉴生物免疫系统三层机制（先天免疫定位、适应性免疫开放词汇识别、突变机制测试时微调），实现地表异常从检测到可行动信息的端到端处理。
AI.motivation: 地表异常因气候变化和人类活动而频率与多样性上升，但历史数据匮乏、不可预测，与常规遥感目标本质不同；现有方法仅针对特定类别或止步于定位，检测与可行动信息之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出ESIA架构，受三层生物免疫原则约束：1）非特异性先天免疫阶段，将异常视为时序卫星影像中的未观测变化，生成二值定位图，速度14.51 km²/s，不预设异常类别；2）特异性适应性免疫阶段，用负选择过滤文本提示，并将存活提示与定位图像块经多模态基础模型匹配，实现未知异常属性（类别、受灾面积、损害程度）的开放词汇识别；3）突变机制在测试时微调极少量嵌入，仅用一对参考图像在3.26s内适配每个场景。
AI.result: 在覆盖六大异常类别、19,801.60 km²的全球尺度数据集上验证，与22个模型对比：定位F1比最强通用基线高37%，识别F1超80%，单场景适配3.26s；并应用于卡霍夫卡大坝坍塌后第聂伯河三角洲退化农田量化及2025年洛杉矶帕利塞兹火灾烧伤严重度评估。
AI.conclusion: ESIA在无需预设异常类别的前提下实现定位与开放词汇识别，展现出对未知异常的前所未有的灵活性，为实时灾害响应与环境监测开辟新途径。

title: Learning Foresight without Explicit Trajectories for 3D Diffusion Policies
summary: 3D diffusion policies are strong at generating geometrically grounded actions from current observations, but successful manipulation requires not only knowing what motion is feasible now, but also anticipating where the interaction is heading. Existing policies largely leave such foresight to emerge implicitly from action learning. We introduce Movement Trend Guidance, a simple but effective way to provide this foresight without introducing an explicit plan. From a short observation history, the policy learns a compact latent representation of interaction evolution. During training, sparse future gripper states supervise this representation; at inference, only the latent is retained as future-oriented conditioning alongside the current observation. The latent provides global conditioning for action generation, while an additional gated FiLM branch is used only at the UNet bottleneck. Despite adding only 3.52% more parameters to DP3, our method preserves the original dense-action and receding-horizon formulation and consistently improves upon DP3 across RoboTwin2.0, LIBERO-40, and DexArt. It reaches 62.8% vs. 56.1% in 50-task RoboTwin2.0 mixed training, 71.93% vs. 37.08% on LIBERO-40, and 72.0% vs. 49.0% on five real-robot tasks. These results show that a diffusion policy can benefit substantially from knowing where an interaction is heading, without being told exactly where to move.

AI.tldr: 提出 Movement Trend Guidance，通过从短历史中学习交互演化的隐表示来为 3D 扩散策略提供前瞻性条件，仅增加 3.52% 参数即在多个基准和真机任务上显著超越 DP3。
AI.motivation: 3D 扩散策略能从当前观测生成几何可行的动作，但成功操作不仅需要知道"现在可行什么动作"，还需预判交互趋势。现有策略大多让这种前瞻性从动作学习中隐式涌现，缺乏显式引导。
AI.method: 从短观测历史中学习交互演化的紧凑隐表示；训练时用稀疏的未来夹爪状态监督该表示；推理时仅保留该隐表示作为面向未来的条件，与当前观测共同输入。隐表示提供全局条件，另加一个门控 FiLM 分支仅作用于 UNet 瓶颈层。方法保持原有稠密动作与滚动时域（receding-horizon）范式，不引入显式规划。
AI.result: 相较 DP3 仅增加 3.52% 参数。50 任务 RoboTwin2.0 混合训练中 62.8% vs 56.1%；LIBERO-40 上 71.93% vs 37.08%；五个真机任务上 72.0% vs 49.0%。
AI.conclusion: 扩散策略可显著受益于"知道交互将走向何处"，而无需被告知具体该移动到哪，验证了隐式前瞻条件对 3D 扩散策略的有效性。

title: FunArt: Decoding Functional Structure and Articulation from Generative 3D Latents
summary: To operate effectively in human environments, robots must identify articulated objects, segment their movable and interactive parts, and estimate their kinematic models. Existing articulated scene representations typically recover kinematics from observed interactions, while methods operating on static scans often decouple articulation from functional interactive elements. We present FunArt, a framework that constructs articulation-aware functional 3D scene graphs from posed RGB-D observations captured in a single static configuration. FunArt reconstructs object instances, converts their fused geometry directly into the O-Voxel representation of TRELLIS.2, and exploits its frozen, sparse-compression VAE as a structural prior. A lightweight query-based decoder combines compact object-level latents with dense, surface-aligned features to jointly segment movable parts and functional interactive elements while estimating motion type, axis, origin, and range. On the Articulate3D dataset, FunArt achieves state-of-the-art performance across movable-part segmentation, articulation estimation, and functional-element segmentation, both with and without ground-truth object input. In the end-to-end setting, it outperforms the strongest baselines by 1.5 AP_{50} points for movable parts, 2.8 AP_{50} points under joint origin-and-axis constraints, and 6.7 AP_{50} points for functional elements. These results demonstrate that generative 3D latents encode actionable structural cues that can initialize robotic perception and planning before physical interaction.

AI.tldr: FunArt 从单次静态 RGB-D 观测构建关节感知的功能性 3D 场景图，利用 TRELLIS.2 的冻结稀疏压缩 VAE 作为结构先验，统一分割可动部件与功能交互元素并估计运动学模型，在 Articulate3D 上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人需识别铰接物体、分割可动与交互部件并估计运动学模型才能在人类环境中有效作业。现有方法多依赖观测到的交互来恢复运动学，而基于静态扫描的方法往往将关节结构与功能性交互元素割裂处理，无法在物理交互之前获得可行动的结构信息。
AI.method: FunArt 从单一静态配置下的位姿 RGB-D 观测出发，重建物体实例，将其融合几何直接转换为 TRELLIS.2 的 O-Voxel 表示，并利用其冻结的稀疏压缩 VAE 作为结构先验；采用轻量级 query-based 解码器，将紧凑的物体级 latent 与稠密、贴合表面的特征结合，联合分割可动部件与功能交互元素，同时估计运动类型、轴、原点与范围。
AI.result: 在 Articulate3D 数据集上，无论是否输入真值物体，FunArt 在可动部件分割、关节估计和功能元素分割三方面均达到 SOTA。端到端设置下，可动部件提升 1.5 AP_{50}，联合原点与轴约束下提升 2.8 AP_{50}，功能元素提升 6.7 AP_{50}。
AI.conclusion: 生成式 3D latent 编码了可行动的结构线索，可在物理交互之前初始化机器人感知与规划。

title: Towards Scaling Marine Perception with Synthetic Data
summary: Scalable machine learning in challenging underwater environments is strongly limited by the lack of labeled real-world training data. This data is often expensive and laborious to gather, making large-scale real-world data challenging to gather and curate. However, simulated data can help close the gap, enabling many learning-based tasks for underwater perception. In this work, we extend OceanSim, an IsaacSim-based underwater perception simulator, with a Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) pipeline for training models to be used in underwater scenarios. The proposed pipeline enables users to generate large, automatically labeled, photorealistic datasets with configurable scene appearance, structure, and sensor settings. We evaluate the pipeline on a real-world sea urchin detection task and study how different forms of synthetic scene variation affect sim-to-real performance. Based on these experiments, we discuss findings on our results, main limitations of the current pipeline and identify future directions for improving underwater rendering fidelity, scene diversity, and the evaluation of sim-to-real generalization. The open-source code can be found at https://github.com/umfieldrobotics/OceanSim.

AI.tldr: 该工作扩展了基于IsaacSim的水下感知模拟器OceanSim，新增合成数据生成（SDG）流程，可生成大规模、自动标注、照片级真实感的水下数据集，并在真实海胆检测任务中验证了其sim-to-real有效性。
AI.motivation: 水下环境下的可扩展机器学习受限于真实标注数据的匮乏：真实数据采集与整理成本高、耗时费力，难以大规模获取。因此希望借助仿真数据弥合这一数据鸿沟，支撑水下感知的学习任务。
AI.method: 在IsaacSim-based的水下感知模拟器OceanSim基础上，扩展一套合成数据生成（SDG）pipeline。该流程支持用户生成大规模、自动标注、photorealistic的数据集，并可配置场景外观、结构与传感器设置。
AI.result: 在真实世界的海胆（sea urchin）检测任务上评估该pipeline，并系统研究了不同形式的合成场景变化（scene variation）对sim-to-real性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 基于实验结果讨论了主要发现与当前pipeline的局限性，并指出未来方向：提升水下渲染保真度、增强场景多样性、以及改进sim-to-real泛化能力的评估。代码已在 https://github.com/umfieldrobotics/OceanSim 开源。

title: HerHealthEval: Evaluating Multilingual and Register-Sensitive Understanding of Women's Health Communication
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to the 2026 International Conference on Large Language Models (LLM 2026)
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in healthcare communication, yet most evaluations emphasize response quality while assuming that the user's concern has been interpreted correctly. We introduce HerHealthEval, a controlled evaluation framework for multilingual understanding of women's-health communication. For each clinical case, HerHealthEval provides matched versions in English, French, and Modern Standard Arabic using six communicative forms: canonical, clinical, layperson, indirect or hedged, emotionally concerned, and deliberately under-specified. The first five express the same underlying concern and retain the same clinical information, whereas the under-specified form intentionally omits relevant details to test whether the model recognizes that clarification is needed. We evaluate a multilingual instruction model and QLoRA-adapted variants on concern classification, risk calibration, clarification behavior, parse compliance, and cross-form consistency. Results reveal that aggregate accuracy and consistency can conceal safety-relevant failures. A multilingual adaptation model reaches 0.994 under-triage in French and Arabic under language-asymmetric risk supervision. A controlled re-adaptation using source-derived, language-invariant risk labels reduces under-triage to 0.572 and 0.558, respectively. These findings show that robust multilingual healthcare evaluation requires explicit testing of register variation, uncertainty handling, and the provenance and invariance of adaptation labels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HerHealthEval，一个用于评估多语言女性健康沟通理解能力的受控评测框架，通过六种沟通形式（含刻意信息不足形式）在英语、法语和现代标准阿拉伯语间进行配对测试。实验发现聚合准确率与一致性会掩盖安全相关失败：在多语言适配模型中，法语和阿拉伯语的分诊不足率高达 0.994，而使用源语言导出的语言不变风险标签再适配后可降至 0.572 和 0.558。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在医疗沟通中应用日益广泛，但多数评测聚焦于回答质量，默认模型已正确理解用户诉求，忽视了语域差异、不确定性表达以及用户信息不完整等实际场景中可能导致的安全风险。此外，多语言医疗场景下风险标签的来源与不变性缺乏检验，容易产生被聚合指标掩盖的分诊失败。
AI.method: 构建 HerHealthEval 受控评测框架：对每个临床案例提供英语、法语、现代标准阿拉伯语的配对版本，覆盖六种沟通形式——规范化、临床化、通俗化、间接/模糊化、情绪化关切以及刻意信息不足；前五种传达相同底层关切并保留相同临床信息，信息不足形式则有意省略细节以检验模型是否识别出需要澄清。在多语言指令模型及 QLoRA 适配变体上评估关切分类、风险校准、澄清行为、解析合规性与跨形式一致性。
AI.result: 聚合准确率与一致性未能反映安全相关失败。在语言非对称风险监督下，多语言适配模型在法语和阿拉伯语中分诊不足率（under-triage）达到 0.994；改用源语言导出、语言不变的风险标签进行受控再适配后，分诊不足率分别降至 0.572 和 0.558。
AI.conclusion: 稳健的多语言医疗评测必须显式测试语域变异、不确定性处理，以及适配标签的来源与不变性；仅依赖聚合准确率与一致性指标会掩盖安全相关的分诊失败。

title: Should This Case Be Adapted? Prediction Fragmentation Controls Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Episodic test-time adaptation resets a frozen segmenter to source weights $M_0$ on each case and adapts for a fixed step count. A fixed horizon conflates a cohort-level question, how far to adapt, with an irreducibly per-case one, whether this case should be adapted at all. Cohort means hide that decision: on cross-vendor cardiac MRI the mean $Δ$Dice from adaptation is statistically indistinguishable from zero while 58.7% of cases are individually made worse. We quantify this harm as harmful accepted area (HA), the harmful fraction of the edited area a controller deploys. Held-out tuning gives a stronger baseline than a fixed horizon, but the budget it selects transfers on neither of the two main medical benchmarks, and no global budget can condition on the case. We show that prediction fragmentation---the disagreement geometry between $M_0$ and the adapted mask $M_k$---predicts HA with no labels or extra backward passes at decision time, comparably on three benchmarks (Spearman $ρ$ 0.50--0.60), at a quarter of gradient-norm's latency. A case-level router built on it cuts HA from 0.228 to 0.139 on a benchmark that took no part in its design, with the design frozen and only cut-points recalibrated there. On the cardiac benchmark the design was selected on, the router cuts HA from 0.129 to 0.013 at matched Dice and 1.10 deployed updates, against the retrospective-best budget found post hoc on evaluation labels, and reduces that 58.7% to 20.0%, an upper bound we quantify. Where the retained cases are not net-helped (as on prostate), the router still cuts HA but concedes accuracy, a boundary we report. Thresholds are fit once on a labeled split disjoint from evaluation; decisions use no labels or gradients. The template ports across architecture and domain (nnU-Net$\to$SegFormer, Cityscapes$\to$ACDC) with coordinate, thresholds and per-bucket actions instantiated per domain.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对医学图像分割的episodic test-time adaptation，指出固定适应步数混合了群体层面与个案层面的决策问题；提出有害接受面积（HA）度量，发现预测碎片化（M0与Mk的分歧几何）可无标签预测HA，并据此构建案例级路由器，在多个基准上显著降低HA。
AI.motivation: 固定适应步数（fixed horizon）将"应适应多远"这一群体问题与"该案例是否应适应"这一个案问题混为一谈，导致组均值掩盖了适应对众多个案的损害：跨厂商心脏MRI上ΔDice均值与零无显著差异，但58.7%的案例被单独变差。留出集调参的更强基线所选的预算在两个主要医学基准上均无法迁移，且任何全局预算都无法以个案为条件。因此需要一种案例级、无需标签的损害预测与决策机制。
AI.method: 1) 以"有害接受面积"（HA）量化控制器所部署编辑面积中的有害比例；2) 提出"预测碎片化"——冻结源模型M0与适应后掩膜Mk之间的分歧几何；3) 验证碎片化在无标签、无额外反向传播条件下预测HA（三个基准Spearman ρ 0.50–0.60），延迟仅为梯度范数的四分之一；4) 基于碎片化构建案例级路由器，阈值在独立于评估的标注划分上拟合一次，决策时不使用标签或梯度；5) 模板可跨架构与领域移植（nnU-Net→SegFormer, Cityscapes→ACDC），坐标、阈值与分桶动作按领域实例化。
AI.result: 路由器在设计未参与的基准上将HA从0.228降至0.139（仅重校准切点）；在心脏基准（设计选择所用集）上以匹配Dice和1.10次部署更新将HA从0.129降至0.013，对照事后在评估标签上找到的回顾最优预算，并将58.7%的受损案例降至20.0%（经量化的上界）；在前列腺等保留案例非净获益的场景下，路由器仍降HA但让出精度，作者报告了这一边界。
AI.conclusion: 案例级适应决策不能由全局预算替代；预测碎片化可作为无标签、低成本的HA代理指标，支撑可迁移的案例级路由器，在多个医学基准上显著减少适应带来的伤害，同时明确其适用边界（非净获益场景下需牺牲精度）。

title: Summarization Bias: The Directional Collapse of Objective Projection into Told-Mode Labels in Large Language Models --- A Conceptual Framework and Registered Test Protocol
comment: v1.1. 8 pages. Also archived at Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22817289
summary: This paper introduces and operationalizes summarization bias: a proposed systematic tendency of large language models (LLMs) to represent narrative meaning as an abstract summary label rather than as the reconstructable inferential structure that produces it. Within the Bulut Doctrine, narrative effect is theorized along a told-shown axis: in told mode, emotional and informational content is declared explicitly and requires little reader reconstruction; in shown mode, that content is suppressed at the surface and must be reconstructed from physical cues and indirection (Objective Projection). Shown mode is the higher-load condition the doctrine is designed to measure. The claim is that LLMs fail along this axis in a specific direction. Summarization bias is hypothesized to operate in two regimes: (i) a generative regime, in which a model asked to render an emotion through Objective Projection defaults to declaring it instead; and (ii) an evaluative regime, in which a model judging narrative quality rewards told-mode explicitness and under-detects shown-mode suppression. The evaluative regime is the more consequential, since LLMs increasingly serve as judges and reward models, and a directional bias toward told mode would impose a selection pressure degrading prose toward flat declaration. This report does not claim the bias is validated. It defines the construct, situates it against LLM-as-judge biases, rereads a completed independent reliability study as directional evidence consistent with it, and pre-registers a two-regime test with decision rules under which the construct would be abandoned.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并操作化"摘要偏向"(summarization bias)：大语言模型倾向于将叙事意义表示为抽象摘要标签，而非可重建的推断结构。该偏向被假设存在于生成与评估两种机制，其中评估机制因LLM作为评委而更具后果性。
AI.motivation: LLM日益充当评委与奖励模型，若其存在朝向"讲述模式"(told mode)的方向性偏好，将对文风施加选择压力，使散文趋向扁平化的直白陈述。作者试图在大规模评测之前先界定构念并提供可证伪的检验框架。
AI.method: 在Bulut Doctrine框架下，将叙事效果理论化为"讲述—展示"(told-shown)轴：讲述模式显性声明情感与信息，展示模式则在表层抑制内容、需通过物理线索与间接性(Objective Projection)重建。作者界定概念，将其与LLM-as-judge的既有偏向对照，重新解读一项已完成的独立信度研究作为方向性证据，并预注册双机制检验及放弃该构念的判定规则。
AI.result: 作者明确声明该偏向尚未被验证。已完成的独立信度研究仅被重读为与该构念一致的方向性证据，尚不构成确认性证据。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献在于提出可证伪的理论构念与预注册检验设计，而非实证结论。若预注册的判定规则触发，该构念将被放弃。

title: Don't Mask the Environment: Observation Supervision Changes How Agents Explore Under RL
summary: Agent trajectories record what an agent does and what happens next. Yet standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) applies loss only to agent-authored action tokens, using environment observations as context but not as prediction targets. We ask whether this convention provides the best initialization for subsequent reinforcement learning. We introduce ActObs, which also supervises the observation tokens already present in each trajectory. Although deployed agents never generate observations, learning to predict them encourages the policy to model action consequences without adding data, parameters, sequence tokens, or forward passes. The methods perform similarly after SFT but diverge after GRPO. On Qwen3-4B, GRPO from ActObs achieves higher pass@k at every evaluated sampling budget than its action-only counterpart on Terminal-Bench 2.0. On Qwen3-8B, it trades some pass@1 reliability for higher pass@k (+3.4 pp at pass@16) and solves more distinct tasks. The advantage extends to cross-domain code editing on aider-polyglot (+4.2 pp at pass@1 at 4B), whose tasks are unseen during SFT and RL. ActObs retains more entropy during RL while requiring less policy movement, leaving the final policy closer to its SFT initialization. Our analysis traces this difference to SFT: action and observation gradients rapidly become orthogonal, while action-only training leaves a large residual observation gradient and degrades environment prediction below the base model. Joint supervision prevents this one-sided specialization, preserving consequence prediction and preparing the policy for downstream exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出ActObs，在SFT阶段同时对轨迹中的动作token与环境观测token施加监督，使策略学习"预测动作后果"，无需额外数据、参数、序列token或前向传播；该方法为后续GRPO提供更优初始化，在Terminal-Bench 2.0与aider-polyglot上提升pass@k。
AI.motivation: 标准SFT仅在agent生成的动作token上计算损失，将环境观测仅作为上下文而不作为预测目标。作者质疑这一惯例是否为后续强化学习提供了最优初始化，希望在不增加任何开销的前提下让策略更好地建模动作后果。
AI.method: ActObs在每条轨迹中不仅监督动作token，也对已存在的观测token施加监督，从而促使策略学习预测行动后果。该方法不引入额外数据、参数、序列token或前向传播。作者将其与仅监督动作的基线在SFT和后续GRPO训练中进行对比，并通过梯度分析考察动作与观测梯度的关系。
AI.result: SFT后两种方法表现相近，但GRPO后出现分化。Qwen3-4B上，ActObs经GRPO在每个评估采样预算下pass@k均高于仅动作基线（Terminal-Bench 2.0）；Qwen3-8B上以一定pass@1可靠性换取更高pass@k（pass@16提升3.4 pp）并解决更多不同任务。跨域代码编辑aider-polyglot上4B模型pass@1提升4.2 pp，而这些任务在SFT与RL中均未见过。ActObs在RL中保留更多熵、所需策略移动更少，最终策略更接近SFT初始化。
AI.conclusion: 差异根源在SFT：动作与观测梯度很快趋于正交，而仅动作训练会留下较大的观测梯度残差，并使环境预测能力退化到低于基座模型。联合监督避免了这种单边特化，保留了后果预测能力，为下游探索做好准备。

title: On-Demand Attention: Language Models Know When to Recall
summary: Reasoning and agentic workloads increasingly demand efficient long-context inference. Yet full-attention decoding reads the growing history at every step, although the benefit of global access varies across prediction positions. We find that, before global attention is computed for the current step, the decoding states available after local computation in frozen pretrained models already contain information predictive of its benefit over local attention. Building on this finding, we introduce On-Demand Attention (ODA), a local-first decoding method: after local computation, a lightweight recall head decides whether to recompute the current step with global attention. ODA trains only the recall head with modest data and compute budgets, leaving pretrained weights unchanged and retaining the complete historical KV cache so that information skipped at one step remains available for later access. Experiments across model scales and families, including hybrid attention backbones, show that ODA recovers most of the performance lost under local attention while substantially reducing the frequency of global attention. Controlled long-context measurements in vLLM further show that GPU-side conditional execution translates fewer global reads into practical decoding speedups over full attention. These findings show that pretrained decoding states can support both token prediction and decisions about accessing distant information, allowing models to allocate global computation as needed during decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出 On-Demand Attention (ODA)：一种“局部优先”的解码方法，利用冻结模型局部计算后的解码状态，通过轻量 recall head 判断是否需全局注意力重算，在保持预训练权重不变、保留完整 KV cache 的前提下，大幅降低全局注意力频率并恢复局部注意力损失的大部分性能。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理需求增长，但全注意力解码每步都要读取不断增长的历史 KV，开销大。而全局访问的收益因预测位置而异，并非每步都需要全局计算，因此存在按需分配全局注意力的优化空间。
AI.method: 基于“局部计算后的解码状态已含预测全局注意力收益的信息”这一发现，设计局部优先解码流程：先做局部计算，再由轻量 recall head 决策是否以全局注意力重算当前步。仅训练 recall head，数据与算力预算适中，预训练权重不变，并保留完整历史 KV cache，使某步跳过的信息后续仍可访问。
AI.result: 在多种模型规模与家族（含混合注意力骨干）上，ODA 恢复了局部注意力下损失的大部分性能，同时显著降低全局注意力触发频率。vLLM 中的受控长上下文测量表明，GPU 侧条件执行可将更少的全局读取转化为相对全注意力的实际解码加速。
AI.conclusion: 预训练解码状态既能支持 token 预测，也能支持“是否访问远距离信息”的决策，使模型可在解码过程中按需分配全局计算。

title: dQwen3.5: Hybrid-Attention Diffusion Language Models
summary: Adapting a pretrained autoregressive (AR) model is a cost-efficient route to a diffusion language model (DLM). While nearly all such adaptations start from a full-attention transformer, AR modeling has shifted toward hybrid architectures that interleave attention and RNN layers. This creates an obstacle for adaptation: unlike attention, RNNs are structurally causal and nontrivial to bidirectionalize. Despite this mismatch, we investigate whether such backbones can become effective DLMs by adapting Qwen3.5 at 0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 9B scales, yielding the dQwen3.5 family. We find that hybrid backbones can be efficient starting points for adaptation: against a full-attention control, the hybrid reaches a given training loss in about half the tokens. Across scales, dQwen3.5 resembles full-attention DLMs in any-order decoding behavior and performs strongly under parallel decoding.

AI.tldr: 将混合注意力-RNN自回归骨干（Qwen3.5）适配为扩散语言模型，构建dQwen3.5系列，验证其可作为高效适配起点。
AI.motivation: 现有从自回归模型适配扩散语言模型的方法几乎都基于全注意力Transformer，而AR建模趋势已转向交替堆叠注意力与RNN层的混合架构。RNN结构上具有因果性，难以双向化，这构成了适配障碍。本文探究此类混合骨干能否成为有效的扩散语言模型。
AI.method: 在0.8B、2B、4B、9B四个规模上对Qwen3.5混合骨干进行适配，得到dQwen3.5系列，并与全注意力对照模型进行比较，考察训练效率、任意顺序解码行为及并行解码性能。
AI.result: 相比全注意力对照模型，混合骨干达到相同训练损失所需token数约为其一半；跨规模上，dQwen3.5在任意顺序解码行为上与全注意力DLM相似，并在并行解码下表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: 尽管存在结构因果性带来的适配障碍，混合注意力-RNN骨干仍可作为扩散语言模型的高效适配起点。

title: OPTED: On-Policy Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Driving using a Render-Free Teacher
summary: As scaling pre-training data alone yields diminishing returns, post-training is becoming increasingly important across physical AI domains such as autonomous driving. End-to-end driving policies are pre-trained in open loop with behavior cloning on human demonstrations. However, compounding errors during closed-loop deployment can take the vehicle outside the training data distribution, increasing the risk of safety-critical incidents. Closed-loop post-training can mitigate this risk but requires costly simulation for sensor-based policies. We propose OPTED (on-policy fine-tuning for end-to-end driving) which decouples reinforcement learning from the post-training of the end-to-end policy: a privileged teacher is trained using RL on vectorized inputs (HD-map and bounding boxes). This teacher then provides supervision to the pre-trained student during closed-loop post-training. We apply OPTED to two camera-based models, TransFuser and VaVAM, and fine-tune them in AlpaSim, using neural reconstructions (3DGS) of real driving logs. Driving scores increase by factors of 1.6$\times$ and 9.5$\times$, respectively. In controlled experiments OPTED matches closed-loop performance with approximately three orders of magnitude fewer simulator interactions than direct RL post-training, while staying closer to the human prior. Project page: https://01dami23.github.io/opted/

AI.tldr: 提出OPTED，将强化学习与端到端驾驶策略的后训练解耦：用特权教师（向量化输入+RL训练）监督预训练学生模型进行闭环后训练，在AlpaSim中微调TransFuser与VaVAM，驾驶得分分别提升1.6倍和9.5倍，且比直接RL后训练减少约三个数量级的仿真交互。
AI.motivation: 仅靠扩大预训练数据收益递减，后训练在自动驾驶等物理AI领域愈发重要。端到端驾驶策略通常在开环下用行为克隆预训练，但闭环部署时误差累积会使车辆偏离训练分布，增加安全风险。闭环后训练可缓解该问题，但基于传感器的策略需要昂贵的仿真。
AI.method: OPTED将强化学习与端到端策略的后训练解耦：先在向量化输入（高精地图与边界框）上用RL训练一个特权教师模型；再由该教师在闭环后训练阶段对预训练的学生模型提供监督。作者将OPTED应用于两个相机模型TransFuser和VaVAM，在AlpaSim中利用真实驾驶日志的神经重建（3DGS）进行微调。
AI.result: 两个相机模型的驾驶得分分别提升1.6倍和9.5倍。在受控实验中，OPTED达到与直接RL后训练相当的闭环性能，同时仿真交互次数减少约三个数量级，并且更接近人类先验。
AI.conclusion: OPTED为基于传感器的端到端驾驶策略提供了一种高样本效率的闭环后训练方案，通过特权教师监督有效规避了直接RL的高仿真成本，同时保持与人类演示分布接近。

title: FlowSGS: Improving Flow Priors for Inverse Imaging with Stochastic Interpolants
summary: Flow matching has emerged as the state-of-the-art generative model and has been used for plug-and-play (PnP) priors to solve inverse problems in computational imaging. However, existing flow-based inverse solvers make simplifying approximations in posterior sampling and/or assume linear forward models. In contrast, principled diffusion-based methods exist but are computationally expensive. To circumvent these problems, we introduce FlowSGS, a flow-based posterior sampling method using Split Gibbs Sampling (SGS) with annealed coupling, and make flow-specific interventions to the prior sampling and annealing steps, theoretically grounded in the Stochastic Interpolants (SI) framework. Using a novel timestep correction and accelerated warm-up with one-step flow models, our method is faster and more accurate than the state of the art across a range of imaging problems. We demonstrate the first use of flow-based samplers for a nonlinear inverse problem (Fourier phase retrieval) and apply one-step flow models to principled Bayesian inverse imaging.

AI.tldr: FlowSGS：基于分裂吉布斯采样与退火耦合的流匹配后验采样方法，用于求解（含非线性）逆成像问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于流的逆问题求解器在后验采样中做了简化近似，且多假设前向模型为线性；而理论严谨的扩散类方法虽更通用却计算开销大。本文旨在兼顾精度、通用性与效率。
AI.method: 提出 FlowSGS，一种基于流的后验采样方法，采用分裂吉布斯采样（SGS）与退火耦合，并针对流模型对先验采样与退火步骤做专门改进，在随机插值（SI）框架下具有理论支撑；引入新颖的时间步校正（timestep correction）以及基于一步流模型的加速预热（accelerated warm-up）。
AI.result: 在多种成像问题上，方法比现有最优方法更快且更准确；首次将基于流的采样器用于非线性逆问题（傅里叶相位恢复）；并将一步流模型应用于有原则的贝叶斯逆成像。
AI.conclusion: FlowSGS 在随机插值理论框架下统一了流匹配后验采样与退火分裂吉布斯采样，克服了现有流方法的近似与线性限制，同时保持高效，拓展了流模型在非线性与贝叶斯逆成像中的应用。

title: Harm Laundering in GPT Models: Evidence That Gender Discrimination Is Transformed Rather Than Reduced Across Safety-Trained Generations
summary: Safety evaluations for large language models rely on surface-form classifiers that report declining harm scores across model generations. We provide evidence that this methodology is systematically incomplete: explicit discriminatory content is transformed rather than removed. We call this \emph{harm laundering}. Analysing 450,000 gender-directed completions across 15 models spanning GPT-2 through to GPT-5 (OpenAI GPT lineage; three demographic conditions), we show that sexual violence clusters prevalent in GPT-2 women-directed output disappear by GPT-4, while men-directed completions gain positive representational territory (caregiving, emotional range, ally identity) that women-directed completions do not. The pattern is most visible at GPT-5: Topic~5 (1,997~documents) frames breast cancer as a men's rights debate, while zero equivalent clusters appear in women-directed output. Three independent classifiers score this content as non-toxic. Sentiment scores invert at GPT-4: early models demean women; later models over-correct. Topic diversity in women-directed completions falls 36\% relative to men at the GPT-4 alignment boundary (W/M~$= 0.58$, from $0.91$ at GPT-2). REGARD representational harm disparity correlates with release date ($ρ= +0.55$, $p = .034$) while Detoxify does not ($ρ= -0.23$, $p = .42$): toxicity scores fall as representational harm grows. We formalise harm laundering as a three-criteria test and provide a three-stage detection protocol applicable to any generative model. Within the OpenAI GPT lineage, toxicity score reduction is not a sufficient proxy for harm reduction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"伤害洗白"概念,通过对GPT系列15个模型45万条性别定向补全的分析,证明显性歧视内容并未被移除而是被转化,毒性分数的下降并不代表伤害的减少。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型安全性评估依赖表层的分类器,报告跨模型代际的伤害分数持续下降。作者认为这种方法论存在系统性缺陷:显性歧视内容实际上是被转化而非被消除,需要揭示这一被忽视的机制。
AI.method: 分析15个模型(GPT-2至GPT-5)的45万条性别定向补全文本,涵盖三种人口统计条件;结合主题聚类、情感分析,并使用三个独立分类器和REGARD、Detoxify等指标,考察表征伤害与毒性分数随发布日期的相关关系;提出伤害洗白的三标准检验与三阶段检测协议。
AI.result: GPT-2中针对女性的性暴力聚类在GPT-4中消失,而针对男性的补全获得积极表征领域(照护、情感表达、盟友身份),女性补全则没有;GPT-5中Topic 5(1,997篇文档)将乳腺癌框定为男性权利议题,女性补全中无对应聚类,且三个分类器均判其为无毒。GPT-4处情感分数反转。女性补全的主题多样性在GPT-4对齐边界下降36%(W/M=0.58,GPT-2时为0.91)。REGARD表征伤害差异与发布日期的相关系数为ρ=+0.55(p=.034),Detoxify则为ρ=-0.23(p=.42),即毒性分数下降而表征伤害上升。
AI.conclusion: 在OpenAI GPT谱系内,毒性分数降低并不构成伤害减少的充分代理指标;作者将伤害洗白形式化为三标准检验,并提供适用于任意生成模型的三阶段检测协议。

title: RetireOPD: Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multi-turn agents trained with reinforcement learning (RL) receive a single scalar reward per trajectory, which motivates self on-policy distillation (OPD) to supply dense token-level supervision from a self-teacher with privileged task skills, letting a skill-free student internalize them. This recipe, however, is undermined by two findings in agentic tasks: privileged information alone does not always make a teacher reliable, and the benefit of teacher supervision is stage-dependent. We therefore propose RetireOPD (Self-Retiring On-Policy Distillation), which first optimizes a decoupled, skill-conditioned teacher with environment rewards and then trains a skill-free student jointly with RL and OPD. Rather than following a predefined distillation schedule, RetireOPD adopts Adaptive Retirement: the student drops the teacher on its own once their discrepancy stops shrinking and it reaches a target fraction of the teacher's success rate, after which training proceeds with RL alone. Across Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 7B, RetireOPD improves ALFWorld success rate over RL baseline by 14.1% to 18.8% and WebShop accuracy by 11.8% to 19.0%, and surpasses its own skill-conditioned teacher in every setting.

AI.tldr: 提出 RetireOPD，通过自适应"退休"机制在智能体任务中协同使用强化学习与自蒸馏，避免教师监督的负面效果。
AI.motivation: 多轮智能体的 RL 训练每条轨迹仅有一个标量奖励，监督稀疏；自蒸馏（OPD）虽可提供 token 级稠密监督，但在智能体任务中存在两个问题：仅凭特权信息并不总能保证教师可靠；教师监督的收益具有阶段性（stage-dependent）。
AI.method: RetireOPD 分两阶段：先用以环境奖励优化的、解耦的技能条件教师（skill-conditioned teacher）；再联合 RL 与 OPD 训练无技能学生。不采用预定义的蒸馏时间表，而是使用自适应退休（Adaptive Retirement）：当师生差异不再缩小且学生达到教师成功率的某一目标比例时，学生自行丢弃教师，之后仅用 RL 训练。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5 系列 1.5B 至 7B 模型上，ALFWorld 成功率较 RL 基线提升 14.1%–18.8%，WebShop 准确率提升 11.8%–19.0%，且在全部设置中均超过其自身的技能条件教师。
AI.conclusion: 教师监督应被视为阶段性资源而非全程信号；由学生依据师生差距与成功率阈值自主决定停止蒸馏，可稳定提升多轮智能体任务性能并超越教师。

title: Uncertainty-Aware RL-Controlled Adaptive 3D Mapping
comment: To appear at BMVC 2026. Code available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/UnRL
summary: Voxel-based volumetric mapping is fundamental to 3D reconstruction, yet fixed-resolution grids remain inherently inefficient - wasting memory in uniform regions and losing detail in complex ones. Existing adaptive methods, such as MAP-ADAPT, partially address this by varying resolution based on geometry and user-defined semantic class lists, but these heuristics require expert tuning, lack generalization to unseen objects, and provide no explicit mechanism to control memory usage. We propose an adaptive framework that refines voxels based on semantic entropy, which captures label uncertainty, together with geometric curvature and texture richness as scene complexity cues, yielding principled resolution allocation without reliance on semantic taxonomies. To make the accuracy-memory trade-off explicit and user-controlled, we further introduce a reinforcement learning agent that learns voxel subdivision policies under a user-specified target memory budget, replacing hand-tuned thresholds with a single intuitive control parameter. The resulting multi-resolution TSDF achieves higher geometric accuracy, better semantic consistency, and improved memory-accuracy trade-offs compared to MAP-ADAPT and fixed-resolution baselines on both synthetic and real-world datasets. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/alpayozkan/UnRL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于语义熵、几何曲率和纹理丰富度的自适应体素细分框架，并引入强化学习智能体在用户指定内存预算下学习细分策略，实现更优的精度-内存权衡。
AI.motivation: 固定分辨率体素建图存在内存效率问题：均匀区域浪费内存，复杂区域丢失细节。现有自适应方法（如MAP-ADAPT）依赖几何和用户定义的语义类别列表，需专家调参、缺乏对未见物体的泛化能力，且无法显式控制内存使用。
AI.method: 提出基于场景复杂度线索的自适应框架，利用语义熵（标签不确定性）、几何曲率和纹理丰富度决定体素细分，摆脱对语义分类体系的依赖；并引入强化学习智能体，在用户指定的目标内存预算下学习体素细分策略，用单一直观控制参数替代手工调参阈值，生成多分辨率TSDF。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上，多分辨率TSDF在几何精度、语义一致性以及内存-精度权衡方面均优于MAP-ADAPT和固定分辨率基线。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过无分类体系依赖的复杂度度量与内存预算约束下的强化学习细分策略，实现了用户可控的精度-内存权衡，提升了3D重建的自适应建图性能。代码与模型已开源。

title: JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds
summary: World modeling enables intelligence to anticipate consequences, guide interventions, and learn from interaction. Yet predictive models remain domain-specific: can a common learning principle support world modeling across radically different systems? We introduce JEPA-Anything, a domain-agnostic framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization (OPF). Extending joint-embedding predictive architectures, OPF decomposes latent targets into complementary factors, learns them through dedicated pathways, and recombines them within a shared predictive design. We evaluate JEPA-Anything across seven domains: vision, biology, clinical trajectories, control, molecular dynamics, physical fields, and weather. Experiments span representation learning, intervention prediction, out-of-distribution generalization, and long-horizon dynamics, including 10 matched dynamics tasks, forecasting of over 1,000 clinical events, and 100-step molecular rollouts across four systems. Against matched JEPA baselines, JEPA-Anything improves reported metrics on all 10 dynamics tasks and reduces single-intervention prediction error on Interventional Pong by 34.8%. It achieves the lowest one-step and 100-step molecular errors among compared methods in all four systems. Beyond prediction, a factor-nominated biological intervention receives experimental support in cell co-cultures, patient-derived organoids, tumor fragments, and mice; latent orbital modes recover the Keplerian scaling exponent with a fitted slope of -1.4991. These results support a common factorized predictive principle across heterogeneous worlds, connecting world modeling with intervention and experimentally grounded scientific discovery. Code: https://github.com/Gen-Verse/JEPA-Anything

AI.tldr: 提出领域无关的世界模型框架JEPA-Anything，基于正交预测分解（OPF）将潜变量目标分解为互补因子并共享预测设计，在七个异构领域一致提升预测与泛化性能，并获实验验证。
AI.motivation: 世界建模是智能体预测后果、指导干预与从交互中学习的基础，但现有预测模型高度领域特定，缺乏跨异质系统的通用学习原则。
AI.method: 提出JEPA-Anything框架与正交预测分解（OPF）：扩展联合嵌入预测架构，将潜变量目标分解为互补因子，通过专用通路分别学习，并在共享预测设计内重组。
AI.result: 在视觉、生物学、临床轨迹、控制、分子动力学、物理场和天气七个领域评估，涵盖表征学习、干预预测、分布外泛化与长时程动力学。相比匹配的JEPA基线，在10项动力学任务上全部提升，Interventional Pong单次干预预测误差降低34.8%；在四个分子系统中一步与100步误差均为最低；因子提名干预获细胞共培养、类器官、肿瘤片段与小鼠实验支持；潜轨道模态恢复开普勒标度指数，拟合斜率为-1.4991。
AI.conclusion: 因子化预测原则可跨异构世界通用，将世界建模与干预及实验驱动的科学发现相连接。

title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
summary: Coding harnesses shape how autonomous coding agents translate model capabilities into long-horizon software-engineering performance, yet existing work typically evaluates harnesses as monolithic systems, leaving the effectiveness of individual components unclear. To enable component-level comparisons, we study this question with a lightweight coding harness whose execution loop is fixed while three components are varied: planning, action space, and context management. Across four models evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.1, we evaluate 176 matched settings spanning five context-management strategies, four context-window budgets, and targeted ablations of planning and action space. We find that: (1) Context management becomes increasingly valuable as the context-window budget tightens, with most of its benefit coming from preventing context-overflow failures. (2) Staging rule-based elision before LLM-based summarization provides the strongest overall efficiency among the context-management strategies, whereas making elided content recoverable adds machinery that models rarely use and yields no accuracy gain. (3) Planning shifts from an accuracy scaffold for weaker models to a cost saver for stronger models, with little change in accuracy. (4) Predefined tools improve performance for models with weaker bash proficiency, whereas bash-capable models can operate effectively with a bash-only interface and achieve substantially lower cost, especially on command-line-centric tasks. Trajectory-level analysis explains these effects: context management extends execution trajectories without substantially altering agent behavior, planning changes where trajectories stop, and the action space changes the granularity at which code is written. These findings inform model- and budget-aware harness design and provide a modular framework for evaluating future harness components.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过固定执行循环、仅变化规划、动作空间和上下文管理三个组件，在SWE-Bench Verified与Terminal-Bench 2.1上对四个模型、176个匹配设置进行组件级评测，揭示了上下文管理、规划与动作空间对编码agent性能与成本的不同作用机制。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多将编码harness视为整体系统进行评估，无法判断各组件各自的贡献，因而难以指导harness设计。作者希望实现组件级比较，明确规划、动作空间、上下文管理三类组件的效果，并为模型与预算感知的harness设计提供依据。
AI.method: 采用轻量级编码harness，固定执行循环，仅变化三个组件：规划、动作空间、上下文管理。在SWE-Bench Verified和Terminal-Bench 2.1上对四个模型评测176个匹配设置，覆盖五种上下文管理策略、四种上下文窗口预算，并对规划和动作空间做定向消融。同时进行轨迹级分析解释效应来源。
AI.result: (1) 上下文窗口预算越紧张，上下文管理价值越大，其收益主要来自避免上下文溢出失败；(2) 先规则化裁剪再LLM摘要（分阶段elision）整体效率最高，而让被裁剪内容可恢复会增加模型很少使用的机制且无精度提升；(3) 规划对弱模型是精度支撑，对强模型转为成本节省，精度变化不大；(4) 预定义工具提升bash能力较弱模型的表现，而bash能力强的模型仅用bash接口即可有效工作且成本显著更低，尤其在命令行任务上。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级分析表明：上下文管理延长执行轨迹但不显著改变agent行为，规划改变轨迹停止位置，动作空间改变代码编写的粒度。这些发现支持模型与预算感知的harness设计，并提供了评估未来harness组件的模块化框架。

title: Unifying Models of Intergroup Hostility in Online Discourse
summary: Hostile rhetoric toward social groups can normalize exclusion and justify mistreatment, as well as contribute to rising polarization and political violence. Efforts to moderate hostile rhetoric in online speech draw on foundational theories in social and moral psychology, and political science. However, these theories were developed largely in parallel, often propose different and sometimes conflicting accounts of how hostility develops, and have rarely been tested against each other in real discourse. The result is a fragmented understanding of the rhetorical mechanisms of hostility, without a clear sense of how they appear, and relate to each other, in real-world discourse. Using 2.86 million posts from TikTok, Truth Social, and Twitter/X during the 2024 U.S. presidential election, we model the mechanisms of six foundational theories of intergroup hostility -- boundary construction, threat construction, scapegoating, negative evaluation, dehumanization, and action orientation -- within a common empirical framework to recover the broader organization of intergroup hostility rhetoric. Structurally, we find that boundary construction and threat construction anchor the system; temporally, we find that these mechanisms tend to follow a regular ordering: boundary construction, derogation, and action orientation tend to appear early; dehumanization and threat construction later; scapegoating latest. Mapping how these theoretical frameworks actually manifest in discourse bridges longstanding divisions across social science traditions and presents computational social science with a clearer empirical foundation for modeling intergroup hostility rhetoric beyond single-label detection.

AI.tldr: 该研究用2024年美国大选期间TikTok、Truth Social和Twitter/X的286万条帖子，将六种群体间敌意理论机制纳入统一实证框架，揭示其结构与时间组织规律。
AI.motivation: 针对网络敌意言论的治理需求，社会与道德心理学及政治学已发展出多种基础理论，但这些理论多平行发展、解释相互分歧且鲜在真实语料中相互检验，导致对敌意修辞机制的理解碎片化，缺乏对其在现实话语中如何呈现及相互关联的清晰认识。
AI.method: 基于2024年美国大选期间TikTok、Truth Social和Twitter/X的286万条帖子，在统一实证框架内对六种群体间敌意基础理论机制——边界建构、威胁建构、替罪羊化、负面评价、非人化和行动导向——进行建模，以还原敌意修辞的总体组织方式。
AI.result: 结构上，边界建构与威胁建构构成该系统的锚点；时间上，各机制呈现规律性顺序：边界建构、贬低和行动导向倾向于较早出现，非人化与威胁建构随后，替罪羊化最晚。
AI.conclusion: 将理论框架映射到真实话语的实证呈现，有助于弥合社会科学传统间的长期分歧，并为计算社会科学超越单一标签检测、建模群体间敌意修辞提供更清晰的实证基础。

title: ERCPMP-Gx: Endoscopic Image and Video Dataset for Morphological, Histopathological, and Genomic Characterization of Colorectal Polyposis
summary: Hereditary polyposis syndromes can be precursor lesions to colorectal cancer and are associated with a broad spectrum of extracolonic tumors. Early identification and accurate classification of these syndromes are essential for timely diagnosis, individualized patient management, and targeted surveillance strategies for affected families. However, public endoscopic datasets are largely organized around the individual sporadic polyp, and none links the polyposis phenotype to histopathology and germline findings at the patient level. Here, we present ERCPMP-Gx, an endoscopic, histopathological, and genomic dataset developed to support the application of artificial intelligence (AI) in the recognition, characterization, and classification of colorectal polyposis. Most procedures were performed using the Olympus EVIS X1 system with white-light endoscopy (WLE), narrow-band imaging (NBI), magnifying NBI (M-NBI), and NBI with near focus modes, yielding 160 images and accompanying video clips. Approximately eighty percent of cases represent clinically and/or genetically confirmed hereditary polyposis syndromes (PG), including familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP), Peutz-Jeghers syndrome (PJS), juvenile polyposis syndrome (JPS), and ganglioneuroma syndrome (GNS), while the remaining twenty percent comprise non-hereditary polyps and polyp-mimicking lesions with overlapping morphological features (Non-PG), included to support differential classification. Each released record is linked, where available, to standardized endoscopic annotations, representative histopathology, and clinically reported germline findings, forming an AI-ready, patient-level annotation framework. The dataset is publicly accessible at Mendeley (https://doi.org/10.17632/nzyfc544bx.2). For the latest updates and further information, readers are referred to the DataBioX website: https://databiox.com.

AI.tldr: 本文发布ERCPMP-Gx，一个整合内镜、组织病理与基因组信息、面向结直肠息肉病AI识别与分类的患者级公开数据集。
AI.motivation: 遗传性息肉病综合征是结直肠癌的癌前病变，并伴广泛肠外肿瘤谱，其早期识别与准确分类对及时诊断、个体化管理和家系靶向监测至关重要。然而现有公开内镜数据集多以散发性单发息肉为单位组织，缺乏在患者层面将息肉病表型与组织病理及胚系发现相关联的数据。
AI.method: 构建ERCPMP-Gx数据集：多数操作采用Olympus EVIS X1系统，涵盖白光内镜（WLE）、窄带成像（NBI）、放大NBI（M-NBI）及NBI近聚焦模式，共获得160幅图像并附视频片段；约80%病例为临床和/或遗传学确诊的遗传性息肉病综合征（PG），包括FAP、PJS、JPS和GNS，其余20%为非遗传性息肉及形态重叠的息肉样病变（Non-PG）以支持鉴别分类；每条记录在可得情况下关联标准化内镜标注、代表性组织病理和临床报告的胚系发现，形成AI可用的患者级标注框架。
AI.result: 形成包含160幅图像及相关视频的患者级多模态数据集，约80%为确诊遗传性息肉病综合征病例、20%为形态重叠的非遗传性对照病例，并附带内镜标注、组织病理与胚系结果。
AI.conclusion: ERCPMP-Gx提供了AI就绪的患者级标注框架，可支持结直肠息肉病的识别、表征与分类研究；数据集已在Mendeley公开（https://doi.org/10.17632/nzyfc544bx.2），最新信息见DataBioX网站https://databiox.com。

title: Paint-Anything: Unified Any-Color Control for Image Generation and Editing
comment: 29 pages, Seed Technical Report. HTML compatibility fixes; scientific content unchanged
summary: Professional design requires any-color control: the ability to specify an object's target color with any 24-bit hex value for image generation and editing. Prior work has explored color generation, editing, and colorization, but often relies on dedicated color representations or specialized inference procedures. Advances in large language models offer a simpler starting point: even compact models can associate hex values with color semantics. We present Paint-Anything, which learns a shared hex-prompt interface for generation and editing through object-level color supervision. We develop a data pipeline that constructs Paint-500K from real images through object grounding, perceptual color labeling, and editing-pair synthesis. Since shadows make real-image labels only approximate colors, we complement this supervision with pure-color anchors whose pixels exactly match their paired hex values. These anchors are used only at high-noise timesteps, leaving low-noise training to natural images. We further introduce Any Color Benchmark (ACBench), comprising ACBench-T2I and ACBench-Edit, to measure object-level hex color fidelity across both tasks. On FLUX.2-4B, Paint-Anything improves ACBench-T2I and ACBench-Edit scores by 85.3% and 28.3%, respectively, relative to the base model, with ablations supporting the training recipe. It also achieves the highest average CompColor score among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Paint-Anything，通过共享的 hex 提示接口统一图像生成与编辑中的任意颜色控制，并构建 Paint-500K 数据集与 ACBench 基准。
AI.motivation: 专业设计需要以任意 24 位十六进制值指定目标颜色，但已有颜色生成、编辑与着色方法多依赖专门的颜色表示或定制推理流程，缺少简单统一的接口。
AI.method: 基于大语言模型能将 hex 值与颜色语义关联的特性，学习共享的 hex 提示接口，以对象级颜色监督同时支持生成与编辑；通过对象定位、感知颜色标注和编辑对合成，从真实图像构建 Paint-500K；由于阴影使真实图像标签仅为近似颜色，引入像素与配对 hex 值完全一致的纯色锚点作为补充监督，且仅在噪声较高的时间步使用，低噪声训练仍用自然图像；并提出 ACBench（含 ACBench-T2I 与 ACBench-Edit）衡量两个任务的对象级 hex 颜色保真度。
AI.result: 在 FLUX.2-4B 上，Paint-Anything 相较基座模型在 ACBench-T2I 和 ACBench-Edit 上分别提升 85.3% 和 28.3%，消融实验支持该训练方案；在对比方法中取得最高的平均 CompColor 分数。
AI.conclusion: 共享 hex 提示接口结合对象级颜色监督与纯色锚点策略，可有效实现生成与编辑中的任意颜色精确控制，并提供了可量化的评测基准。

title: FAMOS: Feed-Forward 3D Articulation Modeling from Sparse Observations
summary: Modeling articulated objects from sparse monocular views is challenging because each observation reveals only partial geometry and motion evidence. Most feed-forward methods infer articulation from a single observation and therefore rely heavily on learned category-level shape priors. We present FAMOS, a feed-forward model that predicts movable-part segmentation and joint parameters from a sparse, unordered set of partial point clouds. Our model jointly reasons over multiple observations and naturally supports a variable number of inputs, including a single view. To aggregate articulation cues across observations, we introduce a Multi-state Articulation Transformer with alternating state-wise and global attention. We further propose an observed articulation span objective that supervises the motion range each part exhibits across the input observations, encouraging the model to leverage the full observation set. To overcome the limited scale and diversity of existing datasets, we introduce a procedural data generator that synthesizes self-annotated assets during training. Experiments on PartNet-Mobility, ACD, and ArtiCraft-10K demonstrate consistent improvements over both feed-forward and optimization-based baselines. Project page: https://kevinqu7.github.io/famos

AI.tldr: FAMOS是一个前馈模型，可从稀疏无序的部分点云集合中预测可动部件分割与关节参数，支持单视图到多视图的可变输入，在多个数据集上优于前馈与优化基线。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏单目视图建模铰接物体具有挑战性：每次观测仅揭示部分几何与运动信息。多数前馈方法仅从单次观测推断铰接关系，因而严重依赖类别级形状先验。
AI.method: 提出FAMOS前馈模型，输入为稀疏、无序的部分点云集合，联合推理多次观测并支持可变数量输入（含单视图）；引入Multi-state Articulation Transformer，采用状态间与全局交替注意力聚合铰接线索；提出observed articulation span目标，监督各部件在输入观测中表现的运动范围；并设计程序化数据生成器，在训练中合成自标注资产以缓解数据规模与多样性不足。
AI.result: 在PartNet-Mobility、ACD与ArtiCraft-10K上，相比前馈方法与优化方法基线均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过多观测联合推理、跨观测注意力与运动范围监督，并辅以程序化数据生成，FAMOS有效提升稀疏单目视图下铰接物体建模的可动部件分割与关节参数预测性能。

title: SplashSplat: Reconstructing Splashing Liquids from Real-World Multi-View Videos
comment: 18 pages (11 main + 7 supplementary), 14 figures, 12 tables. Project page: https://niko-creater.github.io/splashsplat-web/
summary: A splash lives for a fraction of a second: sheets tear into ligaments and droplets, appearance is view-dependent and nearly textureless, and little persists long enough to track. Reconstruction research has consequently focused on smoke, synthetic liquids, or gently deforming surfaces. To our knowledge, no synchronized multi-view dataset of splashing liquids exists. We therefore introduce a benchmark of 20 real scenes, from coherent streams to violent splashes, captured by seven synchronized, calibrated 4K cameras at 60 fps, with manually refined per-view liquid and container masks and fixed evaluation splits. We further present SplashSplat, built on a single principle: impose physical structure only where the observations can constrain it. Per-frame liquid SDFs fused from the masks provide the geometry, level-set transport between consecutive SDFs yields a coarse velocity field, and Lagrangian carriers advected along this flow, corrected against each new observation and reseeded where coverage is lost, decode local Gaussians for differentiable rendering. SplashSplat outperforms state-of-the-art dynamic Gaussian splatting methods on our real captures and on a synthetic benchmark, with physically more plausible motion and a lower training cost. The same representation supports temporal interpolation and style transfer without re-optimization.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了首个同步多视角真实液体飞溅数据集（20个场景，7台同步标定4K相机、60fps），并提出SplashSplat方法，通过掩码融合SDF、水平集输运速度场与拉格朗日载流子实现可微渲染，在真实与合成基准上超越现有动态高斯泼溅方法，且训练成本更低，支持时间插值与风格迁移。
AI.motivation: 液体飞溅持续时间极短（不足一秒）、外观视角依赖且几乎无纹理，撕裂成片状、韧带与液滴后几乎无持久特征可供追踪。现有重建研究多集中于烟雾、合成液体或缓慢形变表面，据作者所知尚不存在同步多视角的真实飞溅液体数据集，因此缺乏可评估动态液体重建的基准。
AI.method: 数据集：20个真实场景，涵盖连贯水流到剧烈飞溅，由7台同步标定的4K相机以60fps采集，并提供人工精修的各视角液体与容器掩码及固定评估划分。方法SplashSplat遵循"仅在观测可约束处施加物理结构"的原则：逐帧由掩码融合得到液体SDF以提供几何；通过相邻SDF间的水平集输运获得粗速度场；沿该流场推进拉格朗日载流子，依据新观测校正并在覆盖丢失处重新播种，最终解码局部高斯用于可微渲染。
AI.result: SplashSplat在真实拍摄数据与合成基准上均优于当前最先进的动态高斯泼溅方法，运动在物理上更合理，训练成本更低；同一表示还可支持时间插值与风格迁移，且无需重新优化。
AI.conclusion: 论文填补了同步多视角飞溅液体数据集的空白，并提出一种以观测约束为准则的混合表示方法，将隐式SDF几何、水平集速度输运与拉格朗日高斯载体结合，实现了物理更合理、训练更高效的动态液体重建，并具备插值与风格迁移的扩展能力。

title: Can 4D Foundation Models Remember?
summary: Perceiving and remembering the visual world is fundamental to navigating and interacting with our environment. Current 4D foundation models, such as camera-controllable video models or 4D reconstruction models, can perceive and reconstruct dynamic environments, but how well they remember what they have perceived remains an open question. Existing benchmarks largely rely on pixel-level metrics and lack ground truth for objects once they leave the field of view, making them unable to evaluate visual memory in an object-centric manner against references. To fill this gap, we introduce PersistBench, a dataset and metric suite that leverages 360° videos as omniscient ground truth and proposes three evaluation aspects: object permanence, motion continuity, and appearance preservation. Evaluating various models across diverse categories reveals that current models can only maintain short-term consistency that degrades significantly once objects leave the field of view. Our findings highlight the gap between current model capabilities and robust visual memory ("seeing is not remembering"), providing guidance for future development of 4D foundation models. Dataset and code are available on the project page: https://guangzhaohe.com/persistbench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PersistBench，以360°视频作为全知真值，从物体恒存性、运动连续性、外观保持三方面评估4D基础模型的视觉记忆能力，发现现有模型仅能维持视场内的短期一致性，物体离开视场后显著退化。
AI.motivation: 感知与记忆视觉世界是导航和交互的基础。现有4D基础模型（如可控摄像机视频模型、4D重建模型）能感知和重建动态环境，但其记忆能力尚不明确；现有基准多依赖像素级指标，且缺乏物体离开视场后的真值，无法以物体为中心与参考进行对比评估视觉记忆。
AI.method: 引入PersistBench，一个数据集与指标套件：利用360°视频作为全知（omniscient）真值，提出三个评估方面——物体恒存性（object permanence）、运动连续性（motion continuity）、外观保持（appearance preservation），并对多种类别的模型进行评测。
AI.result: 跨类别评测显示，当前模型只能维持短期一致性，一旦物体离开视场，性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了当前模型能力与稳健视觉记忆之间的差距（"看见不等于记住"，seeing is not remembering），为未来4D基础模型的发展提供指导。数据集与代码见项目主页。

title: Embedding Models Measure in Peculiar Ways
summary: Embedding spaces define notions of semantic similarity and distance. We study whether those embeddings reflect physical measurements of mass, distance, time and volume, which admit a unique, objective notion of semantic equivalence and distance. We find that physical measurement is only weakly modeled in the embedding space, and that instead quite peculiar measurement patterns can be observed. Further analysis indicates that embedding representations of physical measurements are strongly influenced by superficial string similarity, and recalibration of similarity does not substantially improve the alignment.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验词嵌入空间是否能反映质量、距离、时间、体积等物理测量的客观语义距离，发现物理测量的建模很弱，且嵌入表示受表层字符串相似性强烈影响，重新校准相似度也无法显著改善对齐。
AI.motivation: 嵌入空间定义了语义相似性与距离的概念。本文的动机是探究这些嵌入是否能够反映质量、距离、时间与体积等物理测量——这类测量具有唯一且客观的语义等价与距离定义，从而检验嵌入空间语义距离的客观性与合理性。
AI.method: 以物理测量（质量、距离、时间、体积，具有客观的语义等价与距离）作为基准，考察嵌入空间中这些量的表示；分析嵌入表示与表层字符串相似性之间的关系；并尝试对相似度进行重新校准以改善对齐。
AI.result: 物理测量在嵌入空间中仅被弱建模，且呈现出相当奇特的度量模式；进一步分析表明嵌入表示受表层字符串相似性强烈影响；重新校准相似度并未实质改善对齐效果。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入空间并未很好地反映物理测量的客观语义结构，其相似性度量更多受字符串表层形式影响，且单纯重新校准相似度不足以修正这一问题。

title: Coding Agents with Harness for Safe Robot Control
summary: Coding agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation: a language model writes the robot controller as a program, and agents built in this way now operate robots without robot-specific training. Whether this paradigm is also safe, however, has not been asked. We evaluate coding agents under a safety constraint, where each task pairs a manipulation goal with an obstacle the robot must not touch. The agent pursues the goal but collides with the obstacle in most cases, treating task completion as its sole objective. The agent reasons about the obstacle in its traces, and the prompt already forbids touching it, so neither perception nor instruction is at fault; the fault lies in the planning, where the stated constraint never becomes a priority. By decomposing manipulation into a route phase and a contact-rich moment, we locate the source of the failure. Along the route, the model cannot prioritize the safety constraint, having no notion of a clearing route and none of replanning once a chosen route becomes infeasible. At the contact, it is unaware that contact execution is bounded by the same constraint. To close this gap, we present SafeHarness, which equips the model with two obstacle-aware harnesses. Obstacle-aware route planning grounds the objects as bounding boxes and draws candidate routes over them as sequences of waypoints. The agent then plans a route in advance, verifies it, replans when necessary, and only then executes it. Obstacle-aware contact execution instead selects the contact position so that the contact itself avoids the obstacle. SafeHarness attains 81.2% task success and 91.9% collision avoidance with GPT-6-Astra, surpassing the previous SOTA by 13.7 and 23.0 points, and the same agent without harnesses by 31.2 and 57.5 points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了编码智能体在机器人操作中的安全性，发现其在任务完成与避障约束冲突时几乎必然碰撞，并将失效定位在"路径规划"与"接触执行"两个环节。为此提出 SafeHarness，通过障碍感知的路径规划与接触执行两个模块，使 GPT-6-Astra 达到 81.2% 任务成功率与 91.9% 避障率，刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体（语言模型生成机器人控制程序）已能在无需机器人专项训练的情况下操作机器人，但其安全性尚未被研究。作者希望检验该范式在存在安全约束（不可触碰的障碍物）时是否仍可靠。
AI.method: 在每个任务中同时给定操作目标与禁止触碰的障碍物，对编码智能体进行安全约束下的评测。将操作分解为"路径阶段（route phase）"与"富接触时刻（contact-rich moment）"以定位失败来源，据此提出 SafeHarness：1）障碍感知路径规划——将物体表示为边界框，在其上以路点序列绘制候选路径，智能体先规划、验证、必要时重规划，再执行；2）障碍感知接触执行——选择使接触本身避开障碍物的接触位置。
AI.result: 编码智能体在多数情况下为完成目标而碰撞障碍物。其推理轨迹中确实考虑了障碍物，提示词也已禁止触碰，故问题既非感知也非指令，而在于规划——约束从未被提升为优先项：路径阶段缺乏"畅通路径"概念且一旦路径不可行不会重规划，接触阶段未意识到接触执行受同一约束限制。SafeHarness 在 GPT-6-Astra 上取得 81.2% 任务成功率与 91.9% 避障率，较此前 SOTA 分别提升 13.7 与 23.0 个百分点，较无 harness 的同款智能体分别提升 31.2 与 57.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体范式在缺乏显式安全机制时对约束处理失败，失败根源在于规划层而非感知或指令层；通过将避障约束分别嵌入路径规划与接触执行，SafeHarness 显著提升安全性与任务成功率，表明该范式可在加入结构化障碍感知模块后兼顾安全与效能。

title: $μ^2$-Bench: A Multilingual Machine Unlearning Benchmark
summary: Undesired information such as harmful content and private data propagates through Multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) via direct training and indirect cross-linguistic spread. Multilingual Machine Unlearning (MMU) aims to remove such information, yet its evaluation remains underexplored, leaving unclear whether unlearning truly eliminates target knowledge across all languages. To bridge this gap, we introduce $μ^2$-Bench, an MMU benchmark that simulates the full pipeline of memorization, unlearning, and evaluation across diverse languages. It 1) spans a broad set of languages, 2) evaluates on both training and hold-out languages, and 3) assesses knowledge as dispersed across multiple languages. We show that successful MMU requires methods that reflect multilingual characteristics, and conduct analysis to provide deeper insights into MMU.

AI.tldr: 提出μ²-Bench多语言机器遗忘基准，模拟记忆-遗忘-评估全流程，发现成功的多语言遗忘需适配多语言特性的方法。
AI.motivation: 多语言大模型会通过直接训练和跨语言间接传播不良信息（如有害内容、隐私数据）。多语言机器遗忘（MMU）旨在移除这类信息，但其评估尚不充分，无法确认遗忘是否在所有语言中真正消除了目标知识。
AI.method: 构建μ²-Bench基准，模拟跨语言的记忆、遗忘与评估全流程，特点包括：覆盖广泛语言集合、在训练语言与留出语言上均进行评估、将知识视为分散于多语言中进行评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，成功的MMU需要能够反映多语言特性的方法，并通过分析为MMU提供更深入的洞见。
AI.conclusion: MMU评估需要多语言视角的基准与方法，μ²-Bench为该领域提供了系统化的评估框架与分析基础。

title: MemeTAG: Keyword-Driven Meme Classification through Tag Embedding Reconstruction
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures; published in the Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV), 2026
summary: The proliferation of harmful internet memes poses a significant societal threat, yet their automated classification remains a formidable algorithmic challenge due to the nuanced, multimodal nature of their content. To address this, we introduce MemeTAG, a novel dual-objective framework that pioneers a keyword-aware approach to meme classification. Our core innovation is a two-part semantic guidance mechanism: first, we leverage a pretrained Vision-Language Model to generate a set of descriptive keywords, that capture the high-level semantics. Second, we introduce the Aggregated Tag Inference Network (ATIN), an attention-based module that distills these keywords into a single, rich semantic embedding. This embedding serves as a target for a novel auxiliary reconstruction loss, which compels the model to learn deeply aligned visual and textual features. This approach, combined with an efficient three-stage training strategy, establishes a new state-of-the-art on the HarMeme, Hateful Memes Challenge (HMC), and PrideMM datasets, decisively outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemeTAG，一种关键字感知的双目标框架，用于有害网络模因（meme）的多模态分类，在多个数据集上刷新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 有害网络模因扩散带来显著社会威胁，但其自动分类因内容具有细微且多模态的特性而极具算法挑战性。
AI.method: 核心为两部分语义引导机制：先用预训练视觉-语言模型生成描述性关键字以捕捉高层语义；再提出聚合标签推断网络（ATIN），一种基于注意力的模块，将关键字蒸馏为单一富语义嵌入，作为新型辅助重建损失的目标，迫使模型学习深度对齐的视觉与文本特征；并结合高效的三阶段训练策略。
AI.result: 在HarMeme、Hateful Memes Challenge（HMC）与PrideMM数据集上均达到新的SOTA，明确超越现有最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 关键字感知的语义引导与辅助重建损失相结合，可有效提升有害模因多模态分类性能。

title: Image-Derived PM10 Estimation in Cattle Feedlot Using Machine Learning: Addressing Concentration Ranges Beyond Existing Digital Imaging Methods
summary: Affordable dust monitoring remains a pressing need for the cattle feedlot industry, yet camera-based PM estimation, despite its growing body of research in urban air quality settings, has not been evaluated under the extended concentration ranges characteristic of intensive livestock operations. This study developed an image-based approach using contrast panel features and machine learning to estimate PM10 concentrations in a commercial cattle feedlot, where hourly average PM10 ranged from 250 to 1,000 ug/m^-3 and instantaneous concentrations reached 5,000 to 20,000 ug/m^-3. Grayscale images were captured during the evening dust peak period, and features including panel contrast, black and white panel pixel values, and overall image brightness were extracted. The model also incorporated recent past values from preceding images and solar zenith angle as predictors. Among the candidate models evaluated, XGBoost achieved the highest predictive performance, with an R^2 of 0.792 and a median absolute error of 103 ug/m^-3. Feature importance analysis revealed that (a) panels positioned farthest from the camera contributed most strongly to predictions and (b) that black panel pixel values were more sensitive than white panel values to changes in PM10 concentration. Prediction accuracy during the sunset transition, which coincides with the onset of the feedlot evening dust peak, remains an area for further refinement. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of image-based PM10 estimation across PM concentration ranges substantially exceeding those reported in prior urban studies and provide practical guidelines for future deployment in feedlot environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究在商业化肉牛饲养场开发了基于对比面板特征与机器学习的图像法PM10估算方法，浓度范围远超既有城市研究，XGBoost模型R²达0.792。
AI.motivation: 饲养场行业需要可负担的粉尘监测手段，但基于摄像头的PM估算虽在城市空气质量研究中日渐增多，却尚未在集约化畜牧作业特有的高浓度区间得到验证。
AI.method: 在商业肉牛饲养场于傍晚粉尘峰值期采集灰度图像，提取面板对比度、黑白面板像素值、整体亮度等特征，并引入前序图像的近期历史值与太阳天顶角作为预测因子；比较多种候选模型，以XGBoost表现最佳。
AI.result: XGBoost预测性能最高，R²为0.792，中位绝对误差为103 μg/m⁻³（小时均值PM10范围250–1,000 μg/m⁻³，瞬时浓度达5,000–20,000 μg/m⁻³）。特征重要性显示：距相机最远的面板贡献最大；黑色面板像素值对PM10变化比白色面板更敏感。日落过渡时段的预测精度仍有待改进。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明图像法PM10估算可适用于显著高于既往城市研究的浓度范围，并为饲养场环境中的后续部署提供了实用指导。

title: Trustworthy FinAInce: Unpacking How AI-Mediated Financial Advice is Judged
summary: As generative AI is increasingly used as a source of personal financial guidance, understanding how people appraise such advice is important for supporting appropriate reliance. We conducted a randomized vignette experiment with 285 U.S. adults across eight financial decisions, independently varying three advice styles---AI, expert, and online community---and displayed source labels while holding the underlying recommendation consistent. Advice style most strongly shaped message and safety appraisals, Expert labels selectively increased perceived source knowledge, and decision context primarily shaped risk and safety appraisals. These appraisals were associated with downstream judgments, with models explaining 69.2% of overall quality, 75.9% of trust, and 82.9% of intended reliance. Expert-style advice also remained most preferred when shown without source labels. Our findings have implications for understanding financial advice evaluation, distinguishing the roles of advice style and source labels, and designing financial AI that supports grounded evaluation rather than simply maximizing trust.

AI.tldr: 通过285名美国成年人的随机情境实验，研究比较AI、专家和网络社区三种建议风格对财务建议评价的影响，发现建议风格主要影响信息与安全评价，来源标签仅选择性提升专家可信度，且这些评价能显著预测信任与采纳意愿。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI日益被用作个人财务建议来源，理解人们如何评价此类建议对于支持"适当依赖"（而非盲目信任）至关重要。研究旨在厘清建议风格与来源标签各自的独立作用，为设计支持理性评估的财务AI提供依据。
AI.method: 采用随机情境实验（vignette experiment），招募285名美国成年人，覆盖8类财务决策。实验独立操纵三种建议风格——AI、专家、网络社区，并在保持底层推荐内容一致的前提下显示来源标签。以建议风格（AI/专家/网络社区）为自变量，测量信息评价、安全评价、来源知识感知、风险感知等，并分析其对整体质量、信任和预期依赖的影响。
AI.result: 建议风格对信息与安全评价影响最强；专家标签选择性提升来源知识感知；决策情境主要影响风险与安全评价。这些评价与下游判断显著相关，模型分别解释了69.2%的整体质量、75.9%的信任和82.9%的预期依赖。即使不显示来源标签，专家风格建议仍最受偏好。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了财务建议评价中建议风格与来源标签的不同作用机制，强调财务AI设计应支持基于证据的理性评估，而非单纯追求最大化信任。

title: Voice-Light: A Full-Duplex Cascaded Voice Agent with Causal Turn-Taking and Speculative Generation
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code, datasets, and model artifacts: https://github.com/BertilBraun/Voice-Light ; live demo: https://voice.bertil-braun.de
summary: Natural spoken interaction requires more than streaming ASR, language generation, and speech synthesis: a system must react to overlap without canceling on every acknowledgment, prepare a response before a turn is certain, and ensure canceled audio cannot enter conversation history. We present Voice-Light, a full-duplex cascaded voice agent that combines immediate acoustic onset, a causal adapter sharing a streaming ASR encoder, reversible playback control, and private speculative response generation. Structured tool calls execute concurrently with audible bridge speech, while browser acknowledgments make rendered audio authoritative for durable history. Locked evaluation on 1,673 real-conversation silence candidates found that an earlier learned completion checkpoint preserved a 2.70% false-cutoff rate but reached only 12.53% end-of-turn recall, compared with 95.60% for a Silero timing policy. The deployed system therefore retains a hybrid controller rather than claiming a learned-policy replacement. Across three unscripted operator-run microphone sessions, 36 measured response turns had a 758 ms median from final VAD endpoint to first server audio; 21 turns were below 800 ms. These sessions are an instrumented case study, not a controlled user evaluation. We release the synthetic data, model artifacts, evaluation code and summaries, source code, and deployment configuration supporting the result.

AI.tldr: Voice-Light：全双工级联语音智能体，含声学起音、因果适配器、可逆播放与私有推测生成；混合控制器部署，36轮中位响应758ms。
AI.motivation: 自然口语交互不止需要流式ASR、语言生成与语音合成：系统必须能对重叠语音作出反应而不在每个确认词上取消，在轮次尚未确定前预备响应，并确保被取消的音频不进入对话历史。
AI.method: 提出Voice-Light全双工级联语音智能体，结合即时声学起音、共享流式ASR编码器的因果适配器、可逆播放控制与私有推测式响应生成；结构化工具调用与可听桥接语音并发执行，浏览器确认使已渲染音频成为持久历史的权威依据。在1,673个真实对话静音候选上做锁定评估，比较学习式完成检查点与Silero时序策略。
AI.result: 锁定评估：早期学习式完成检查点保持2.70%误切断率，但话轮结束召回仅12.53%，Silero时序策略达95.60%，故部署采用混合控制器。三次无脚本操作者麦克风会话中，36个实测响应轮从最终VAD端点到首个服务端音频中位758ms，21轮低于800ms。这些会话为带仪器案例研究，非受控用户评估。
AI.conclusion: 系统保留混合控制器而非声称以学习策略替代；释放合成数据、模型产物、评估代码与摘要、源代码及部署配置以支持复现。

title: Do Spinning Radar Doppler Velocity Measurements Improve Vehicle Detection and Tracking?
summary: Spinning frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radars have been gaining popularity in autonomous vehicle perception on account of their robustness to adverse weather conditions and 360° field of view. Recently, scanning radars have also been shown capable of generating per-azimuth Doppler velocity. In this paper, we investigate whether these Doppler velocity measurements improve spinning radar vehicle detection and tracking performance. For detection, we estimate the ego motion and use it to undo the Doppler range distortion of the radar image before passing it to a network. For tracking, we propose a new way to estimate a per-vehicle velocity and use it as a prior for the tracker's motion model. Since Doppler-enabled spinning radar data is not available in any dataset with ground-truth dynamic object labels, our first contribution is an automatic labelling pipeline that uses an ensemble of fine-tuned off-the-shelf lidar detectors to label all 643 km of the Boreas Road Trip dataset. We then transfer detections to radar, and use over 250 km of vehicle-dense sequences as ground-truth training data. By training and evaluating two state-of-the-art detectors, we show that Doppler undistortion can improve detection accuracy by up to $2.37$ points on mean average precision. Furthermore, we show that the Doppler velocity prior can improve tracking accuracy by $13.68$ points on multi-object tracking accuracy (MOTA) versus the zero-velocity initialization baseline, while achieving $99.7\%$ of the MOTA obtained using ground-truth velocities as the prior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究旋转式FMCW雷达的Doppler速度测量是否能提升车辆检测与跟踪性能，并提出自动标注流程生成训练数据。实验表明Doppler去畸变最多提升2.37点mAP，Doppler速度先验最多提升13.68点MOTA。
AI.motivation: 旋转式FMCW雷达因抗恶劣天气和360°视野在自动驾驶感知中受青睐，且具备逐方位Doppler速度测量能力，但尚不清楚这些Doppler测量能否改善旋转雷达的车辆检测与跟踪性能；同时缺乏带动态目标真值标签的Doppler旋转雷达数据集。
AI.method: 检测方面，估计自车运动以消除雷达图像的Doppler距离畸变后再输入网络；跟踪方面，提出新的逐车辆速度估计方法，并将其作为跟踪器运动模型的先验。为获取训练数据，提出自动标注流程，用一组微调的现成激光雷达检测器对Boreas Road Trip数据集的全部643 km进行标注，再将检测结果迁移到雷达，取超过250 km车辆密集序列作为真值训练数据。
AI.result: 通过训练和评估两种SOTA检测器，Doppler去畸变可将检测精度最高提升2.37点mAP；Doppler速度先验相比零速度初始化基线可将跟踪精度提升13.68点MOTA，并达到以真值速度为先验所得MOTA的99.7%。
AI.conclusion: Doppler速度信息能有效提升旋转式FMCW雷达的车辆检测与跟踪性能，且所提Doppler速度先验接近使用真值速度的上界效果，验证了Doppler在旋转雷达感知中的价值。

title: Fragment-Aware Vision Transformers for Fresco-Fragment Style Classification
summary: Artistic style classification is usually studied on complete artworks, where models can exploit global composition, spatial organisation, and iconographic structure. In archaeological settings, however, artworks often survive only as fragmented remains, forcing recognition from incomplete, irregular, and context-limited visual evidence. We study fresco-fragment style classification using a progressive transformer-based framework. Starting from a ViT-B/16 baseline, we introduce foreground-guided masking to suppress background-only tokens, inpainting-based geometric regularisation to align irregular fragment supports with the ViT patch grid, and a supervised contrastive objective that operates on predictive distributions through a Kullback-Leibler similarity and consistently improves every branch. We combine the branches with a deliberately simple learnable logit ensemble. Experiments on CLEOPATRA and POMPAAF show that fragment-aware modelling improves over the standard ViT baseline, with the ensemble increasing accuracy from 0.604 to 0.656 and macro-F1 from 0.596 to 0.648 on CLEOPATRA, and outperforming the best single branch in four of six fragmentation settings on POMPAAF. We additionally evaluate a more complex graph-fusion variant and find that it matches the simple ensemble on POMPAAF while offering only a small, dataset-specific gain on CLEOPATRA, which does not justify its added complexity. Beyond these empirical gains, our contribution is twofold: a distribution-level contrastive objective that consistently sharpens single-branch recognition, and an interpretability analysis that verifies the models exploit genuine painted evidence, while quantifying that the inpainting-based branch draws part of its attribution from the synthesised surround.

AI.tldr: 本文研究壁画残片的艺术风格分类，提出渐进式Transformer框架：前景引导掩码、基于修复的几何正则化及KL分布级监督对比目标，并用简单可学习logit集成融合分支；在CLEOPATRA与POMPAAF上优于ViT基线。
AI.motivation: 艺术风格分类通常依赖完整艺术品的全局构图、空间组织与图像志结构；但考古场景中作品多以残片形式存留，只能依据不完整、不规则且缺乏上下文的视觉证据进行识别，标准ViT在此类输入上面临背景token干扰与patch网格错位等问题。
AI.method: 以ViT-B/16为基线，构建渐进式多分支框架：1）前景引导掩码抑制纯背景token；2）基于修复（inpainting）的几何正则化，使不规则残片支撑区与ViT patch网格对齐；3）在预测分布上通过KL相似度构造监督对比目标，持续提升每个分支；4）用刻意简单的可学习logit集成合并各分支；另评估更复杂的图融合变体作为对照。
AI.result: 在CLEOPATRA与POMPAAF上，残片感知建模优于标准ViT基线：集成将CLEOPATRA准确率从0.604提升至0.656，宏F1从0.596提升至0.648；在POMPAAF的六种残片设置中有四种优于最佳单分支。图融合变体在POMPAAF上与简单集成持平，仅在CLEOPATRA上有小幅数据集特定增益，不足以证明其额外复杂度合理。
AI.conclusion: 贡献有二：一是分布级对比目标，可稳定锐化单分支识别能力；二是可解释性分析，验证模型利用真实绘画证据，同时量化指出基于修复的分支部分归因来自合成周边区域。

title: MAGIC: Marginal-Guided Compression with Optimal Transport for Efficient Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Recent visual document retrieval (VDR) systems such as ColPali use multi-vector page embeddings, in which patch-level vectors enable fine-grained evidence matching but incur substantial index storage and MaxSim scoring overhead. Post-hoc merging offers a practical route to efficient VDR by reducing this cost without retraining the retriever, but its uniform reconstruction objectives are poorly aligned with the sparse, non-uniform patch usage induced by late-interaction retrieval. Under aggressive compression, this misalignment can preserve rarely used patches while concentrating retrieval activity on too few retained representatives. To address this misalignment, we propose Marginal-Guided Compression with Optimal Transport (MAGIC), a training-free post-hoc compressor for efficient retrieval with frozen multi-vector embeddings. MAGIC derives a MaxSim-induced compression surrogate and optimizes it through a two-marginal entropic optimal-transport formulation, where a retrieval-demand source marginal prioritizes high-use patches and a balanced target marginal regularizes retained-facet usage. Across ViDoRe benchmarks, keep ratios, and retrieval backbones, MAGIC consistently outperforms strong post-hoc compressors, with particularly large gains in the aggressive-compression regime; component ablations verify the complementary effects of its two marginals. We release the code at: https://github.com/xandery-geek/MAGIC.

AI.tldr: MAGIC是一种用于视觉文档检索（VDR）的无训练后处理压缩方法，通过双边缘熵最优传输优化MaxSim诱导的压缩代理目标，在激进压缩下显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: ColPali等VDR系统使用多向量页面嵌入，patch级向量支持细粒度证据匹配，但带来巨大的索引存储与MaxSim评分开销。后处理合并是无需重训练即可降低开销的实用途径，但其均匀重建目标与晚期交互检索产生的稀疏、非均匀patch使用模式不匹配：在激进压缩下，会保留很少使用的patch，却将检索活动集中在过少的保留代表上。
AI.method: 提出MAGIC（Marginal-Guided Compression with Optimal Transport），一种面向冻结多向量嵌入的无训练后处理压缩器。它推导MaxSim诱导的压缩代理目标，并通过双边缘熵最优传输公式进行优化：其中检索需求源边缘优先考虑高使用率的patch，平衡的目标边缘则对保留facet的使用进行正则化。
AI.result: 在ViDoRe基准、不同保留比例和多种检索骨干网络上，MAGIC一致优于强后处理压缩器，在激进压缩场景下增益尤为显著；组件消融实验验证了两个边缘的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: MAGIC通过将压缩目标与晚期交互检索的实际patch使用分布对齐，实现了高效且有效的VDR后处理压缩，并开源了代码。

title: Scaling Discovery through Test-Time Communication
summary: Science advances not in isolation but through collaboration, yet existing agentic systems capture little of this. Whether communicating agents help remains an open question with mixed prior results. We show that test-time communication can substantially outperform independent parallel attempts on challenging tasks, where sharing a breakthrough can push the whole group forward. We first study the effect of scaling multi-agent test-time communication, where agents have no predefined roles and communicate via a shared directory, on ARC-AGI-3, a benchmark requiring novel problem solving. We find that a team of $k$ communicating agents, team@$k$, matches the success rate of $4k$ independent agents, and this advantage grows with $k$, suggesting gains compound with scale. The effect is not merely efficiency: a task that no single agent can solve, a team of agents can solve reliably. Furthermore, these gains transfer to research-oriented tasks, given sufficient compute. On polyomino packing, communicating agents outperform best@$k$ and exceed the prior best-known score. On MNIST classifier compression, communication surpasses the best-known human solution. A team of four agents produced a 1,957-byte classifier submission achieving 99.4% test accuracy, smaller than both the best-known human solution and the best single-agent result. These gains are not unconditional. Independent agents may outperform communication when compute is limited or when a clear measure of progress is absent. However, under sufficient compute and clear feedback, multi-agent communication consistently yields stronger results.

AI.tldr: 论文表明，在充足算力与明确反馈下，测试时多智能体通信可显著超越独立并行尝试，甚至解决单个智能体无法解决的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统很少体现“科学通过协作而非孤立推进”的特性，且通信智能体是否有帮助这一问题上，既有结果并不一致，因此需要系统研究测试时多智能体通信的效果与适用条件。
AI.method: 研究无预定义角色、通过共享目录通信的多智能体测试时通信扩展效应；在 ARC-AGI-3 基准上对比 k 个通信智能体团队（team@k）与 4k 个独立智能体的成功率；并将结论迁移到多联骨牌堆叠与 MNIST 分类器压缩等研究型任务，同时考察算力与反馈信号对通信收益的影响。
AI.result: team@k 的成功率可匹配 4k 个独立智能体，且优势随 k 增大而增强；某些无单个智能体能解决的任务，团队可稳定解决。多联骨牌堆叠上通信智能体超过 best@k 并刷新先前最佳分数；MNIST 分类器压缩中，4 个智能体生成 1,957 字节、测试准确率 99.4% 的分类器，优于已知人类最佳解与最佳单智能体结果。但算力受限或缺乏明确进度度量时，独立智能体可能优于通信。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体通信的收益并非无条件：在算力充足且反馈明确时，测试时通信能持续带来更强结果，且增益随规模扩大而累积；反之则可能不如独立并行尝试。

title: Initial Evaluation of Potential Bias in Coverage of Humans in Wikidata
summary: Introduction. Open collaborative knowledge graphs such as Wikidata increasingly ground agentic artificial intelligence, information retrieval, and language modeling systems, making systematic auditing of their demographic representation and overall equity a research imperative. Methods. Herein, we present an open-source auditing platform that ingests over 10 million statement bindings representing over 6 million humans on Wikidata via QLever, and evaluates representation of gender, sexual orientation, geography, birthplace urbanicity, ethnicity, multilingual coverage of labels, descriptions, and aliases, occupation, and select intersectional pairs of these entities. It does so by making use of Chi-square goodness-of-fit tests, 95% Wilson-score confidence intervals, and disparity ratios, in light of Rubin's missingness taxonomy. Results. Women accounted for 28.71% (CI +/-0.04) of all humans in Wikidata with a stated gender. 38.26% of humans had a citizenship statement, with Western Europe and North America (WENA) representing approximately 53% of such statements. Among 1.8 million birthplaces that could be classified, rural birthplaces were observed in 2.48% of cases (in comparison to 27.4% global baseline). Fewer than 1.2% of entities carried an ethnicity statement, and non-English Wikidata descriptions covered 18.2% of items. Discussion. Our findings reveal significant missingness across the evaluated axes. Ethnicity and sexual orientation were the most critically under-documented (missing statements) while rural birthplaces and non-WENA citizenship were the most underrepresented.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个开源审计平台，通过QLever摄取Wikidata中逾1000万条语句绑定（代表逾600万人物），系统评估性别、性取向、地理、出生地城市化程度、族群、多语言覆盖、职业及交叉维度的代表性偏差，发现各族群维度存在显著缺失与低估。
AI.motivation: Wikidata等开放协作知识图谱日益成为智能体AI、信息检索和语言建模的基础支撑，因此对其人口代表性及整体公平性的系统性审计成为研究必需。
AI.method: 构建开源审计平台，经QLever摄取Wikidata中逾1000万条语句绑定（涵盖逾600万人物）；采用卡方拟合优度检验、95% Wilson得分置信区间和差异比（disparity ratios），并参照Rubin缺失性分类框架，评估性别、性取向、地理、出生地城市化、族群、标签/描述/别名的多语言覆盖、职业及部分交叉配对维度的代表性。
AI.result: 在有性别陈述的人物中，女性占28.71%（CI ±0.04）；38.26%的人物有公民身份陈述，其中西欧与北美（WENA）约占53%；在可分类的180万出生地中，农村出生地仅占2.48%（全球基线为27.4%）；不足1.2%的实体带有族群陈述；非英语Wikidata描述仅覆盖18.2%的条目。
AI.conclusion: 各评估维度均存在显著缺失：族群与性取向文档化程度最低（陈述缺失最严重），农村出生地与非WENA公民身份则代表性最低。

title: Forecasting Brain Tracer Distribution from Pre-Contrast MRI: A Comparison of Direct Regression and Flow Matching
summary: Intrathecal contrast-enhanced MRI shows how a tracer injected into the cerebrospinal fluid spreads through the brain, but requires repeated scans over 24--48\,h. We therefore ask how much of the later tracer distribution can be predicted from the pre-contrast scan and elapsed time alone. Using 104 training patients (878 MRI volumes), we compared a direct image-to-image regression model with a more complex generative model based on conditional flow matching, and tested both on 23 held-out patients and on 51 patients from a separate cohort with idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus (INPH). The direct model reduced the error of simply copying the pre-contrast scan by about 60\% in held-out patients and 25\% in the INPH cohort, and its predicted change maps agreed with the observed tracer enhancement rather than only reproducing anatomy. The generative model was less accurate in both cohorts. A substantial part of the later tracer distribution is therefore predictable from the patient's brain anatomy as seen on pre-contrast MRI, and the added model complexity gave no benefit at this data scale. With prospective validation, such forecasts could be studied for patient stratification and treatment planning in intrathecal therapies.

AI.tldr: 本文探究能否仅凭增强前MRI与经过时间预测鞘内注射示踪剂在脑内的后期分布，比较了直接图像回归模型与条件流匹配生成模型，结果显示直接模型误差较朴素复制降低约60%（留出集）和25%（INPH队列），生成模型反而更差，说明该数据规模下增加模型复杂度无益。
AI.motivation: 鞘内对比增强MRI能反映示踪剂经脑脊液在脑内的扩散，但需在24–48小时内反复扫描，耗时且成本高。因此作者希望验证：后期示踪剂分布中可被增强前扫描图像与经过时间所解释的比例有多大，从而为减少重复扫描、开展患者分层与治疗方案制定提供依据。
AI.method: 使用104例训练患者（878个MRI体数据），将直接的图像到图像回归模型与基于条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）的更复杂生成模型进行对比。在23例留出患者及来自另一队列的51例特发性正常压力脑积水（INPH）患者上测试。评估指标包括相对朴素复制增强前扫描的误差降低幅度，以及预测变化图是否与观察到的示踪剂增强一致（而非仅复现解剖结构）。
AI.result: 直接回归模型将朴素复制增强前扫描的误差在留出患者中降低约60%，在INPH队列中降低约25%；其预测的变化图与观察到的示踪剂增强相符，而不仅是重现解剖结构。生成模型在两个队列中精度均更低，即在该数据规模下增加模型复杂度未带来收益。
AI.conclusion: 后期示踪剂分布的相当大一部分可由增强前MRI所显示的脑解剖结构预测得到。经前瞻性验证后，此类预测有望用于鞘内治疗中的患者分层与治疗规划。

title: Aligning with Lived Experience: Heterogeneous Benefits of Fine Tuning in Mental Health Support Generation
summary: As access to professional mental healthcare remains limited, many individuals turn to online platforms such as Reddit to seek peer support situated within human lived experience. However, a significant portion of such queries go unanswered, presenting an opportunity for using Large Language Models (LLMs) to fill this gap. While LLMs have demonstrated strong performance on clinical benchmarks, their ability to generate lived-experience informed and community-aligned peer support is underexplored. Addressing this gap, we introduce the COmmunity-centered Peer Engaged Support (COPES) dataset and a three-axis evaluation framework to assess LLM alignment with community perspectives to mental health support seeking queries. Evaluating zero-shot and post-trained (SFT and DPO) models, we show that post-training on COPES significantly improves Strategy Alignment (>50% for general-purpose models) and alignment in Emotion & Tone. However, we also observe that such improvements are heterogeneous and alignment improvements vary significantly across subreddits and requested coping strategies. Furthermore, post-training induces distributional shifts, heavily favoring problem-focused recommendations while suppressing emotion-focused strategies. Together, this work shows that while curating community-driven data improves the alignment of LLM responses, model performance remains disparate across distinct sub-communities and specific mental health needs.
