AI.tldr: 该论文提出COPES数据集与三轴评估框架，用于评估LLM在心理健康求助回复中与社区视角的对齐程度，并揭示后训练虽提升对齐但存在异质性与分布偏移问题。
AI.motivation: 专业心理健康服务可及性有限，许多人转向Reddit等在线平台寻求基于真实生活经验的同伴支持，但大量求助帖无人回复。LLM虽有潜力填补这一空白，但其在临床基准上的优异表现并不代表能生成契合真实生活经验与社区规范的同伴支持，这一能力尚缺乏研究。
AI.method: 构建了以社区为中心的同伴参与支持数据集COPES，并提出三轴评估框架，用以衡量LLM回复与社区视角在心理健康求助查询上的对齐度。对零样本模型以及后训练模型（SFT与DPO）进行评估，其中后训练在COPES数据上进行。
AI.result: 在COPES上后训练显著提升了策略对齐（通用模型提升超50%）以及情绪与语气对齐。但改进具有异质性，不同subreddit与不同所需应对策略之间的对齐提升差异明显。此外，后训练引入分布偏移，过度偏向问题聚焦型建议，抑制情绪聚焦型策略。
AI.conclusion: 整理社区驱动数据可改善LLM回复的对齐性，但模型性能在不同子社区与特定心理健康需求之间仍存在明显差异。

title: The Hidden Cost of Digits: Number Normalization and WER in ASR Systems
summary: Modern automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems trained on extremely large datasets can produce transcripts with numbers written in Arabic numerals. This creates a need for fair comparison with models that output verbatim texts and proper processing of reference transcripts. Popular approaches often reduce text normalization to lowercase and remove punctuation, with no additional normalization applied to languages other than English. In this work, we analyze the impact of normalization of numerical expressions in the evaluation of ASR systems in various languages, using Polish as an example of a highly inflective language. We perform experiments on VoxPopuli and The Polish Parliamentary speech datasets and estimate word error rate (WER) differences for different text normalization approaches. We show that the difference due to the lack of number normalization in WER may be substantial - more than 2 percentage points, and often higher than the differences between systems in popular multilingual benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文分析ASR评测中数值表达式归一化对WER的影响，以波兰语为例，发现缺失数字归一化可造成超过2个百分点的WER差异，常大于多语言基准中系统间差距。
AI.motivation: 现代ASR系统在大规模数据上训练后可能输出阿拉伯数字形式的转写，而其他模型输出逐字文本，导致评测不公平；且现有归一化方法多针对英语，对非英语语言的数值处理不足，故需研究数值归一化的影响。
AI.method: 在VoxPopuli和波兰议会语音数据集上进行实验，针对高度屈折的波兰语，比较不同文本归一化方法，估算其对WER的影响。
AI.result: 未进行数字归一化导致的WER差异可能很大，超过2个百分点，且常高于流行多语言基准中系统之间的差异。
AI.conclusion: ASR评测中必须重视数值表达式归一化，否则会导致不公平比较；该问题在非英语、高度屈折语言中尤为突出。

title: Geometry of Values: Task Vector Composition for Ethical Preference Alignment in Language Models
comment: Accepted at the Pluralistic Alignment Workshop @ ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea. https://icml.cc/virtual/2026/75692
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in applications that must weigh clashing moral values, yet even strong models exhibit hidden biases and brittle instruction-following across languages. We introduce a 12,000-instance dataset of two-option dilemmas covering pairwise three value conflicts: Honesty vs. Justice, Justice vs. Autonomy, and Autonomy vs. Honesty, along with their translations into Hindi, Arabic, Spanish, and Chinese, to probe cross-lingual behavior. Benchmarking on GPT-5-mini reveals that it consistently favors Honesty over Autonomy across all five languages when no policy is given. The Llama-3.2-1/3B models exhibit strong first-option bias; however, both plain fine-tuning and Direct Preference Optimization fine-tuning effectively remove this bias, increasing accuracy to greater than 98%. In order to decouple the effect of learning correlations in the dataset from abstract values, we propose a task vector transfer based experiment where after computing the task vectors for a direction of value preference we orthogonalize it with respect to the general instruction following vector. Our experiment shows that this method is effective in isolating the direction of the specific value preference that can successfully be used to conduct task arithmetic to obtain a model with the opposite stance.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了覆盖三种价值观冲突（诚实vs正义、正义vs自主、自主vs诚实）的双选项道德困境数据集，含12000实例及印地语、阿拉伯语、西班牙语、中文翻译，用于探测LLM跨语言道德偏好。基准测试发现GPT-5-mini在所有语言中一致偏好诚实优于自主，Llama-3.2-1/3B存在强首选项偏差，但微调与DPO可将其准确率提升至98%以上。作者进一步提出基于任务向量迁移并正交化通用指令遵循向量的方法，成功分离出特定价值偏好方向，并通过任务算术得到立场相反的模型。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被部署于需权衡冲突道德价值的场景，但存在隐藏偏见与跨语言指令遵循脆弱性；同时难以区分模型学到的是数据集中的相关性还是抽象价值观本身，因此需要新数据集与解耦方法来探测并隔离价值偏好。
AI.method: 构建12,000实例双选项道德困境数据集，覆盖三种两两价值冲突，并翻译为印地语、阿拉伯语、西班牙语和中文；在GPT-5-mini及Llama-3.2-1/3B上进行基准测试；采用普通微调与直接偏好优化（DPO）微调消除首选项偏差；提出任务向量迁移实验，计算价值偏好方向的任务向量并将其对通用指令遵循向量正交化，以隔离特定价值偏好方向并进行任务算术。
AI.result: GPT-5-mini在无政策条件下跨五种语言一致偏好诚实优于自主；Llama-3.2-1/3B表现出强首选项偏差，普通微调与DPO微调均能有效消除该偏差，准确率提升至98%以上；正交化后的任务向量能有效隔离特定价值偏好方向，并可通过任务算术获得持有相反立场的模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了跨语言道德困境基准，揭示了LLM的价值偏好与首选项偏差，证明微调可缓解偏差，并提出正交化任务向量方法以解耦数据集相关性与抽象价值观，实现可控的立场反转。

title: MarsFM: Shading-Regularized Flow Matching for Martian Relief Estimation
summary: We present MarsFM, an image-conditioned latent flow-matching model for local Martian relief estimation from single-band HiRISE RED orthoimagery. The method combines a pretrained generative prior with stereo-derived geometric supervision and a differentiable Lunar--Lambert shading objective. Relief, normal, gradient, curvature, and ordinal terms constrain complementary aspects of terrain structure, while a positive-affine-invariant image comparison constrains rendered appearance. An evaluation comprising 2024 gathered patch records per integration-step count yields mean affine-aligned RMSE between 0.0935 and 0.0957 in normalized signed-log relief space for one to twenty Euler steps. These scores measure agreement with VAE-reconstructed references on positive-reference support. Their narrow range supports low-step inference under this protocol. Spatial, differential, and spectral diagnostics show broad terrain correspondence alongside smoothing, amplitude compression, and boundary mismatch. MarsFM provides a framework for combining learned terrain priors with image-based constraints; establishing improved physical terrain resolution requires matched baselines and independent high-resolution reference data. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/SuperComputer/mars_hirise_dtm_processed-6aa9b66ba461e07f; code: https://github.com/Marius-Juston/MarsRecon.

AI.tldr: MarsFM：一种图像条件隐空间流匹配模型，从单波段HiRISE RED正射影像估计局部火星地形起伏，结合生成先验与立体几何监督。
AI.motivation: 从单波段轨道影像重建火星局部地形起伏具有挑战性，需要将学习到的地形先验与图像约束相结合，以在缺乏高分辨率参考数据的情况下实现可靠估计。
AI.method: 采用预训练生成先验，融合立体影像导出的几何监督与可微分Lunar-Lambert着色目标；使用起伏、法线、梯度、曲率及序数项约束地形结构的不同方面，并以正仿射不变图像比较约束渲染外观。
AI.result: 在每积分步数2024条补丁记录上评估，1至20个Euler步的仿射对齐RMSE均值为0.0935–0.0957（归一化带符号对数起伏空间），衡量与VAE重建参考在正参考支撑上的一致性，区间狭窄支持低步推理；空间、微分与光谱诊断显示整体地形对应良好，但存在平滑、振幅压缩与边界失配。
AI.conclusion: MarsFM为结合学习地形先验与图像约束提供了框架；要确立更优的物理地形分辨率，仍需匹配基线及独立高分辨率参考数据。

title: Detecting Hallucination in LLMs: Tracing the Topological Signatures of Impaired Context Sharing
summary: In this work, we examine the topology of information flow patterns within attention graphs to effectively distinguish hallucinated from non-hallucinated responses. We analyze the Forman-Ricci curvature to identify structural patterns indicating information bottlenecks in attention graphs. We then introduce a method that captures both semi-local and global information-flow characteristics of attention heads associated with hallucinated responses. We evaluate our approach extensively across several LLMs and established benchmarks. Empirical results demonstrate that our proposed single-pass approach provides consistent improvements over existing attention-based and multi-response baselines across two hallucination-detection benchmarks, while achieving competitive performance across diverse LLM architectures. Further analysis reveals that impaired context sharing among tokens during causal generation is strongly associated with hallucination occurrences in LLMs. In particular, hallucinated responses are consistently characterized by an over-reliance on self-attention, diffused context retrieval from earlier tokens, or information over-squashing, especially in the final transformer layer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种单次推理的幻觉检测方法，通过分析注意力图的拓扑结构（Forman-Ricci曲率、半局部与全局信息流特征）来区分幻觉与非幻觉回复，在多个LLM和基准上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 幻觉检测对LLM可靠性至关重要。现有基于注意力的方法或多回复方法存在局限，本文希望从注意力图的信息流拓扑角度捕捉幻觉的结构性特征，并提供更高效、可泛化的检测方案。
AI.method: 将注意力图建模为图结构，计算Forman-Ricci曲率以识别信息瓶颈；提取与幻觉回复相关的注意力头的半局部（semi-local）和全局信息流特征，构建单次推理（single-pass）的检测方法。
AI.result: 在多个LLM和两个幻觉检测基准上，该方法相较现有基于注意力和多回复基线取得一致提升，并在多种LLM架构上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 因果生成过程中token间上下文共享受损与幻觉强相关：幻觉回复常表现为过度依赖自注意力、对早期token的上下文检索弥散，以及信息过度压缩（over-squashing），尤其在最后一个transformer层最为明显。

title: MarsRecon: Self-Supervised and Multimodal Surface Representations for Mars
summary: High-resolution orbital imagery offers a rich record of the Martian surface, but sparse geological labels limit supervised representation learning. We present MarsRecon, a geospatially aware pipeline for learning visual and multimodal representations from HiRISE observations of Olympus Mons. The pipeline calibrates NASA Planetary Data System products, extracts valid georeferenced patches, and trains a masked autoencoder on unlabeled imagery. Increasing input resolution and filtering invalid tokens reduced held-out reconstruction loss from 0.1751 to 0.1342 in the principal Stage A model series. We then freeze the visual encoder and align its features with observation text, coordinates, and local--global image context. The strongest current local-primary model achieves image-to-text recall@10 of 0.3787, text-to-image recall@10 of 0.9161, and local-to-global recall@10 of 0.4350 on the held-out test split. These results establish a working Mars-specific pretraining and retrieval pipeline; further crop-overlap controls and downstream geological evaluations are needed to assess the broader utility of its embeddings.

AI.tldr: 提出MarsRecon流程，基于HiRISE影像对火星奥林帕斯山进行自监督与多模态表征学习，重建损失由0.1751降至0.1342，图文检索recall@10最高达0.9161。
AI.motivation: 火星轨道高分辨率影像记录丰富，但地质标注稀疏，限制了监督式表征学习，因此需要构建面向火星的自监督预训练与多模态对齐流程。
AI.method: MarsRecon为具备地理空间感知的流程：对NASA行星数据系统（PDS）产品进行校准，提取有效的带地理参考影像块，在无标注影像上训练掩码自编码器（MAE）；随后冻结视觉编码器，将其特征与观测文本、坐标及局部—全局图像上下文进行对齐。
AI.result: Stage A主模型系列中，提高输入分辨率并过滤无效token使留出重建损失由0.1751降至0.1342；当前最强的局部主导模型在留出测试集上取得图文检索image-to-text recall@10为0.3787、text-to-image recall@10为0.9161、local-to-global recall@10为0.4350。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了可运行的火星专用预训练与检索流程；仍需补充裁剪重叠控制与下游地质任务评估，以验证其嵌入表征的更广泛实用性。

title: From Task Success to Productive Success: Evaluating Human-AI Collaboration by Quality and Cost
summary: AI productivity is often measured by task completion time, economic value, or improvements in outcome quality. However, these measures usually treat collaboration as a black box where they capture what output was produced, but not the interaction cost required to produce it. Motivated by economics literature, we introduce a productivity-oriented framework for evaluating human-AI collaboration as outcome quality relative to interaction cost. Across two datasets spanning four tasks, we show that: (1) sessions with identical quality ratings can differ by up to 70 times in interaction cost; (2) quality-cost relationships vary by task, with some tasks rewarding extended interaction and others favoring fast convergence; (3) subjective user ratings are not reliable substitutes for productivity; and (4) productive sessions are characterized by agents probing earlier and users spending less effort repairing the interaction. By distinguishing productive success from costly success, our framework makes interactional cost visible and shows how dialogue analysis can inform the evaluation and design of AI systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以"产出质量/交互成本"衡量人机协作生产力的框架，基于两个数据集四个任务发现：相同质量评级的会话交互成本可差70倍；质量-成本关系随任务而异；主观评分不能替代生产力；高生产力会话的特征是智能体更早探查、用户修复交互的投入更少。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生产力评估多用任务完成时间、经济价值或结果质量提升，但把协作本身视为黑箱，只捕捉产出，不衡量产出所需的交互成本，因而无法区分"高代价的成功"与"低成本的成功"。
AI.method: 受经济学文献启发，构建以结果质量相对于交互成本为核心的生产力评估框架，将人机协作对话作为分析对象，在两个数据集、四个任务上进行对话分析，比较会话的质量评级与交互成本，并考察任务类型、主观用户评分与交互行为特征的差异。
AI.result: （1）质量评级相同的会话，交互成本可相差达70倍；（2）质量-成本关系因任务而异，部分任务受益于延长交互，另一些则倾向于快速收敛；（3）主观用户评分不能可靠替代生产力指标；（4）高生产力会话表现为智能体更早进行探查，用户用于修复交互的精力更少。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将交互成本显性化，把"有生产力的成功"与"高代价的成功"区分开来，并表明对话分析可为AI系统的评估与设计提供依据。

title: Scaling Forced Alignment to End-User Devices
summary: The Viterbi algorithm has been previously used to perform forced alignment of audio to text to mine training data from online resources. However, many existing implementations have quadratic time and space complexity, scaling poorly to long input sequences. We propose two optimizations to address this issue. First, we apply the Hirschberg algorithm to perform the alignment in place using linear memory. Second, we model the alignment between speech and text as a constrained random walk, allowing us to prune the search space with arbitrary confidence while accounting for transcription errors. The Hirschberg optimization reduces memory usage from 140 GB to 5 MB for three-hour inputs while producing identical alignments in one-third the time of torchaudio when both run on a CPU. We achieve an additional 2x speedup with pruning on inputs longer than 20 minutes while preserving alignment accuracy in more than 98% of tested cases.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对Viterbi强制对齐的二次时空复杂度问题，提出Hirschberg算法实现线性内存对齐，并将语音-文本对齐建模为受约束随机游走以进行剪枝，显著降低内存与时间开销且保持对齐精度。
AI.motivation: 现有Viterbi强制对齐实现具有二次时间和空间复杂度，难以扩展到长输入序列，限制了从在线资源挖掘训练数据的效率。
AI.method: 提出两项优化：1）应用Hirschberg算法以线性内存进行原地对齐；2）将语音与文本的对齐建模为受约束随机游走，从而可任意置信度剪枝搜索空间并考虑转录错误。
AI.result: Hirschberg优化将三小时输入的内存占用从140 GB降至5 MB，在CPU上产生相同对齐结果且耗时仅为torchaudio的三分之一；配合剪枝在超过20分钟的输入上再获2倍加速，且在98%以上测试案例中保持对齐精度。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法有效缓解了强制对齐的扩展性问题，在大幅降低内存与时间成本的同时保持对齐准确性，适用于长序列的语音-文本对齐任务。

title: Clinician-Grounded Quality Assurance for AI-Assisted Psychiatric Intake
summary: Before patients can use AI-assisted psychiatric intake systems, health systems need practical ways to routinely evaluate these tools against their clinical standards for quality assurance. Because clinicians may use different intake styles, evaluation for this task must (1) support comparison across interviewing approaches, (2) minimize clinician burden, and (3) measure clinically relevant performance for health systems deploying these technologies. We present a clinician-grounded evaluation platform built around a memory-augmented patient simulator for open-ended AI interviewing, InterviewPlayground. We created interactive patients using InterviewPlayground with our expert-authored vignettes, constructed a simulated intake platform for the interviews, and designed evaluation modalities relevant to intake. In a pilot of 6 clinicians in a 25-minute assessment compared to a GPT-based LLM intake interviewer, the LLM recovered more of the clinically relevant items embedded in the patient vignettes (88.0% vs. 38.9%), but made more clinical inferences not based on the interview (56.8% vs. 27.8%), and characterized identified safety concerns less often (33.3% vs. 66.7%), setting the stage for deployed quality assurance for this task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以记忆增强患者模拟器为核心的临床医生本位评估平台InterviewPlayground，用于对AI精神科问诊系统进行常规质量保证评估，并通过6名临床医生的试点验证其在开放式访谈中的可行性与临床相关性。
AI.motivation: AI辅助精神科问诊系统在临床部署前，卫生系统需要可常规操作的评估手段以对照其临床质量标准。由于临床医生问诊风格各异，评估须满足三点：支持跨问诊方式的比较、最小化临床医生负担、测量对部署方具有临床相关性的表现。
AI.method: 构建以记忆增强患者模拟器为核心的医生本位评估平台InterviewPlayground；基于专家撰写的情景脚本创建可交互患者，搭建模拟问诊平台，并设计适用于问诊场景的评估模态。开展6名临床医生的25分钟试点评估，与基于GPT的大语言模型问诊者进行对比。
AI.result: LLM问诊者找回情景中嵌入的临床相关条目更多（88.0% vs. 38.9%），但产生更多非基于访谈的临床推断（56.8% vs. 27.8%），且对已识别安全顾虑进行特征化描述的比例更低（33.3% vs. 66.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 该平台为AI精神科问诊任务的部署级质量保证奠定基础，可支持跨问诊风格的标准化比较并揭示LLM在推断合理性与安全顾虑描述方面的不足。

title: CoLearn: An Agentic Tutor that Learns its Learner in a Human--AI Co-Learning Loop
summary: Good tutoring adapts to the individual: it tracks what a learner knows, notices why they go wrong, and asks the next question that will help most. Most deployed tutoring tools instead serve fixed item banks and treat a wrong answer as a single bit of signal. We present CoLearn, an interactive, agentic tutor that supports an iterative tutoring loop: the learner practises, and the system builds an evidence-grounded memory of the learner's mastery and misconceptions. This memory is updated as evidence accumulates and is used to generate the next personalised question. CoLearn has three components: (i) a persistent learner-state memory that updates per-topic mastery with a soft-evidence variant of Bayesian Knowledge Tracing, where a large language model acts as a continuous observation function; (ii) adaptive question generation that targets the learner's weakest topic and recurring misconceptions; and (iii) an evidence view that makes personalisation visible and testable through live progress visualisation and blind A/B comparison. In blind A/B evaluation, questions conditioned on this memory are preferred over non-personalised ones 68-69% of the time, and in persona simulations with hidden ground-truth mastery the agent's belief converges toward the learner's true mastery.

AI.tldr: CoLearn 是一个交互式智能体导师系统，通过持续构建并更新学习者状态记忆，实现个性化题目生成与个性化效果的可视化验证。
AI.motivation: 现有部署的辅导工具多采用固定题库，且仅把答错视为单一二值信号，无法追踪学习者真实掌握情况、识别错误原因并选择最优的下一题；而良好的辅导应具备这种个体化适应能力。
AI.method: CoLearn 支持迭代辅导闭环，包含三部分：(i) 持久学习者状态记忆，以贝叶斯知识追踪的软证据变体逐主题更新掌握度，并由大语言模型充当连续观察函数；(ii) 自适应题目生成，针对学习者最薄弱主题和反复出现的错误概念出题；(iii) 证据视图，通过实时进度可视化和盲测 A/B 对比使个性化可见、可检验。
AI.result: 盲测 A/B 评估中，基于该记忆条件生成的题目相较非个性化题目有 68–69% 的偏好率；在具有隐藏真实掌握度的角色模拟中，智能体的信念收敛于学习者的真实掌握水平。
AI.conclusion: 以证据为基础、持续更新的学习者记忆能够有效驱动个性化出题，并可通过盲测与模拟验证其个性化优势与掌握度估计的收敛性。
